1.5.0.readmeMarkdown:
# agy-dart **All-in-One Latency Accelerator & Context-Window Guard Plugin for Google Antigravity** Zero Runtime Dependencies · Dual-Engine Co-op · Hard `<= 8.8 KB` No-Spill Budget · Built-in Live Sidecar Dashboard · Optional Auto `rg` Setup [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · English · [Community Feedback & Improvements](#community-feedback--improvements) · [Third-Party Notices](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)
--- ## Why `agy-dart`? Long coding sessions in Google Antigravity (Desktop 2.0 / IDE / CLI) hit two compounding bottlenecks: 1. **Round-trip & check latency**: per-turn TTFT, split `edit_file` calls, serial shell searches, and Antigravity's ~10 KB MCP `output.txt` disk spill causing extra turns. 2. **Context bloat & agent amnesia**: multi-megabyte build logs, giant JSON/CSV payloads, and un-paged file dumps flooding the prompt. Installing separate acceleration and context-guard plugins naively causes friction (over-eager 8 KB read blocks fighting local 7ms `read_file`, conflicting `AGENTS.md` routing rules, MCP previews spilling past 10 KB, and missing Sidecar assets from npm installs). **`agy-dart`** fuses both capabilities into **one clean native Antigravity plugin** with unified zero-conflict routing, single-process lifecycle hooks, an isolated SQLite store (`~/.agy-dart/context.db`), and a live Aux Pane dashboard. > **Tip**: Google Antigravity evolves fast — click **Star** or **Watch → Releases only** so you don't miss compatibility fixes and new cache strategies. --- ## What's New in v1.5.0 (Cross-Session Empirical TTL Calibration, Opt-In Expiry Alert & Keep-Alive Replay) 1. **Cross-Session Per-Model Empirical TTL Calibration (`ttl_calibration:v1:`)**: - Learns real server-side KV-cache idle windows (e.g., 5m vs 10m vs 15m on Gemini 4 / Claude tiers) across conversations from bounded 14-day warm-hit lower bounds and pure-idle cold-miss upper bounds (`estimateCalibratedTtl`, bidirectional downward convergence when backend TTL shrinks, zero `ttl_idle_expiry` circular lock-in, `explicit > session/history > profile` precedence) while keeping `cache-analyzer.js` pure and backward-compatible (`diag.ttlCalibration`). 2. **Opt-In High-Context TTL Expiry Desktop Alert (Zero `statSync`)**: - Added `ttlDesktopNotify` (`AGY_DART_TTL_DESKTOP_NOTIFY`, Sidecar `TTL Alert` toggle, **OFF by default**), `ttlNotifyLeadSec` (`60s`), and `ttlNotifyMinTokens` (`60000`): fires a single debounced OS notification when an `IDLE` primary conversation with `>= 60k` tokens enters its final expiry window (`0 < remSec <= 60s`), strictly maintaining **0 `fs.statSync` calls**, sleep-wake suppression, and decoupled operation even when `stallWatchdog` is disabled. 3. **Counterfactual Keep-Alive Policy Replay in `npm run cache:simulate`**: - Expanded offline policy simulation to **9 policies** with `keepalive-1x` and `keepalive-unlimited` (`--keepalive-tail `, marked `hypothetical: true` so they never hijack `recommendedPolicy`), quantifying ping cache-read overhead, end-of-session walk-away waste, and apparent vs real user-turn hit rates (`userTurnHitRate`). ## What's New in v1.4.0 (Sidecar Stall Watchdog & Jailbreak-Free Rescue Loop) 1. **Dual-Source Fusion Stall Watchdog (5 Hooks + Sidecar + `transcript.jsonl` Self-Healing)**: - Added lightweight, fail-open `hooks/stop.mjs` (`Stop` hook in `hooks.json`) alongside `PreInvocation`, `PreToolUse`, and `PostToolUse` (now also covering `run_command` completion) writing direct-conversation-isolated execution leases (`watchdog_lease:`) into SQLite `meta` via ultra-lightweight `context/lib/watchdog-lease.js` (<1 ms load, 0-SQLite fast path preserved, 0-byte `stderr`). - Built `context/lib/watchdog.js` (`WatchdogMonitor`) running inside the persistent Aux Pane Sidecar (`sidecars/dashboard/server.mjs`): performs low-frequency polling with **zero `statSync` overhead when all conversations are `IDLE`**, **dual silence verification** (if `transcript.jsonl` `mtimeMs`/`size` is still growing, silence resets automatically), and **transcript tail self-healing** (detects completed/aborted terminal turns to heal missed `Stop` hooks without hiding newly hung turns). 2. **State-Aware Dynamic Timeout Matrix (Zero False Positives)**: - Distinguishes `IDLE`, `LLM_INFLIGHT` (`<120k` normal `120s`, `>=120k` or `/compact` `240s`, `>=150k` multimodal `360s`), `TOOL_RUNNING` (`read_file`/fast MCP `90s` vs sync `run_command`/`ctx_execute`/`run_checks` `300s`), and `SUBAGENT_BG` (async background tasks/subagents `600s`) with two-tier **yellow (`suspect`, 60%) → red (`stalled`, 100%)** alerting, all configurable via `~/.agy-dart/config.json` and `AGY_DART_WATCHDOG_*` env vars. 3. **Jailbreak-Free Rescue Loop & Engineering Safeguards**: - Auto-pre-generates a redacted **Rescue Handoff Brief** (`context/lib/handoff.js` `stallContext` snapshot: phase, silent duration, last tool/command, last user input, suspected root cause, modified files, last test/build & FTS5 handles) and surfaces **1–2 targeted troubleshooting steps** across 6 attribution buckets (`auto_compact_deadlock`, `terminal_eof_or_interactive`, `mcp_tool_blocked`, `host_tool_blocked`, `subagent_or_bg_stalled`, `oauth_ghost_or_network`) inside the Sidecar Watchdog card (with 1s local silence timer, Snooze/Mark-Idle actions, and opt-in debounced OS desktop notifications — **OFF by default**). - Hardened with **Sleep Drift Guard** (lid-close / OS suspend wall-vs-monotonic clock jump compensation), strict multi-session & subagent isolation, Sidecar restart cleanup of stale prior-app leases, `POST`-only CSRF-hardened `/api/watchdog` & `/api/watchdog/action` endpoints, zero CDP access, and zero host process killing. ## What's New in v1.3.1 (Long-Horizon & Zero-Latency Compaction Hardening) 1. **Zero-Latency Compaction Detection & Same-Turn Invalidation**: - Unified 4 compaction/pruning signals into `cache-analyzer.js` (`latestCompactionEvent` + `inspectTranscriptCompaction`): severe `compaction_or_truncation` bust, decoupled context shrink (even alongside `model_switch` or mild selective pruning `>= 15%` & `>= 8k` tokens from `>= 12k`), explicit compaction/summary steps, and `/compact` user commands. - Upgraded `PreInvocation` to react immediately to `/compact` `lastUserInput` (idempotent across `invocationNum >= 1` mid-turn tool loops) and `initialNumSteps` rollbacks; added a zero-normal-overhead slow-path check in `PreToolUse` (`statSync` size/mtime fast-skip + 128 KB tail scan) that catches silent auto-compaction on the very first post-compaction `read_file` call (0 wasted turns while preserving files newly read after the compaction step via `invalidateFileReadsBefore`). 2. **Full-Scope Turn Decay, Small-File Anti-Backfire Threshold & Failure Error Anchors**: - Added turn-based `readDedup` decay (`readDedupMaxTurns: 12`, `AGY_DART_READ_DEDUP_MAX_TURNS`, `file_reads.read_turn_seq`) driven by `PreInvocation` even when payloads omit `stepIdx`, plus automatic allow on `stepIdx` / `turnSeq` rollback. - Raised minimum `readDedup` threshold to configurable **`4096 B` (4 KB)** (`readDedupMinBytes`, `AGY_DART_READ_DEDUP_MIN_BYTES`) evaluated against the **actual requested slice size** (preventing 2-strike backfire on small configs or 15-line slices) and added isolated `dedup_bypass` telemetry in `featureRoi.features.read_dedup`. - Upgraded `hooks/filter-rules.mjs` with `compactFailureWithErrorAnchors` so oversized (`> 7.9 KB`) failing command outputs preserve head/tail summaries plus `±3`-line context around middle-of-log error anchors (`AssertionError`, `Traceback`, `ERROR`, `✖`, `not ok`, etc.) within `<= 7.9 KB` (`<= 8.8 KB` total), reducing extra `ctx_search` round-trips. ## What's New in v1.3.0 1. **4-Tier Host-Aligned Read Guard & Review Workflow First-Class Support**: - Aligned default source-file cutoff to **`45 KiB` (`46,080 B` / `<= 800` lines, `host-45k` mode)** matching Antigravity's native `read_file` cap with **2-strike soft guard** (5-branch session/subagent/anonymous TTL key isolation) so large source files and MCP-less subagents never deadlock, while keeping high-noise logs/locks/minified bundles at **`16 KB`** (`noiseMaxReadBytes`) and `.patch`/`.diff` code-review files at **`128 KB`** (`reviewMaxReadBytes`) with native `ByteOffset` / open-ended `StartLine` pagination continuation. - Decoupled `read_file` size exemptions (`exemptExtensions`, linear ReDoS-proof `exemptPaths`, `readGuardMode: "soft"|"strict"|"off"`) from **both** `readDedup`/`diffRead` (exempt text files still enjoy duplicate-read protection) and `run_command` (which now uses an independent `shellDumpMaxBytes = 16 KB` and no longer allows `cat huge.png` / `curl .../archive.zip` bypasses). - Fixed pre-1a read-cache priority (eliminating the 3-strike trap), `measureLineRangeBytes` `>2 MB && startLine > 1` blind spot, multi-line prose mislabeling as minified, `sensitive_read_confirm` TTL/isolation, `getExemptExtensions` split-state bug, Sidecar `/api/purge` `"conversation"` scope error, dynamic custom cutoff dropdown echo, and bidirectional upgrade migration (`cutoff:source` migrates legacy `16384` default while preserving custom cutoffs). 2. **Native Diff Outlines & 3-Stage Context-Preserving `git diff` / `gh pr diff` Filter**: - Added zero-dependency `.patch`/`.diff` outline parser (`extractDiffSymbols`) to `agy-dart_fast` `read_slices({ outlines })` mapping changed files (`+add/-del`) and `@@` hunks. - Upgraded `filterGitDiff` to 3-stage context fidelity (Stage 1 lossless within `<= 7.9 KB` budget → Stage 2 `-U`/`--unified`/`-W`/`--word-diff` context-preserved cap → Stage 3 1-line context before compact `+/-`, plus mailbox `From ` / `---` support) and fixed `filterGhCli` so `gh pr view` with Markdown diff fences is never wiped. ## What's New in v1.2.2 1. **Long-Task Continuity & Anti-Premature-Handoff Protections**: - Removed mid-task `/compact` prompts from `rules/AGENTS.md` and routed `>60s` builds/tests + background tasks (`WaitMsBeforeAsync <= 2000`, `cliFilterAsyncBypassMs`) directly to native `run_command` (preserving live streaming logs and attaching read-only `permissionOverrides` for plugin scripts on sync `overwrite`). - Raised `ctx_execute` default timeout to `120s` (`execTimeoutMs`, per-call `timeoutSec: 1..300`) with `timedOut: true` guidance, added workspace `cwd` support across `agy-dart_context` tools + MCP `initialize` `workspaceFolders`/`rootUri`, suppressed mid-turn tool-loop (`invocationNum >= 1`) TTL/cold-compact banners in `PreInvocation` (scaling 1M-window `ttlMinContext` to `300k`), and added step-based read-dedup decay (`readDedupMaxSteps: 40`). 2. **Second-Round Deep Audit, Cross-Platform CI & Protocol Hardening (42 Verified Fixes)**: - **Access-Control, SSRF, ReDoS & Windows Shell Fidelity**: Enforced end-to-end `sensitiveFileGuard=deny` (including symlinked files, `.envrc`/`*.env`, and `\\?\` ADS paths) across `PreToolUse`, `fast/mcp-server.mjs`, `ctx_index`, and `ctx_execute` (`P1-03`); forced `-n` on `git remote show` to block network SSRF (`P1-04`); hardened `install.mjs` against internal symlinks/NTFS junctions, UNC shares, and `.git` clones/worktrees while supporting self-`uninstall` (`P1-05`/`P1-06`); respected per-directory `PATHEXT` precedence and PowerShell `,`/`--`/`"` safety in `cli-filter` (`P1-07`); and capped serialized `fast` JSON-RPC payloads `<= 8.8 KB` with mixed `\n\n`/`\r\n\r\n` frame safety, dangling-symlink rollback, and bounded glob/regex/Markdown linear parsers (`P1-09`–`P1-13`). - **Session Isolation, Process-Group Teardown & Multi-Provider Accuracy**: Enforced strict session/worktree/lifetime isolation in Sidecar `/api/search` and MCP `ctx_search`/`ctx_resume` (`P1-01`); added POSIX `detached` process-group + Windows `taskkill /T /F` teardown, linear JS ESM `--input-type=module` lexer, recursive subshell inspection, and graceful Windows `413` socket close; wrapped `pruneByTtl` in transactions, computed per-turn USD cost across `model_switch`, fixed OpenAI gateway cached-token double-counting, and anchored 1h implicit-write replay deltas (126/126 tests across Linux & Windows on Node 22/24). ## What's New in v1.2.1 1. **Full-Repository Security & Stability Hardening (76 Audited Fixes)**: - Split `apply_edits` temp-file write from `rename` fallback with guaranteed rollback (`C-1`), attached `child.stdin`/`stdout`/`stderr` error handlers and `close`-drained capture in `context/lib/executor.js` (`C-2`/`H-10`), hardened PowerShell `-Command` argument passing via env-var indirection (`M-21`), closed read-only `git branch`/`tag` `OPTARG` bypasses (`H-1`), hardened Windows `\\?\`/`\\.\`/8.3 path canonicalization (`H-2`/`H-3`), and eliminated $O(N^4)$ CSS/SFC outline ReDoS (`H-7`). ## What's New in v1.2.0 1. **Sidecar Security Hardening & Unified Config (`~/.agy-dart/config.json`)**: - Standalone HTTP Sidecar requires per-process `X-Agy-Dart-Token` across all `/api/*` endpoints (while `SidecarApp` mode enforces `POST` + `X-Sidecar-Token`); `/api/search` and all mutating endpoints (`/api/purge`, `/api/toggle-active`, `/api/cutoff`, `/api/exemptions`, `/api/maintenance`, `/api/cli-filter`, `/api/read-dedup`) are strictly `POST`-only with `Content-Type: application/json`, `Host`/`Origin`/`Sec-Fetch-Site` anti-DNS-rebinding guards, a `64 KB` request body cap, and XSS-safe DOM rendering. - Consolidated 20+ `AGY_DART_*` toggles into `~/.agy-dart/config.json` (with `AGY_DART_*` env vars always overriding); `doctor` and `ctx_doctor` print effective flags and override provenance. 2. **SmartCrusher, Expanded CLI Rules & Hardened Shell Guard**: - Reversible zero-dep JSON/JSONL structural compactor (`context/lib/json-crusher.js`) extracts schema, head/tail samples, and prioritized anomalies (`status >= 400`, `ok: false`, fatal/error rows) while indexing raw output into FTS5. - Added built-in CLI rules for `gh`, `kubectl`, `terraform`, and `playwright`, project-level declarative `.agy-dart/filters.json` (with ReDoS validator), safe `cd [/d] && [2>&1]` unwrapping, and stricter cmd/PowerShell metacharacter rejection (`%`, `!`, `{}`, `@`, non-git `^`). 3. **Opt-In Three-State Diff-Read Cache (Safe by Default)**: - Compact unified-diff re-reads on modified files are **OFF by default** (`diffRead: true` in `~/.agy-dart/config.json` or `AGY_DART_ENABLE_DIFF_READ=1` to opt in), scoped strictly to direct `conversationId` (zero parent↔subagent baseline leaks), bounded by recency (`diffReadMaxTurns` / `diffReadMaxAgeMs`), and carry baseline SHA/timestamp + 2-strike full-file bypass hints. 4. **KV-Cache Diagnostics, Policy Replay, Handoff Brief & Persistent L2 Caches**: - Added `npm run cache:audit` (global Prompt Cache audit), `npm run cache:simulate` (7-policy offline replay comparing 5m vs 1h TTL, cold-boundary compact, and cutoffs), Sidecar **Handoff Brief** + live 1s TTL countdown, 7-bucket `contextComposition` & `subagentBreakdown`, subagent Turn-0 stable-prefix sharing, persistent SQLite L2 `outline_cache`, per-feature ROI telemetry (`featureRoi`), and cross-Node 22/24 zero-`stderr` SQLite warning suppression. 5. **Modular Store & Lean Runtime Install**: - Split `context/lib/store.js` into focused `context/lib/store/` submodules and `context/lib/cache/profiles.js`; default `scripts/install.mjs install` copies **runtime files only** (pass `--with-devtools` to also copy offline benchmark/audit CLIs), verified automatically by `npm run verify:pkg`. ## What's New in v1.1.0 1. **Transparent CLI Output Filtering (`PreToolUse.overwrite`)**: Automatically wraps safe noisy dev commands (`git status/diff/log`, `npm/pnpm/yarn/node/pytest/cargo/go/dotnet` tests, `tsc/eslint/ruff/mypy/vite/cargo` builds, package installs, `docker build`) through zero-dependency `hooks/cli-filter.mjs` in **1 turn** (zero deny/retry overhead!), preserving exact exit codes, stripping ANSI/spinners, capping inline output `<= 8.8 KB`, and indexing raw output in SQLite FTS5. 2. **Server-Side KV-Cache Protection & Diagnostics**: - Deterministic prefix-stable `SessionStart` ordering (static routing line → semi-static Project/Layout + `git HEAD`-cached import hubs → volatile `git status` last) and slimmed canonical Turn-0 MCP tool schemas (`npm run prefix:budget` ~2,832–2,950 est. tokens). - Model-aware dynamic watermarks, idle TTL, and cost-discount estimation (`resolveModelProfile` across Claude / Gemini / GPT / DeepSeek / Qwen tiers, with env overrides) + **Doom-Loop / Oscillation Watch** (`edit↔fail` cycles & normalized tool-call repeat rate). - Zero-prefix-pollution `PreInvocation` hook using Antigravity's UI-only `metadata.user_markdown` (`systemMessage: ""`) for dynamic context watermark, hot-cache compact-delay, idle TTL expiry, multimodal TTFT cliff, and convergence alerts. - Deep `transcript.jsonl` cache-bust attribution, last-15-turns ASCII hit-rate trend, and Top-3 context-growth tool attribution in both `fast/benchmark.mjs cache` and the live Sidecar Dashboard (with mini hit-rate bar chart). 3. **2-Strike Session Read Deduplication, Bounded Slice Cache & Structured `ctx_resume` Checkpoint**: - Tracks `(session, file, range, mtime, size)` in SQLite to prevent redundant unchanged re-reads while automatically invalidating on edits or compaction (`ctx_resume`), and maintains a compact `sessionCheckpoint` ledger (modified files + latest test/build status) returned by `ctx_resume` with zero extra MCP tools. - Cross-call `(mtimeMs, size)` LRU caches in `agy-dart_fast` for both `read_slices({ outlines })` (128 entries) and `read_slices({ slices })` (bounded <= 4 MB total / <= 256 KB per file, actively invalidated by `apply_edits`). 4. **Security Hardening & DB Maintenance**: - SSRF-hardened `ctx_index(url)` (`http:`/`https:` whitelist, max 5 redirects with relative `Location` resolution, per-hop DNS & IPv4/IPv6 private/loopback/link-local blocking with DNS pinning), configurable secret redaction before indexing/return (`AGY_DART_DISABLE_SECRET_REDACTION=1` to opt out), and optional sensitive-file read guard (`AGY_DART_SENSITIVE_FILE_GUARD=warn|deny`). - Heading-aware Markdown chunking, SHA-256 content dedup, daily TTL pruning, `ctx_purge({ scope: "stale", vacuum: true })`, and one-click **Prune & Vacuum** in the Sidecar Dashboard. --- ## Community Feedback & Improvements This dedicated section tracks real-world friction reported by the community (preserving the original feedback), along with the exact engineering fixes and underlying design principles shipped in response. ### `[v1.5.0]` 15-Minute Idle KV-Cache Expiry vs. Automatic Keep-Alive Pings #### 1. Original Community Feedback > *"`@billy88lsh`: Looking at my records, my cache hit rate is 97%. Your problem is that you keep timing out — once past 15 minutes the cache is gone. The way to improve it is to have the program automatically ping/activate the cache after each turn."* > > *(Original Chinese: 「@billy88lsh: 我看的记录，我的缓存是97。你的问题是你总是超时，超过15分钟就缓存没了。提升的办法就是回答完一轮，程序自动激活一下缓存」)* Auditing both Antigravity's plugin sandbox boundaries and prompt-cache billing math clarified why idle timeouts dominate average hit-rate drops — and why blind auto-pinging backfires: 1. **Hard 300s static profile TTL missed real ~15m server windows**: `v1.4.x` defaulted Gemini 3/4 and unknown tiers to `300s` (5m) and forgot empirical calibration on every new conversation, causing premature expiry warnings and zero downward adaptation when backend LRU windows shrank. 2. **Plugin-layer auto-keep-alive is impossible without prefix/UI pollution**: Server KV-cache keys bind to the host's full raw request prefix (hidden system prompt, tool schemas, thinking signatures, auth routing). `Stop` hooks are synchronous (`5s` cap), Sidecars lack silent 1-token RPCs, and synthetic messages pollute history and violate zero-prefix-pollution invariants. 3. **Narrow break-even & Goodhart's Law**: Each keep-alive ping still pays `0.10x`–`0.25x` cached-read cost + output/thinking/request quota. 10 pings at 90% discount (or 4 at 75% discount) already cost as much as a full cold re-prefill, and walk-away sessions burn 100% wasted quota while artificially inflating apparent hit-rate metrics. #### 2. Solution Shipped (`v1.4.x` → `v1.5.0`) | Area | Before (`v1.4.x`) | After (`v1.5.0`) | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **TTL Estimation** | Static `300s` reset on every new conversation; upward-only single-session floor | **Cross-Session Per-Model Calibration (`ttl_calibration:v1:`)**: 14-day bounded ring buffer of warm lower bounds & pure-idle cold upper bounds (`estimateCalibratedTtl`), bidirectional downward convergence, `explicit > session/history > profile` precedence | | **Idle Expiry Awareness** | Only in-pane countdown bar; missed when user switches apps | **Opt-In High-Context TTL Desktop Alert**: `ttlDesktopNotify` (`>= 60k` tokens, `(0, 60s]` lead window, debounced 1x per idle anchor + 60s global cooldown, **0 `statSync`**, sleep-jump guarded, works even with `stallWatchdog=false`) | | **Keep-Alive Economics** | No way to test whether auto-pinging saves or wastes money on real usage | **`cache:simulate` Keep-Alive Replay**: Added `keepalive-1x` & `keepalive-unlimited` (`--keepalive-tail `, `hypothetical: true`), reporting both apparent `projectedHitRate` and `userTurnHitRate` plus wasted walk-away pings | ### `[v1.4.0]` Multi-Turn Silent Hang ("Working Forever With Zero Output") #### 1. Original Community Feedback > *"After multiple turns of conversation, it very easily stays 'working' forever without outputting anything and just freezes — isn't there an automatic summarization/compaction feature?"* > > *(Original Chinese: 「我在多轮对话之后很容易一直工作中却不输出任何东西，直接卡住了，难道没有自动总结压缩的功能么？」)* Analyzing Antigravity's multi-turn execution lifecycle revealed **4 distinct real-world hang modes** that all look identical in the UI (an endless spinner with zero streamed output): 1. **High-context / background auto-compaction deadlock**: At `>= 120k` tokens (or `>= 150k` with images), silent auto-compaction or cold prefill can hang indefinitely with no user-visible timeout or progress bar. 2. **Windows terminal EOF / interactive prompt blocking**: A synchronous `run_command` waiting on `[y/N]`, a pager (`less`/`more`), or a Windows PowerShell/CMD stdin EOF never finishes and blocks the entire turn. 3. **OAuth Ghost Session / proxy disconnect**: Silent network drops or stale OAuth sessions leave the request spinning at 0 streamed bytes. 4. **Blocked MCP tool call**: A wedged MCP server leaves the agent waiting indefinitely while the user has no visibility into which phase or tool actually froze. #### 2. Solution Shipped (`v1.3.x` → `v1.4.0`) | Area | Before (`v1.3.x`) | After (`v1.4.0`) | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Execution Visibility** | No active turn/tool state tracking; users stare at an endless spinner | **Dual-Source Fusion State Machine**: `PreInvocation` / `PreToolUse` / `PostToolUse` (`+run_command`) / `Stop` hooks write per-conversation leases (`watchdog_lease:`) into SQLite `meta`, fused with Sidecar `transcript.jsonl` `mtimeMs`/`size` & tail self-healing | | **Stall Detection** | None (or naive flat timer prone to false alarms on long builds / 150k turns) | **State-Aware Dynamic Timeout Matrix**: `IDLE` (0 `statSync`) · `LLM_INFLIGHT` (`<120k` 120s / `>=120k` or `/compact` 240s / `>=150k` multimodal 360s) · `TOOL_RUNNING` (`read_file`/fast MCP 90s vs sync `run_command`/`ctx_execute` 300s) · `SUBAGENT_BG` (600s), yellow `suspect` + red `stalled`, dual-silence growth extension | | **Recovery Workflow** | Manual guesswork; stopping a hung turn risks losing context & progress | **Jailbreak-Free Rescue Loop**: Entering red `stalled` auto-pre-generates a redacted **Rescue Handoff Brief** (phase, silent duration, last tool/command, last user input, git diff stat, checkpoint & FTS5 handles) + 1–2 root-cause tips across 6 causes, 1s local Sidecar timer, Snooze/Mark-Idle, and opt-in debounced desktop notify (OFF by default) | | **Robustness & Security** | N/A | **Sleep Drift Guard** (lid-close/suspend jump compensation), multi-session & subagent isolation, Sidecar restart stale-lease cleanup, `hookMode: true` fail-open, `POST`-only CSRF-hardened `/api/watchdog*`, zero CDP, zero host process killing | #### 3. Underlying Design Principles 1. **Sidecar Watchdog + Lifecycle Hooks beats fragile CDP/process-killing**: Injecting into the host via CDP or force-killing `language_server` risks corrupting active trajectories and breaks across Antigravity updates. Running a zero-dependency monitor inside the existing `restart_policy: always` Sidecar + fail-open hooks is 100% jailbreak-free and leaves cancellation firmly under user control. 2. **Never alert on one noisy signal alone**: Hooks alone can miss a `Stop` event; `transcript.jsonl` alone doesn't distinguish `IDLE` from a silent Turn-1 hang. Fusing SQLite leases with transcript growth checks and timestamp-guarded tail self-healing achieves both zero false alarms on active streaming and instant self-healing on missed `Stop` hooks. 3. **Separate hook hot-path latency from Sidecar analytics**: Splitting ultra-lightweight `watchdog-lease.js` (<1 ms load) from `watchdog.js` keeps `PreToolUse` 0-SQLite fast paths and latency budgets untouched while giving Sidecar full transcript/handoff/attribution richness. 4. **Zero background disk I/O when idle & immune to laptop sleep**: When all conversations are `IDLE`, `WatchdogMonitor.tick()` executes zero `statSync` calls; when a laptop resumes from sleep, wall-vs-monotonic clock drift detection automatically compensates active leases instead of firing false red alerts. ### `[v1.3.0]` 16 KB Default Read Guard Blocking Code Review (`.patch`) & MCP-less Subagents #### 1. Original Community Feedback > *"Claude doesn't have this limit — it reads large files in chunks without stopping. This 16 KB limit isn't built into Antigravity either; it's a pre-read check (`agy-dart protection`) from your local config. Relaxing it or exempting the review directory fixes it — is a 16 KB single-file read/write limit seriously the default config?"* > > *(Original Chinese: 「Claude 没有这个限制。大文件它会分段读完，不会因此停下来。这个 16 KB 的限制也不是 Antigravity 自带的，而是你那台机器上 Antigravity 配置里加的一道读前检查（agy-dart protection），放宽它或者给评审目录开个例外就能解决，16kb 单文件读写居然是默认配置吗」)* > *"`@xcq`: I use it as a reviewer in my workflow and hit this exact issue — git `.patch` files get rejected directly because a single patch easily exceeds 16 KB and fails under the default config, so I fell back to `AGY_DART_DISABLE_READ_HOOK=1`."* > > *(Original Chinese: 「@xcq: 我是让他做我工作流的 reviewer，会碰到这种情况，git 的 patch 文件直接拒绝读写，因为单个 patch 文件随便就超过 16kb 了碰到现在的默认设置就会失败，我走了 `AGY_DART_DISABLE_READ_HOOK=1`」)* *(Note: `agy-dart` never restricts writes—only pre-read guards—but blocking `.patch` reads is enough to stall a review workflow.)* End-to-end codebase auditing against these reports exposed **5 deeper root causes in `v1.2.2`**: 1. **Permanent hard-deny at 35% of the host's native cap**: Antigravity's native `read_file` already caps each call at `46,080 B` (45 KiB) / 800 lines with native pagination, yet `v1.2.2` inherited a 16 KB hard-deny with no 2-strike bypass (unlike `read-dedup` and `diff-read` in the same file). 2. **Valid host pagination blocked by the hook itself**: `ByteOffset` was parsed *after* the size guard, open-ended `StartLine` continuations hit `isWideRange`, and wide multi-line prose/logs exceeding 36 KB were mislabeled as `"giant single-line/minified content"`. 3. **Broken code-review fallback chain**: `agy-dart_fast` `read_slices({ outlines })` had no `.patch`/`.diff` parser, while `filterGitDiff` stripped all `' '` context lines from `git diff` and `gh pr diff` (and `filterGhCli` wiped `gh pr view` metadata whenever a PR body contained a Markdown diff fence). 4. **MCP-less subagent deadlock (same class as upstream `context-mode#1311`)**: Reviewer/research subagents without `agy-dart_context` tools stalled when hard-denied with MCP-only instructions. 5. **Cross-channel coupling**: Text extension exemptions short-circuited before `readDedup`, and `run_command` (`cat`/`curl`) shared `maxReadBytes` and `exemptExtensions`, meaning disabling the read cutoff or adding exemptions could inadvertently punch holes through shell dump protection. #### 2. Solution Shipped (`v1.2.2` → `v1.3.0`) | Area | Before (`v1.2.2`) | After (`v1.3.0`) | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Read Threshold Model** | Flat `16 KB / 410 lines` permanent hard `deny` | **4-Tier Risk Model + 2-Strike Soft Guard (default `host-45k`)**:
• Tier 0 (attachments / instructions / binaries): 0-SQLite allow
• Tier 1 (high-noise logs / lockfiles / minified): **`16 KB`** (`noiseMaxReadBytes`)
• Tier 2 (source code / docs): **`45 KiB` (`46,080 B`) / 800 lines** + 2-strike
• Tier 3 (`.patch` / `.diff` review): **`128 KB`** (`reviewMaxReadBytes`) direct allow, 2-strike above | | **Pagination & Anti-Deadlock** | Blocked `ByteOffset` & open-ended `StartLine`; stalled MCP-less subagents | Pre-guard `ByteOffset` remaining-bytes check & valid continuation allow; split minified vs wide multi-line slices (computing `suggestedLines`); 5-branch session/subagent/anonymous TTL isolation + pre-1a read-cache priority (eliminates 3-strike trap); subagent 2-strike native fallback | | **Channel Decoupling & Security** | Exemptions skipped `readDedup` & leaked into `cat`/`curl` | `read_file` size exemptions skip Section 1a only (**preserving `readDedup`/`diffRead`**); `run_command` uses independent `shellDumpMaxBytes = 16 KB` with `exemptExtensions` removed; `realpathSync` symlink checks & strict integer `parseLineArg` | | **First-Class Code Review** | No `.patch` outliner; `git diff` stripped context | Native zero-dep `.patch`/`.diff` parser (`extractDiffSymbols`) in `read_slices({ outlines })`; **3-stage context-preserving `filterGitDiff`** inside `<= 7.9 KB` (lossless within budget → `-U`/`-W` preserved cap → 1-line context before compact `+/-`) + fixed `gh pr view` detection | | **Trusted Config & Upgrade** | Required `AGY_DART_DISABLE_READ_HOOK=1` | `~/.agy-dart/config.json` adds `readGuardMode` (`soft`/`strict`/`off`), per-tier cutoffs, `exemptExtensions`, and linear ReDoS-proof `exemptPaths`; `cutoff:source` migrates legacy `16384` default to `46080` while preserving user-chosen cutoffs | #### 3. Underlying Design Principles 1. **Align with the host's physical ceiling to eliminate negative-ROI blocks**: Because Antigravity's host `read_file` already caps single responses at `46,080 B` (~11.5K tokens) / 800 lines, hard-blocking `16 KB–45 KiB` files saves minimal tokens while paying an extra full-prefix LLM round trip (negative ROI). Aligning source defaults to `45 KiB` guarantees 1-turn lossless reads below the cap and intervenes only when multi-turn paging is actually unavoidable. 2. **Tier by signal-to-noise ratio and reading mode, not flat file size**: Logs, lockfiles, and minified bundles rarely benefit from sequential reading (`ctx_execute` cuts >90%, keeping `16 KB`); source code aligns to `45 KiB`; sequential code-review `.patch`/`.diff` files need linear inspection to catch logic bugs (`128 KB` direct allow + native Diff Outline above). 3. **Soft 2-strike guardrails over permanent deadlocks**: Hooks cannot assume every subagent has MCP tools. A 2-strike retry path (bounded by the host's 45 KiB ceiling) preserves Turn-1 guidance while guaranteeing zero deadlocks—backed by 5-branch TTL key isolation, TTL refresh across continuation pages, and read-cache priority so retries never loop into 3-strike chains. 4. **Strictly decouple host-capped channels from uncapped channels**: `read_file` has a 45 KiB host cap, whereas `cat`, `curl`, and `git diff` do not. Relaxing `read_file` must never relax shell dump guards (`shellDumpMaxBytes`) or bypass `cli-filter.mjs` via `skipFlags` (which would expose unbounded 5 MB diffs without secret redaction), and skipping first-read size checks must never disable `readDedup`. 5. **Preserve the security threat model**: `exemptPaths` and `exemptExtensions` are loaded exclusively from trusted user-level `~/.agy-dart/config.json` and env vars (never from untrusted repo configs), run strictly after `sensitiveFileGuard`, validate symlink targets via `fs.realpathSync`, and use linear segment matching to eliminate ReDoS. ### `[v1.2.2]` Premature Handoffs & Interrupted Long-Running Tasks #### 1. Original Community Feedback > *"After enabling dart (`agy-dart`), it becomes very hard to run long tasks — it automatically hands off within a very short time."* > > *(Original Chinese: 「使用了dart之后，就很难进行长任务了，会自动在很短的时间内交接」)* Auditing Antigravity's executor loop alongside `v1.2.1` revealed that "premature automatic handoffs" reflected both **early turn termination yielding control back to the user** and **frequent `Handoff Brief` / `/compact` banners firing after just a few minutes**, driven by **5 concrete root causes**: 1. **Imperative phase-boundary `/compact` rule inducing self-handoffs**: `rules/AGENTS.md` instructed the agent to *"compact at cold/phase boundaries then call `ctx_resume`"*. Because `/compact` is a UI-only slash command that the model cannot invoke via tools, obedient models following `` stopped calling tools at the end of Phase 1 (within minutes) and handed control back to the user asking them to run `/compact`. 2. **Hardcoded `30s` MCP sandbox kill on long scripts**: While native `run_command` transitions seamlessly into asynchronous background tasks after `WaitMsBeforeAsync`, `ctx_execute` hardcoded a `30,000 ms` kill timer (`exitCode: 124`) with no timeout parameter (and `run_checks` defaulted to `60s`), killing long builds or batch scripts within 30–60s and forcing an error handoff. 3. **`PreToolUse.overwrite` friction with Terminal Sandbox & async background streams**: `cli-filter.mjs` buffered stdout/stderr until process exit (leaving `manage_task(status)` blank during background runs). Worse, under `Default`/`Auto` Terminal Sandbox presets, `~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-dart` sits outside the workspace mount—causing rewritten commands to fail inside the sandbox, request unsandboxed execution, and pause for manual user approval. 4. **Mid-turn tool-loop & 1M-window false `Handoff Brief` alerts**: `PreInvocation` did not distinguish user idle time from long tool/subagent execution gaps (`invocationNum >= 1`), firing 5-minute TTL handoff banners mid-task; meanwhile `ttlMinContext` was clamped via `Math.min(..., 60000)` to `60k`—just 6% of a 1M-token window. 5. **Unbounded `read-dedup` burning `MAX_INVOCATIONS` budget**: In deep 50+ step tasks, re-verifying a file read dozens of steps earlier still triggered a Strike-1 `deny`, consuming extra model invocations against the host's per-turn `MAX_INVOCATIONS` ceiling. #### 2. Solution Shipped (`v1.2.1` → `v1.2.2`) | Area | Before (`v1.2.1`) | After (`v1.2.2`) | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Phase-Boundary Rule (`AGENTS.md`)** | Imperative prompt to compact at cold/phase boundaries | **Strictly passive rule**: never pause mid-task to ask for `/compact`; keep long tasks continuous and call `ctx_resume` only after user compaction; route `>60s` & async commands to native `run_command` | | **MCP Sandbox Timeout** | Hardcoded `30s` kill in `ctx_execute` with no parameter | Raised default to **`120s`** (`execTimeoutMs`), exposed per-call `timeoutSec: 1..300`, and added explicit `timedOut: true` + native background `run_command` fallback guidance | | **Sandbox & Async Stream Bypass** | Rewrote async commands (buffering live logs); lacked sandbox read grant; orphan shells on kill | Bypass `cli-filter` when `WaitMsBeforeAsync <= 2000ms` (`cliFilterAsyncBypassMs`) or `IsDaemon: true`; attach read-only `permissionOverrides` (`read_file()`) on sync `overwrite`; full Windows `taskkill /T /F` & POSIX `detached` process-group teardown | | **Mid-Turn & 1M Watermark Alerts** | Fired TTL/handoff banners mid-loop and at `60k` on 1M models | Suppress idle TTL & cold-compact handoff banners during mid-turn tool loops (`invocationNum >= 1` & `diag.inToolLoop`); scale `ttlMinContext` to model `coldCompactTokens` (`60k` on 200k models, **`300k`** on 1M models) | | **Step-Decayed Read Dedup** | Session-wide dedup regardless of trajectory depth | Track `read_step` in `file_reads` and auto-allow re-reads after `readDedupMaxSteps` (default **`40` steps**), preserving `MAX_INVOCATIONS` budget in deep tasks | #### 3. Underlying Design Principles 1. **Never put user-only actions as imperative commands inside ``**: Antigravity injects `AGENTS.md` as highest-priority mandatory instructions. Because an agent cannot execute UI slash commands like `/compact`, any imperative to "compact at phase boundaries" forces compliant models to halt execution and hand off to the human. Framing compaction strictly as a post-hoc recovery hook (`ctx_resume` after user action) keeps multi-phase execution uninterrupted. 2. **Separate synchronous data filtering from asynchronous lifecycle management**: MCP `tools/call` is inherently synchronous and bounded by RPC/stream idle timeouts—ideal for `<=120s` sandbox data reduction (`ctx_execute`), whereas long builds, test suites, and daemons rely on Antigravity's native background task streaming (`manage_task`) and reactive wakeup. Routing by `WaitMsBeforeAsync <= 2000ms` and `>60s` preserves both fast inline filtering and multi-hour background durability. 3. **Least-privilege sandbox bridging (read-only code vs. isolated DB state)**: Mounting `~/.agy-dart` read-write into the Terminal Sandbox would let untrusted repo test scripts tamper with `context.db`. Granting only `read_file()` via `permissionOverrides` exposes immutable plugin JS so rewritten commands never trigger unsandboxed approval prompts, while `cli-filter.mjs` degrades gracefully in memory whenever SQLite writes are sandbox-restricted. 4. **Distinguish turn-entry user idle from mid-turn tool execution**: When `invocationNum >= 1` inside an active tool loop (`inToolLoop`), elapsed time since `lastPlannerAt` reflects a long tool or subagent run—not human inactivity—and the user cannot run `/compact` mid-turn anyway. Scaling `ttlMinContext` to `30%` of the active model's window (`coldCompactTokens`) keeps alerts meaningful across both 200k and 1M context models. 5. **Balance attention decay against `MAX_INVOCATIONS` step budgets**: Blocking duplicate reads within `<= 40` steps eliminates pure token waste, but 40+ steps into a complex refactor, re-reading a target file before editing prevents stale-context hallucinations without burning extra `deny`/retry turns. --- ## Credits & Open-Source Inspirations `agy-dart` is 100% MIT-licensed with zero runtime npm dependencies (full upstream # agy-dart **All-in-One Latency Accelerator & Context-Window Guard Plugin for Google Antigravity** Zero Runtime Dependencies · Dual-Engine Co-op · Hard `<= 8.8 KB` No-Spill Budget · Built-in Live Sidecar Dashboard · Optional Auto `rg` Setup [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · English · [Community Feedback & Improvements](#community-feedback--improvements) · [Third-Party Notices](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)
--- ## Why `agy-dart`? Long coding sessions in Google Antigravity (Desktop 2.0 / IDE / CLI) hit two compounding bottlenecks: 1. **Round-trip & check latency**: per-turn TTFT, split `edit_file` calls, serial shell searches, and Antigravity's ~10 KB MCP `output.txt` disk spill causing extra turns. 2. **Context bloat & agent amnesia**: multi-megabyte build logs, giant JSON/CSV payloads, and un-paged file dumps flooding the prompt. Installing separate acceleration and context-guard plugins naively causes friction (over-eager 8 KB read blocks fighting local 7ms `read_file`, conflicting `AGENTS.md` routing rules, MCP previews spilling past 10 KB, and missing Sidecar assets from npm installs). **`agy-dart`** fuses both capabilities into **one clean native Antigravity plugin** with unified zero-conflict routing, single-process lifecycle hooks, an isolated SQLite store (`~/.agy-dart/context.db`), and a live Aux Pane dashboard. > **Tip**: Google Antigravity evolves fast — click **Star** or **Watch → Releases only** so you don't miss compatibility fixes and new cache strategies. --- ## What's New in v1.5.0 (Cross-Session Empirical TTL Calibration, Opt-In Expiry Alert & Keep-Alive Replay) 1. **Cross-Session Per-Model Empirical TTL Calibration (`ttl_calibration:v1:`)**: - Learns real server-side KV-cache idle windows (e.g., 5m vs 10m vs 15m on Gemini 4 / Claude tiers) across conversations from bounded 14-day warm-hit lower bounds and pure-idle cold-miss upper bounds (`estimateCalibratedTtl`, bidirectional downward convergence when backend TTL shrinks, zero `ttl_idle_expiry` circular lock-in, `explicit > session/history > profile` precedence) while keeping `cache-analyzer.js` pure and backward-compatible (`diag.ttlCalibration`). 2. **Opt-In High-Context TTL Expiry Desktop Alert (Zero `statSync`)**: - Added `ttlDesktopNotify` (`AGY_DART_TTL_DESKTOP_NOTIFY`, Sidecar `TTL Alert` toggle, **OFF by default**), `ttlNotifyLeadSec` (`60s`), and `ttlNotifyMinTokens` (`60000`): fires a single debounced OS notification when an `IDLE` primary conversation with `>= 60k` tokens enters its final expiry window (`0 < remSec <= 60s`), strictly maintaining **0 `fs.statSync` calls**, sleep-wake suppression, and decoupled operation even when `stallWatchdog` is disabled. 3. **Counterfactual Keep-Alive Policy Replay in `npm run cache:simulate`**: - Expanded offline policy simulation to **9 policies** with `keepalive-1x` and `keepalive-unlimited` (`--keepalive-tail `, marked `hypothetical: true` so they never hijack `recommendedPolicy`), quantifying ping cache-read overhead, end-of-session walk-away waste, and apparent vs real user-turn hit rates (`userTurnHitRate`). ## What's New in v1.4.0 (Sidecar Stall Watchdog & Jailbreak-Free Rescue Loop) 1. **Dual-Source Fusion Stall Watchdog (5 Hooks + Sidecar + `transcript.jsonl` Self-Healing)**: - Added lightweight, fail-open `hooks/stop.mjs` (`Stop` hook in `hooks.json`) alongside `PreInvocation`, `PreToolUse`, and `PostToolUse` (now also covering `run_command` completion) writing direct-conversation-isolated execution leases (`watchdog_lease:`) into SQLite `meta` via ultra-lightweight `context/lib/watchdog-lease.js` (<1 ms load, 0-SQLite fast path preserved, 0-byte `stderr`). - Built `context/lib/watchdog.js` (`WatchdogMonitor`) running inside the persistent Aux Pane Sidecar (`sidecars/dashboard/server.mjs`): performs low-frequency polling with **zero `statSync` overhead when all conversations are `IDLE`**, **dual silence verification** (if `transcript.jsonl` `mtimeMs`/`size` is still growing, silence resets automatically), and **transcript tail self-healing** (detects completed/aborted terminal turns to heal missed `Stop` hooks without hiding newly hung turns). 2. **State-Aware Dynamic Timeout Matrix (Zero False Positives)**: - Distinguishes `IDLE`, `LLM_INFLIGHT` (`<120k` normal `120s`, `>=120k` or `/compact` `240s`, `>=150k` multimodal `360s`), `TOOL_RUNNING` (`read_file`/fast MCP `90s` vs sync `run_command`/`ctx_execute`/`run_checks` `300s`), and `SUBAGENT_BG` (async background tasks/subagents `600s`) with two-tier **yellow (`suspect`, 60%) → red (`stalled`, 100%)** alerting, all configurable via `~/.agy-dart/config.json` and `AGY_DART_WATCHDOG_*` env vars. 3. **Jailbreak-Free Rescue Loop & Engineering Safeguards**: - Auto-pre-generates a redacted **Rescue Handoff Brief** (`context/lib/handoff.js` `stallContext` snapshot: phase, silent duration, last tool/command, last user input, suspected root cause, modified files, last test/build & FTS5 handles) and surfaces **1–2 targeted troubleshooting steps** across 6 attribution buckets (`auto_compact_deadlock`, `terminal_eof_or_interactive`, `mcp_tool_blocked`, `host_tool_blocked`, `subagent_or_bg_stalled`, `oauth_ghost_or_network`) inside the Sidecar Watchdog card (with 1s local silence timer, Snooze/Mark-Idle actions, and opt-in debounced OS desktop notifications — **OFF by default**). - Hardened with **Sleep Drift Guard** (lid-close / OS suspend wall-vs-monotonic clock jump compensation), strict multi-session & subagent isolation, Sidecar restart cleanup of stale prior-app leases, `POST`-only CSRF-hardened `/api/watchdog` & `/api/watchdog/action` endpoints, zero CDP access, and zero host process killing. ## What's New in v1.3.1 (Long-Horizon & Zero-Latency Compaction Hardening) 1. **Zero-Latency Compaction Detection & Same-Turn Invalidation**: - Unified 4 compaction/pruning signals into `cache-analyzer.js` (`latestCompactionEvent` + `inspectTranscriptCompaction`): severe `compaction_or_truncation` bust, decoupled context shrink (even alongside `model_switch` or mild selective pruning `>= 15%` & `>= 8k` tokens from `>= 12k`), explicit compaction/summary steps, and `/compact` user commands. - Upgraded `PreInvocation` to react immediately to `/compact` `lastUserInput` (idempotent across `invocationNum >= 1` mid-turn tool loops) and `initialNumSteps` rollbacks; added a zero-normal-overhead slow-path check in `PreToolUse` (`statSync` size/mtime fast-skip + 128 KB tail scan) that catches silent auto-compaction on the very first post-compaction `read_file` call (0 wasted turns while preserving files newly read after the compaction step via `invalidateFileReadsBefore`). 2. **Full-Scope Turn Decay, Small-File Anti-Backfire Threshold & Failure Error Anchors**: - Added turn-based `readDedup` decay (`readDedupMaxTurns: 12`, `AGY_DART_READ_DEDUP_MAX_TURNS`, `file_reads.read_turn_seq`) driven by `PreInvocation` even when payloads omit `stepIdx`, plus automatic allow on `stepIdx` / `turnSeq` rollback. - Raised minimum `readDedup` threshold to configurable **`4096 B` (4 KB)** (`readDedupMinBytes`, `AGY_DART_READ_DEDUP_MIN_BYTES`) evaluated against the **actual requested slice size** (preventing 2-strike backfire on small configs or 15-line slices) and added isolated `dedup_bypass` telemetry in `featureRoi.features.read_dedup`. - Upgraded `hooks/filter-rules.mjs` with `compactFailureWithErrorAnchors` so oversized (`> 7.9 KB`) failing command outputs preserve head/tail summaries plus `±3`-line context around middle-of-log error anchors (`AssertionError`, `Traceback`, `ERROR`, `✖`, `not ok`, etc.) within `<= 7.9 KB` (`<= 8.8 KB` total), reducing extra `ctx_search` round-trips. ## What's New in v1.3.0 1. **4-Tier Host-Aligned Read Guard & Review Workflow First-Class Support**: - Aligned default source-file cutoff to **`45 KiB` (`46,080 B` / `<= 800` lines, `host-45k` mode)** matching Antigravity's native `read_file` cap with **2-strike soft guard** (5-branch session/subagent/anonymous TTL key isolation) so large source files and MCP-less subagents never deadlock, while keeping high-noise logs/locks/minified bundles at **`16 KB`** (`noiseMaxReadBytes`) and `.patch`/`.diff` code-review files at **`128 KB`** (`reviewMaxReadBytes`) with native `ByteOffset` / open-ended `StartLine` pagination continuation. - **Access-Control, SSRF, ReDoS & Windows Shell Fidelity**: Enforced end-to-end `sensitiveFileGuard=deny` (including symlinked files, `.envrc`/`*.env`, and `\\?\` ADS paths) across `PreToolUse`, `fast/mcp-server.mjs`, `ctx_index`, and `ctx_execute` (`P1-03`); forced `-n` on `git remote show` to block network SSRF (`P1-04`); hardened `install.mjs` against internal symlinks/NTFS junctions, UNC shares, and `.git` clones/worktrees while supporting self-`uninstall` (`P1-05`/`P1-06`); respected per-directory `PATHEXT` precedence and PowerShell `,`/`--`/`"` safety in `cli-filter` (`P1-07`); and capped serialized `fast` JSON-RPC payloads `<= 8.8 KB` with mixed `\n\n`/`\r\n\r\n` frame safety, dangling-symlink rollback, and bounded glob/regex/Markdown linear parsers (`P1-09`–`P1-13`). - Cross-call `(mtimeMs, size)` LRU caches in `agy-dart_fast` for both `read_slices({ outlines })` (128 entries) and `read_slices({ slices })` (bounded <= 4 MB total / <= 256 KB per file, actively invalidated by `apply_edits`). 4. **Security Hardening & DB Maintenance**: - SSRF-hardened `ctx_index(url)` (`http:`/`https:` whitelist, max 5 redirects with relative `Location` resolution, per-hop DNS & IPv4/IPv6 private/loopback/link-local blocking with DNS pinning), configurable secret redaction before indexing/return (`AGY_DART_DISABLE_SECRET_REDACTION=1` to opt out), and optional sensitive-file read guard (`AGY_DART_SENSITIVE_FILE_GUARD=warn|deny`). - Heading-aware Markdown chunking, SHA-256 content dedup, daily TTL pruning, `ctx_purge({ scope: "stale", vacuum: true })`, and one-click **Prune & Vacuum** in the Sidecar Dashboard. --- ## Community Feedback & Improvements This dedicated section tracks real-world friction reported by the community (preserving the original feedback), along with the exact engineering fixes and underlying design principles shipped in response. ### `[v1.5.0]` 15-Minute Idle KV-Cache Expiry vs. Automatic Keep-Alive Pings #### 1. Original Community Feedback > *"`@billy88lsh`: Looking at my records, my cache hit rate is 97%. Your problem is that you keep timing out — once past 15 minutes the cache is gone. The way to improve it is to have the program automatically ping/activate the cache after each turn."* > > *(Original Chinese: 「@billy88lsh: 我看的记录，我的缓存是97。你的问题是你总是超时，超过15分钟就缓存没了。提升的办法就是回答完一轮，程序自动激活一下缓存」)* Auditing both Antigravity's plugin sandbox boundaries and prompt-cache billing math clarified why idle timeouts dominate average hit-rate drops — and why blind auto-pinging backfires: 1. **Hard 300s static profile TTL missed real ~15m server windows**: `v1.4.x` defaulted Gemini 3/4 and unknown tiers to `300s` (5m) and forgot empirical calibration on every new conversation, causing premature expiry warnings and zero downward adaptation when backend LRU windows shrank. 2. **Plugin-layer auto-keep-alive is impossible without prefix/UI pollution**: Server KV-cache keys bind to the host's full raw request prefix (hidden system prompt, tool schemas, thinking signatures, auth routing). `Stop` hooks are synchronous (`5s` cap), Sidecars lack silent 1-token RPCs, and synthetic messages pollute history and violate zero-prefix-pollution invariants. 3. **Narrow break-even & Goodhart's Law**: Each keep-alive ping still pays `0.10x`–`0.25x` cached-read cost + output/thinking/request quota. 10 pings at 90% discount (or 4 at 75% discount) already cost as much as a full cold re-prefill, and walk-away sessions burn 100% wasted quota while artificially inflating apparent hit-rate metrics. #### 2. Solution Shipped (`v1.4.x` → `v1.5.0`) | Area | Before (`v1.4.x`) | After (`v1.5.0`) | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **TTL Estimation** | Static `300s` reset on every new conversation; upward-only single-session floor | **Cross-Session Per-Model Calibration (`ttl_calibration:v1:`)**: 14-day bounded ring buffer of warm lower bounds & pure-idle cold upper bounds (`estimateCalibratedTtl`), bidirectional downward convergence, `explicit > session/history > profile` precedence | | **Idle Expiry Awareness** | Only in-pane countdown bar; missed when user switches apps | **Opt-In High-Context TTL Desktop Alert**: `ttlDesktopNotify` (`>= 60k` tokens, `(0, 60s]` lead window, debounced 1x per idle anchor + 60s global cooldown, **0 `statSync`**, sleep-jump guarded, works even with `stallWatchdog=false`) | | **Keep-Alive Economics** | No way to test whether auto-pinging saves or wastes money on real usage | **`cache:simulate` Keep-Alive Replay**: Added `keepalive-1x` & `keepalive-unlimited` (`--keepalive-tail `, `hypothetical: true`), reporting both apparent `projectedHitRate` and `userTurnHitRate` plus wasted walk-away pings | ### `[v1.4.0]` Multi-Turn Silent Hang ("Working Forever With Zero Output") #### 1. Original Community Feedback > *"After multiple turns of conversation, it very easily stays 'working' forever without outputting anything and just freezes — isn't there an automatic summarization/compaction feature?"* > > *(Original Chinese: 「我在多轮对话之后很容易一直工作中却不输出任何东西，直接卡住了，难道没有自动总结压缩的功能么？」)* Analyzing Antigravity's multi-turn execution lifecycle revealed **4 distinct real-world hang modes** that all look identical in the UI (an endless spinner with zero streamed output): 1. **High-context / background auto-compaction deadlock**: At `>= 120k` tokens (or `>= 150k` with images), silent auto-compaction or cold prefill can hang indefinitely with no user-visible timeout or progress bar. 2. **Windows terminal EOF / interactive prompt blocking**: A synchronous `run_command` waiting on `[y/N]`, a pager (`less`/`more`), or a Windows PowerShell/CMD stdin EOF never finishes and blocks the entire turn. 3. **OAuth Ghost Session / proxy disconnect**: Silent network drops or stale OAuth sessions leave the request spinning at 0 streamed bytes. 4. **Blocked MCP tool call**: A wedged MCP server leaves the agent waiting indefinitely while the user has no visibility into which phase or tool actually froze. #### 2. Solution Shipped (`v1.3.x` → `v1.4.0`) | Area | Before (`v1.3.x`) | After (`v1.4.0`) | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Execution Visibility** | No active turn/tool state tracking; users stare at an endless spinner | **Dual-Source Fusion State Machine**: `PreInvocation` / `PreToolUse` / `PostToolUse` (`+run_command`) / `Stop` hooks write per-conversation leases (`watchdog_lease:`) into SQLite `meta`, fused with Sidecar `transcript.jsonl` `mtimeMs`/`size` & tail self-healing | | **Stall Detection** | None (or naive flat timer prone to false alarms on long builds / 150k turns) | **State-Aware Dynamic Timeout Matrix**: `IDLE` (0 `statSync`) · `LLM_INFLIGHT` (`<120k` 120s / `>=120k` or `/compact` 240s / `>=150k` multimodal 360s) · `TOOL_RUNNING` (`read_file`/fast MCP 90s vs sync `run_command`/`ctx_execute` 300s) · `SUBAGENT_BG` (600s), yellow `suspect` + red `stalled`, dual-silence growth extension | | **Recovery Workflow** | Manual guesswork; stopping a hung turn risks losing context & progress | **Jailbreak-Free Rescue Loop**: Entering red `stalled` auto-pre-generates a redacted **Rescue Handoff Brief** (phase, silent duration, last tool/command, last user input, git diff stat, checkpoint & FTS5 handles) + 1–2 root-cause tips across 6 causes, 1s local Sidecar timer, Snooze/Mark-Idle, and opt-in debounced desktop notify (OFF by default) | | **Robustness & Security** | N/A | **Sleep Drift Guard** (lid-close/suspend jump compensation), multi-session & subagent isolation, Sidecar restart stale-lease cleanup, `hookMode: true` fail-open, `POST`-only CSRF-hardened `/api/watchdog*`, zero CDP, zero host process killing | #### 3. Underlying Design Principles 1. **Sidecar Watchdog + Lifecycle Hooks beats fragile CDP/process-killing**: Injecting into the host via CDP or force-killing `language_server` risks corrupting active trajectories and breaks across Antigravity updates. Running a zero-dependency monitor inside the existing `restart_policy: always` Sidecar + fail-open hooks is 100% jailbreak-free and leaves cancellation firmly under user control. 2. **Never alert on one noisy signal alone**: Hooks alone can miss a `Stop` event; `transcript.jsonl` alone doesn't distinguish `IDLE` from a silent Turn-1 hang. Fusing SQLite leases with transcript growth checks and timestamp-guarded tail self-healing achieves both zero false alarms on active streaming and instant self-healing on missed `Stop` hooks. 3. **Separate hook hot-path latency from Sidecar analytics**: Splitting ultra-lightweight `watchdog-lease.js` (<1 ms load) from `watchdog.js` keeps `PreToolUse` 0-SQLite fast paths and latency budgets untouched while giving Sidecar full transcript/handoff/attribution richness. 4. **Zero background disk I/O when idle & immune to laptop sleep**: When all conversations are `IDLE`, `WatchdogMonitor.tick()` executes zero `statSync` calls; when a laptop resumes from sleep, wall-vs-monotonic clock drift detection automatically compensates active leases instead of firing false red alerts. ### `[v1.3.0]` 16 KB Default Read Guard Blocking Code Review (`.patch`) & MCP-less Subagents #### 1. Original Community Feedback > *"Claude doesn't have this limit — it reads large files in chunks without stopping. This 16 KB limit isn't built into Antigravity either; it's a pre-read check (`agy-dart protection`) from your local config. `.patch` files get rejected directly because a single patch easily exceeds 16 KB and fails under the default config, so I fell back to `AGY_DART_DISABLE_READ_HOOK=1`."* > > *(Original Chinese: 「@xcq: 我是让他做我工作流的 reviewer，会碰到这种情况，git 的 patch 文件直接拒绝读写，因为单个 patch 文件随便就超过 16kb 了碰到现在的默认设置就会失败，我走了 `AGY_DART_DISABLE_READ_HOOK=1`」)* *(Note: `agy-dart` never restricts writes—only pre-read guards—but blocking `.patch` reads is enough to stall a review workflow.)* End-to-end codebase auditing against these reports exposed **5 deeper root causes in `v1.2.2`**: 1. **Permanent hard-deny at 35% of the host's native cap**: Antigravity's native `read_file` already caps each call at `46,080 B` (45 KiB) / 800 lines with native pagination, yet `v1.2.2` inherited a 16 KB hard-deny with no 2-strike bypass (unlike `read-dedup` and `diff-read` in the same file). 2. **Valid host pagination blocked by the hook itself**: `ByteOffset` was parsed *after* the size guard, open-ended `StartLine` continuations hit `isWideRange`, and wide multi-line prose/logs exceeding 36 KB were mislabeled as `"giant single-line/minified content"`. 3. **Broken code-review fallback chain**: `agy-dart_fast` `read_slices({ outlines })` had no `.patch`/`.diff` parser, while `filterGitDiff` stripped all `' '` context lines from `git diff` and `gh pr diff` (and `filterGhCli` wiped `gh pr view` metadata whenever a PR body contained a Markdown diff fence). 4. **MCP-less subagent deadlock (same class as upstream `context-mode#1311`)**: Reviewer/research subagents without `agy-dart_context` tools stalled when hard-denied with MCP-only instructions. 5. **Cross-channel coupling**: Text extension exemptions short-circuited before `readDedup`, and `run_command` (`cat`/`curl`) shared `maxReadBytes` and `exemptExtensions`, meaning disabling the read cutoff or adding exemptions could inadvertently punch holes through shell dump protection. #### 2. Solution Shipped (`v1.2.2` → `v1.3.0`) | Area | Before (`v1.2.2`) | After (`v1.3.0`) | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Read Threshold Model** | Flat `16 KB / 410 lines` permanent hard `deny` | **4-Tier Risk Model + 2-Strike Soft Guard (default `host-45k`)**:
• Tier 0 (attachments / instructions / binaries): 0-SQLite allow
• Tier 1 (high-noise logs / lockfiles / minified): **`16 KB`** (`noiseMaxReadBytes`)
• Tier 2 (source code / docs): **`45 KiB` (`46,080 B`) / 800 lines** + 2-strike
• Tier 3 (`.patch` / `.diff` review): **`128 KB`** (`reviewMaxReadBytes`) direct allow, 2-strike above | | **Pagination & Anti-Deadlock** | Blocked `ByteOffset` & open-ended `StartLine`; stalled MCP-less subagents | Pre-guard `ByteOffset` remaining-bytes check & valid continuation allow; split minified vs wide multi-line slices (computing `suggestedLines`); 5-branch session/subagent/anonymous TTL isolation + pre-1a read-cache priority (eliminates 3-strike trap); subagent 2-strike native fallback | | **Channel Decoupling & Security** | Exemptions skipped `readDedup` & leaked into `cat`/`curl` | `read_file` size exemptions skip Section 1a only (**preserving `readDedup`/`diffRead`**); `run_command` uses independent `shellDumpMaxBytes = 16 KB` with `exemptExtensions` removed; `realpathSync` symlink checks & strict integer `parseLineArg` | | **First-Class Code Review** | No `.patch` outliner; `git diff` stripped context | Native zero-dep `.patch`/`.diff` parser (`extractDiffSymbols`) in `read_slices({ outlines })`; **3-stage context-preserving `filterGitDiff`** inside `<= 7.9 KB` (lossless within budget → `-U`/`-W` preserved cap → 1-line context before compact `+/-`) + fixed `gh pr view` detection | | **Trusted Config & Upgrade** | Required `AGY_DART_DISABLE_READ_HOOK=1` | `~/.agy-dart/config.json` adds `readGuardMode` (`soft`/`strict`/`off`), per-tier cutoffs, `exemptExtensions`, and linear ReDoS-proof `exemptPaths`; `cutoff:source` migrates legacy `16384` default to `46080` while preserving user-chosen cutoffs | #### 3. Underlying Design Principles 1. **Align with the host's physical ceiling to eliminate negative-ROI blocks**: Because Antigravity's host `read_file` already caps single responses at `46,080 B` (~11.5K tokens) / 800 lines, hard-blocking `16 KB–45 KiB` files saves minimal tokens while paying an extra full-prefix LLM round trip (negative ROI). Aligning source defaults to `45 KiB` guarantees 1-turn lossless reads below the cap and intervenes only when multi-turn paging is actually unavoidable. 2. **Tier by signal-to-noise ratio and reading mode, not flat file size**: Logs, lockfiles, and minified bundles rarely benefit from sequential reading (`ctx_execute` cuts >90%, keeping `16 KB`); source code aligns to `45 KiB`; sequential code-review `.patch`/`.diff` files need linear inspection to catch logic bugs (`128 KB` direct allow + native Diff Outline above). 3. **Soft 2-strike guardrails over permanent deadlocks**: Hooks cannot assume every subagent has MCP tools. A 2-strike retry path (bounded by the host's 45 KiB ceiling) preserves Turn-1 guidance while guaranteeing zero deadlocks—backed by 5-branch TTL key isolation, TTL refresh across continuation pages, and read-cache priority so retries never loop into 3-strike chains. 4. **Strictly decouple host-capped channels from uncapped channels**: `read_file` has a 45 KiB host cap, whereas `cat`, `curl`, and `git diff` do not. Relaxing `read_file` must never relax shell dump guards (`shellDumpMaxBytes`) or bypass `cli-filter.mjs` via `skipFlags` (which would expose unbounded 5 MB diffs without secret redaction), and skipping first-read size checks must never disable `readDedup`. 5. **Preserve the security threat model**: `exemptPaths` and `exemptExtensions` are loaded exclusively from trusted user-level `~/.agy-dart/config.json` and env vars (never from untrusted repo configs), run strictly after `sensitiveFileGuard`, validate symlink targets via `fs.realpathSync`, and use linear segment matching to eliminate ReDoS. ### `[v1.2.2]` Premature Handoffs & Interrupted Long-Running Tasks #### 1. Original Community Feedback > *"After enabling dart (`agy-dart`), it becomes very hard to run long tasks — it automatically hands off within a very short time."* > > *(Original Chinese: 「使用了dart之后，就很难进行长任务了，会自动在很短的时间内交接」)* Auditing Antigravity's executor loop alongside `v1.2.1` revealed that "premature automatic handoffs" reflected both **early turn termination yielding control back to the user** and **frequent `Handoff Brief` / `/compact` banners firing after just a few minutes**, driven by **5 concrete root causes**: 1. **Imperative phase-boundary `/compact` rule inducing self-handoffs**: `rules/AGENTS.md` instructed the agent to *"compact at cold/phase boundaries then call `ctx_resume`"*. Because `/compact` is a UI-only slash command that the model cannot invoke via tools, obedient models following `` stopped calling tools at the end of Phase 1 (within minutes) and handed control back to the user asking them to run `/compact`. 2. **Hardcoded `30s` MCP sandbox kill on long scripts**: While native `run_command` transitions seamlessly into asynchronous background tasks after `WaitMsBeforeAsync`, `ctx_execute` hardcoded a `30,000 ms` kill timer (`exitCode: 124`) with no timeout parameter (and `run_checks` defaulted to `60s`), killing long builds or batch scripts within 30–60s and forcing an error handoff. 3. **`PreToolUse.overwrite` friction with Terminal Sandbox & async background streams**: `cli-filter.mjs` buffered stdout/stderr until process exit (leaving `manage_task(status)` blank during background runs). Worse, under `Default`/`Auto` Terminal Sandbox presets, `~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-dart` sits outside the workspace mount—causing rewritten commands to fail inside the sandbox, request unsandboxed execution, and pause for manual user approval. 4. **Mid-turn tool-loop & 1M-window false `Handoff Brief` alerts**: `PreInvocation` did not distinguish user idle time from long tool/subagent execution gaps (`invocationNum >= 1`), firing 5-minute TTL handoff banners mid-task; meanwhile `ttlMinContext` was clamped via `Math.min(..., 60000)` to `60k`—just 6% of a 1M-token window. 5. **Unbounded `read-dedup` burning `MAX_INVOCATIONS` budget**: In deep 50+ step tasks, re-verifying a file read dozens of steps earlier still triggered a Strike-1 `deny`, consuming extra model invocations against the host's per-turn `MAX_INVOCATIONS` ceiling. #### 2. Solution Shipped (`v1.2.1` → `v1.2.2`) | Area | Before (`v1.2.1`) | After (`v1.2.2`) | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Phase-Boundary Rule (`AGENTS.md`)** | Imperative prompt to compact at cold/phase boundaries | **Strictly passive rule**: never pause mid-task to ask for `/compact`; keep long tasks continuous and call `ctx_resume` only after user compaction; route `>60s` & async commands to native `run_command` | | **MCP Sandbox Timeout** | Hardcoded `30s` kill in `ctx_execute` with no parameter | Raised default to **`120s`** (`execTimeoutMs`), exposed per-call `timeoutSec: 1..300`, and added explicit `timedOut: true` + native background `run_command` fallback guidance | | **Sandbox & Async Stream Bypass** | Rewrote async commands (buffering live logs); lacked sandbox read grant; orphan shells on kill | Bypass `cli-filter` when `WaitMsBeforeAsync <= 2000ms` (`cliFilterAsyncBypassMs`) or `IsDaemon: true`; attach read-only `permissionOverrides` (`read_file()`) on sync `overwrite`; full Windows `taskkill /T /F` & POSIX `detached` process-group teardown | | **Mid-Turn & 1M Watermark Alerts** | Fired TTL/handoff banners mid-loop and at `60k` on 1M models | Suppress idle TTL & cold-compact handoff banners during mid-turn tool loops (`invocationNum >= 1` & `diag.inToolLoop`); scale `ttlMinContext` to model `coldCompactTokens` (`60k` on 200k models, **`300k`** on 1M models) | | **Step-Decayed Read Dedup** | Session-wide dedup regardless of trajectory depth | Track `read_step` in `file_reads` and auto-allow re-reads after `readDedupMaxSteps` (default **`40` steps**), preserving `MAX_INVOCATIONS` budget in deep tasks | #### 3. Underlying Design Principles 1. **Never put user-only actions as imperative commands inside ``**: Antigravity injects `AGENTS.md` as highest-priority mandatory instructions. Because an agent cannot execute UI slash commands like `/compact`, any imperative to "compact at phase boundaries" forces compliant models to halt execution and hand off to the human. Framing compaction strictly as a post-hoc recovery hook (`ctx_resume` after user action) keeps multi-phase execution uninterrupted. 2. **Separate synchronous data filtering from asynchronous lifecycle management**: MCP `tools/call` is inherently synchronous and bounded by RPC/stream idle timeouts—ideal for `<=120s` sandbox data reduction (`ctx_execute`), whereas long builds, test suites, and daemons rely on Antigravity's native background task streaming (`manage_task`) and reactive wakeup. Routing by `WaitMsBeforeAsync <= 2000ms` and `>60s` preserves both fast inline filtering and multi-hour background durability. 3. **Least-privilege sandbox bridging (read-only code vs. isolated DB state)**: Mounting `~/.agy-dart` read-write into the Terminal Sandbox would let untrusted repo test scripts tamper with `context.db`. Granting only `read_file()` via `permissionOverrides` exposes immutable plugin JS so rewritten commands never trigger unsandboxed approval prompts, while `cli-filter.mjs` degrades gracefully in memory whenever SQLite writes are sandbox-restricted. 4. **Distinguish turn-entry user idle from mid-turn tool execution**: When `invocationNum >= 1` inside an active tool loop (`inToolLoop`), elapsed time since `lastPlannerAt` reflects a long tool or subagent run—not human inactivity—and the user cannot run `/compact` mid-turn anyway. Scaling `ttlMinContext` to `30%` of the active model's window (`coldCompactTokens`) keeps alerts meaningful across both 200k and 1M context models. 5. **Balance attention decay against `MAX_INVOCATIONS` step budgets**: Blocking duplicate reads within `<= 40` steps eliminates pure token waste, but 40+ steps into a complex refactor, re-reading a target file before editing prevents stale-context hallucinations without burning extra `deny`/retry turns. --- ## Credits & Open-Source Inspirations `agy-dart` is 100% MIT-licensed with zero runtime npm dependencies (full upstream
