# agy-dart **Save tokens · Improve cache hits · Keep cache warm automatically · Protect context quota · Rescue crashed sessions** No extra dependencies · Works automatically in the background · Built-in side panel [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-10b981.svg)](LICENSE) [![Node.js 22.16+ (22.x) or 24+](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-22.16%2B_(22.x)_or_24%2B-38bdf8.svg)](package.json) [![Security Policy](https://img.shields.io/badge/Security-Policy-818cf8.svg)](SECURITY.md) [![Glama MCP](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/zou172866/agy-dart/badges/score.svg)](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/zou172866/agy-dart) [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · English · [How to Install](#how-to-install) · [Changelog](#changelog) · [Security](SECURITY.md) · [Third-Party Notices](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)

--- ## What does this plugin do? Reduces repeated reads and large tool results, shows prompt-cache usage, and helps you resume work in a new chat when a session fills up or stalls. Once installed, it runs automatically in the background — no new commands to learn, just chat and code as usual: ### 1. Combine actions When the AI needs to search several terms, it runs them in one batch; when it edits multiple files, it edits them together and runs tests in the same step instead of resending your full chat context across half a dozen turns. ### 2. Block noise If a test run prints 3,000 lines of logs, the plugin passes only the lines that matter to the AI (e.g., line 42 failed, the other 199 passed) and stores the full log locally for lookup. On multi-thousand-line code files, it pulls the outline first and reads only the target lines. ### 3. Cache monitoring and optional keepalive The plugin keeps prompt headers steady and avoids repeated reads of unchanged files. Automatic keepalive and desktop expiry alerts start off. If you enable keepalive, the initial limit is one ping per chat until your next message. You can change the limit in the panel. ### 4. Side panel & crash/hang rescue The right-sidebar panel shows: remaining context space, minutes until cache expiry, and total noise blocked. With multiple project windows open, if a background window is nearly out of context or stuck spinning with zero output, a desktop popup names that exact project and chat — click the popup to jump straight there. If a session crashes from blown-out context or hangs completely, click once in the panel to copy a progress summary and paste it into a new chat to continue. ### Other built-in features 1. **Restore context clues after `/compact`**: Records modified files, latest test/build pass status, and saved reference IDs in the background so the AI can pick back up right after `/compact`. 2. **Local search for long docs & web pages**: Stores multi-thousand-word docs or web pages by section in a local database and fetches only matching sections by keyword. 3. **Local script filtering for giant logs & tables**: On multi-MB logs, CSVs, or huge JSON dumps, the AI runs a short local script to compute counts or extract rows (e.g., top 5 failing endpoints) and returns only the result; large JSON outputs also surface error rows automatically. 4. **Workspace layout on new chats**: Supplies a compact directory, script, and core-file summary at the start of a new conversation. 5. **Loop warnings**: Shows a UI-only note (not injected into model context) when the AI repeats `edit → fail → revert → fail` cycles or calls the same tool with no progress. 6. **Secret masking & sensitive-file blocking**: Masks API keys and tokens in logs or fetched pages, blocks accidental reads of `.env` files when configured, and sandboxes read-only `git` queries against untrusted `.git/config` hooks. 7. **Hard 8.8 KB response cap with dynamic quota**: Antigravity spills tool outputs above ~10 KB into a temp file that costs an extra read turn; all plugin responses stay within 8.8 KB, dynamically giving short passing checks' unused space to failing stack traces. 8. **Detailed panel breakdown & offline simulation**: Inspect context usage across file reads, terminal output, and subagents, check 15-turn cache hit trends and miss causes, optionally read only changed lines after edits (off by default), or replay past chat history via CLI to measure cache hit rates and keepalive cost. > Antigravity updates frequently — click **Star** at the top right to follow compatibility updates. --- ## How to Install Use **Node.js 22.16.0 or later in the 22.x line, or Node.js 24 or later**. The installer checks that the built-in SQLite supports FTS5 with the trigram tokenizer. The plugin uses only built-in modules. ### Option 1: One-line terminal install (no clone needed) **Windows (PowerShell):** ```powershell irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zou172866/agy-dart/v1.7.0/install.ps1 | iex ``` **macOS / Linux:** ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zou172866/agy-dart/v1.7.0/install.sh | sh ``` ### Option 2: Let Antigravity install it Send this to Antigravity: ```text Clone tag v1.7.0 of https://github.com/zou172866/agy-dart.git to a temp folder, run `node scripts/install.mjs install` (add `--install-rg` on Windows if `rg` is missing), and confirm `doctor` passes. ``` ### Option 3: Clone & install with custom flags ```powershell git clone --branch v1.7.0 --depth 1 https://github.com/zou172866/agy-dart.git cd agy-dart # Windows PowerShell (optional -InstallRg auto-installs ripgrep) .\install.ps1 -InstallRg # macOS / Linux ./install.sh ``` **Other commands:** ```bash node scripts/install.mjs install # Global install (auto-syncs GEMINI_HOME & T3 ACP if present) node scripts/install.mjs install --project /repo/path # Single-project install node scripts/install.mjs doctor # Check install health node scripts/install.mjs uninstall # Uninstall ``` Restart or reload Antigravity after installing and open a new chat. User-created `rules/*.local.md` files inside the plugin directory are preserved across upgrades. If you previously installed standalone `agy-fast` or `antigravity-plugin-context-mode`, disable the old ones in your plugin list. Indexed content and usage history are stored locally in `~/.agy-dart/context.db` by default and survive uninstall. Before uninstalling, `ctx_purge` can clear the current chat's index. When the host omits a session ID, this covers anonymous data for the confirmed workspace. To clear indexed data and history across all projects, call `ctx_purge` with `scope: "all"`. Global uninstall also removes the Gemini/T3 copies recorded by the installer. If an older copy has no ownership record, the installer prints its location and a command for removing that copy explicitly. --- ## Settings Automatic cache keepalive is off by default. To opt in for one chat, turn on **Auto-Keepalive** in the **agy-dart Context** panel. **Global Warm** sets the default for chats without an override. Turning off warming for a chat silences its cache-expiry and keepalive-limit desktop alerts. Desktop alerts for stalled tasks default to off and can be enabled separately. Each keepalive requests an `OK` reply and consumes model input, including the full prompt on a cache miss. The panel also controls desktop alerts, protection, local cleanup, and file-size limits. Preset modes & tool-loading modes via CLI: ```bash node scripts/install.mjs mode host-45k # Default: direct read up to 45 KB code / 128 KB patches, block >16 KB noisy logs node scripts/install.mjs mode balanced-16k # Outline first above 16 KB node scripts/install.mjs mode fast-32k # Raise normal file limit to 32 KB node scripts/install.mjs mode strict-8k # Block above 8 KB node scripts/install.mjs mode no-read-hook # Never block file reads, only trim noisy terminal output node scripts/install.mjs tool-loading fast-eager # Default: 4 fast tools eager, 8 context tools lazy node scripts/install.mjs tool-loading lazy # All 12 tools lazy-loaded node scripts/install.mjs tool-loading eager # All 12 tools eager-loaded ``` --- ## Changelog ### v1.6.0 - **4 core fast tools preloaded directly, fixing occasional multi-file edit drops**: Batch search, outlines, multi-file edits, and concurrent checks now preload directly instead of going through the wrapper tool that occasionally emptied multi-file edit arrays; the other 8 large-log tools stay on-demand to save initial context (switchable via `tool-loading`). - **Fixed automatic cache keepalive & skipped all subagents**: Cleared legacy global-off state conflicts from old panel processes, added duplicate-send locks, and auto-restarts the background panel after plugin updates; subagents spawned by `/boost`, browser tasks, or workflows — plus closed chats — no longer trigger keepalives or take over the top keepalive bar. - **Direct file reads for subagents, plugin-folder write protection**: Background subagents can read large or repeated files directly without red-text blocks; calls missing a project path that land inside the installed plugin folder are blocked so the plugin never searches or edits its own files. - **One-line install without cloning**: Added single-line PowerShell and Shell install commands. - Cross-platform hook launcher; unused quota from short checks shifts to long error traces; read-only Git sandboxing against external `.git/config` hooks; clean Windows exit, preserved `rules/*.local.md` on upgrade, plus `SECURITY.md` and light/dark architecture diagrams. ### v1.5.4 - **Click alerts to jump to that chat**: Clicking a desktop popup or cross-window panel alert brings the matching project window to the front and opens that conversation; added a multi-window session switcher bar in the panel. - **Optional cache keepalive** sends a ping for primary chats shortly before expiry. The panel controls the per-chat limit. Your next message resets the count. - Moved current context usage, cache countdown, and blocked noise volume into a larger top card in the panel. ### v1.5.3 - **Project & chat titles on multi-window alerts**: Desktop popups and panel alerts show folder names (e.g., `work/agy-dart`) and short chat titles without exposing message text. - **"Context Almost Full" desktop alert**: Pops up once near the limit and resets after `/compact`. ### v1.5.2 - Faster file reads and chat startup; added code outlines for multi-thousand-line `.html` / `.astro` and `.dart` files; fixed Windows Python / PowerShell encoding garbling and paused panel refreshes while hidden. ### v1.5.1 - Filled in untranslated strings in Chinese UI mode; tuned post-edit file-limit suggestions. ### v1.5.0 - **Read actual model cache expiry time**: Reads the active model's real cache lifetime (such as 5m or 15m) from recent usage and carries it into new chats. - Added optional 1-minute cache-expiry desktop reminder and CLI keepalive cost simulation. ### v1.4.0 - **Hang detection & rescue summary**: Flags chats stuck spinning with zero output (ignoring long builds and laptop sleep), points to the stalled step in the panel, and prepares a one-click progress summary (modified files, last command, current step) to continue in a new chat. ### v1.3.1 - Allow immediate file re-reads right after `/compact`; skip dedup prompts on slices under 4 KB; preserve mid-log error lines in long failure outputs. ### v1.3.0 - **Tiered file-read limits**: Raised direct reads to 45 KB (800 lines) for normal code and 128 KB for `.patch` files while keeping noisy logs at 16 KB; second-try reads pass through so patch reviews and subagents don't stall. - Added `.patch` file outlines and kept context lines when trimming `git diff`. ### v1.2.2 - **Uninterrupted long tasks**: Removed mid-task `/compact` prompts and routed >60s builds, tests, and background servers straight to Antigravity's native background runner. - Blocked `.env` reads and fixed 42 Windows shell, isolation, and orphan-process issues. ### v1.2.1 - Automatic rollback on failed multi-file edits and 76 path/argument stability fixes. ### v1.2.0 - Unified settings in `~/.agy-dart/config.json`; added local panel request checks; **automatic structure, sample, and error extraction for huge JSON files**; added `gh`, `kubectl`, `terraform`, and `playwright` output trimming plus handoff summaries. ### v1.1.0 - **Automatic terminal output trimming**: Strips progress bars and repetitive noise from `git`, test, build, and install commands while saving full logs locally. - Unchanged-file duplicate-read protection, edit-fail loop notes, internal-URL SSRF blocking, log secret masking, and one-click panel cleanup. --- ## Local Checks ```bash npm test # Run full test suite npm run verify:pkg # Verify installer file list npm run prefix:budget # Estimate configured Antigravity startup and full-catalog token usage node scripts/cache-audit.mjs --workspace . --no-live npm run cache:simulate ``` --- ## Credits & License [MIT License](LICENSE). Incorporates and adapts MIT-licensed code from [INK-Q/agy-fast](https://github.com/INK-Q/agy-fast) and [Domush/antigravity-plugin-context-mode](https://github.com/Domush/antigravity-plugin-context-mode); full third-party notices are in [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md). ## v1.7 CLI Install for Antigravity by default. Select Claude Code or Codex explicitly with `--target claude|codex`. Use `outline ` for a compact signature map and `session ` or `compare ` for transcript usage. For Claude Code and Codex, the installer keeps hashes and undo metadata in `~/.agy-dart/-install.json` to restore the plugin's configuration changes. Reinstalling replaces an older full-config record. Uninstalling removes that host's record. ```sh git clone --branch v1.7.0 --depth 1 https://github.com/zou172866/agy-dart.git cd agy-dart node bin/agy-dart.mjs install node bin/agy-dart.mjs doctor ```

--- ## 这个 Google Antigravity 插件是干什么的？ `agy-dart` 是专为 **Google Antigravity** 打造的性能、缓存与上下文管理插件（同时支持通过 `--target` 安装到 Claude Code 与 Codex）：减少重复读取和过长的工具输出，查看缓存用量，会话占满上下文或卡住时可以把进度带到新对话。 装好之后在后台自动生效，不用记新命令，平时照常打字聊天就行： ### 1. 整合动作 AI 要搜好几个词时一次同时搜完，要改多个文件时一次改完并顺手跑完测试，少跑好几轮重复带上下文的请求。 ### 2. 挡住废话 跑一次测试吐出 3000 行日志，插件只挑关键那几句给 AI（比如第 42 行报错，其余 199 个通过），完整原文存进本地备查。遇到几千行的大代码文件，先拉目录再读要改的那几十行。 ### 3. 缓存监测与按需续温 插件保持提示前缀稳定，减少短时间内重复读取未修改的文件。自动续温和缓存到期桌面提醒默认关闭。首次开启续温时，每段对话最多自动请求 1 次，发新消息后重新计数。次数可在面板里调整。 ### 4. 右侧面板与崩溃/卡死抢救 右侧边栏面板直接显示：上下文还有多少、缓存还剩几分钟过期、挡掉了多少废话。 多开项目窗口时，哪个后台窗口上下文快满了，或者一直转圈不出字，右下角会弹窗标明是哪个窗口、哪段对话，点一下弹窗直接切过去。会话真因为爆上下文崩掉或卡死时，在面板点一下复制当前进度摘要，贴到新对话接着往下做。 ### 其他内置功能 1. **压缩对话（`/compact`）后恢复上下文线索**：后台记录本轮改过哪些文件、最近一次测试或打包过没过、存过哪些参考资料。跑完 `/compact` 后 AI 可以直接调出这份记录接着做。 2. **长文档与网页存本地检索**：几万字的开发文档或网页可以先按章节存进本地数据库，后面用到哪段按关键词搜哪段。 3. **大日志与大表格先在本地跑脚本筛选**：遇到几十 MB 的日志、CSV 或几万行 JSON，AI 可以在本地沙盒跑几行脚本先做统计（比如筛出报错最多的 5 个接口），只把算出来的结果发回对话；大 JSON 还会自动摘出报错的异常条。 4. **新对话自动附带目录结构**：刚开对话时自动给出一份精简的项目目录、脚本和核心文件清单。 5. **死循环提示**：AI 连续出现「改代码 → 报错 → 改回去 → 又报错」或反复调同一个工具没进展时，在聊天界面弹一行只给用户看的提示（不塞进模型上下文）。 6. **密钥打码、敏感文件与 Git 沙盒防护**：日志或网页里的 API Key、口令自动打码；可拦截 AI 误读 `.env` # agy-dart **Google Antigravity plugin — Save tokens · Improve KV-cache hits · Keep cache warm automatically · Protect context quota · Rescue crashed sessions** No extra dependencies · Works automatically in the background · Built-in Sidecar dashboard [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-10b981.svg)](LICENSE) [![Node.js 22.16+ (22.x) or 24+](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-22.16%2B_(22.x)_or_24%2B-38bdf8.svg)](package.json) [![Security Policy](https://img.shields.io/badge/Security-Policy-818cf8.svg)](SECURITY.md) [![Glama MCP](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/zou172866/agy-dart/badges/score.svg)](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/zou172866/agy-dart) [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · English · [How to Install](#how-to-install) · [Changelog](#changelog) · [Security](SECURITY.md) · [Third-Party Notices](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)

--- ## What does this Google Antigravity plugin do? `agy-dart` is a performance, KV-cache, and context-window plugin for **Google Antigravity** (also supports Claude Code and Codex via `--target`). It reduces repeated reads and large tool results, shows prompt-cache usage, and helps you resume work in a new chat when a session fills up or stalls. Once installed, it runs automatically in the background — no new commands to learn, just chat and code as usual: ### 1. Combine actions When the AI needs to search several terms, it runs them in one batch; when it edits multiple files, it edits them together and runs tests in the same step instead of resending your full chat context across half a dozen turns. ### 2. Block noise If a test run prints 3,000 lines of logs, the plugin passes only the lines that matter to the AI (e.g., line 42 failed, the other 199 passed) and stores the full log locally for lookup. On multi-thousand-line code files, it pulls the outline first and reads only the target lines. ### 3. Cache monitoring and optional keepalive The plugin keeps prompt headers steady and avoids repeated reads of unchanged files. Automatic keepalive and desktop expiry alerts start off. If you enable keepalive, the initial limit is one ping per chat until your next message. You can change the limit in the panel. ### 4. Side panel & crash/hang rescue The right-sidebar panel shows: remaining context space, minutes until cache expiry, and total noise blocked. With multiple project windows open, if a background window is nearly out of context or stuck spinning with zero output, a desktop popup names that exact project and chat — click the popup to jump straight there. If a session crashes from blown-out context or hangs completely, click once in the panel to copy a progress summary and paste it into a new chat to continue. ### Other built-in features 1. **Restore context clues after `/compact`**: Records modified files, latest test/build pass status, and saved reference IDs in the background so the AI can pick back up right after `/compact`. 2. **Local search for long docs & web pages**: Stores multi-thousand-word docs or web pages by section in a local database and fetches only matching sections by keyword. 3. **Local script filtering for giant logs & tables**: On multi-MB logs, CSVs, or huge JSON dumps, the AI runs a short local script to compute counts or extract rows (e.g., top 5 failing endpoints) and returns only the result; large JSON outputs also surface error rows automatically. 4. **Workspace layout on new chats**: Supplies a compact directory, script, and core-file summary at the start of a new conversation. 5. **Loop warnings**: Shows a UI-only note (not injected into model context) when the AI repeats `edit → fail → revert → fail` cycles or calls the same tool with no progress. 6. **Secret masking & sensitive-file blocking**: Masks API keys and tokens in logs or fetched pages, blocks accidental reads of `.env` files when configured, and sandboxes read-only `git` queries against untrusted `.git/config` hooks. 7. **Hard 8.8 KB response cap with dynamic quota**: Antigravity spills tool outputs above ~10 KB into a temp file that costs an extra read turn; all plugin responses stay within 8.8 KB, dynamically giving short passing checks' unused space to failing stack traces. 8. **Detailed panel breakdown & offline simulation**: Inspect context usage across file reads, terminal output, and subagents, check 15-turn cache hit trends and miss causes, optionally read only changed lines after edits (off by default), or replay past chat history via CLI to measure cache hit rates and keepalive cost. > Antigravity updates frequently — click **Star** at the top right to follow compatibility updates. --- ## How to Install Use **Node.js 22.16.0 or later in the 22.x line, or Node.js 24 or later**. The installer checks that the built-in SQLite supports FTS5 with the trigram tokenizer. The plugin uses only built-in modules. ### Option 1: One-line terminal install (no clone needed) **Windows (PowerShell):** ```powershell irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart/v1.7.1/install.ps1 | iex ``` **macOS / Linux:** ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart/v1.7.1/install.sh | sh ``` ### Option 2: Let Antigravity install it Send this to Antigravity: ```text Clone tag v1.7.1 of https://github.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart.git to a temp folder, run `node scripts/install.mjs install` (add `--install-rg` on Windows if `rg` is missing), and confirm `doctor` passes. ``` ### Option 3: Clone & install with custom flags ```powershell git clone --branch v1.7.1 --depth 1 https://github.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart.git cd Antigravity-agy-dart # Windows PowerShell (optional -InstallRg auto-installs ripgrep) .\install.ps1 -InstallRg # macOS / Linux ./install.sh ``` **Other commands:** ```bash node scripts/install.mjs install # Global install (auto-syncs GEMINI_HOME & T3 ACP if present) node scripts/install.mjs install --project /repo/path # Single-project install node scripts/install.mjs doctor # Check install health node scripts/install.mjs uninstall # Uninstall ``` Restart or reload Antigravity after installing and open a new chat. User-created `rules/*.local.md` files inside the plugin directory are preserved across upgrades. If you previously installed standalone `agy-fast` or `antigravity-plugin-context-mode`, disable the old ones in your plugin list. Indexed content and usage history are stored locally in `~/.agy-dart/context.db` by default and survive uninstall. Before uninstalling, `ctx_purge` can clear the current chat's index. When the host omits a session ID, this covers anonymous data for the confirmed workspace. To clear indexed data and history across all projects, call `ctx_purge` with `scope: "all"`. Global uninstall also removes the Gemini/T3 copies recorded by the installer. If an older copy has no ownership record, the installer prints its location and a command for removing that copy explicitly. --- ## Settings Automatic cache keepalive is off by default. To opt in for one chat, turn on **Auto-Keepalive** in the **agy-dart Context** panel. **Global Warm** sets the default for chats without an override. Turning off warming for a chat silences its cache-expiry and keepalive-limit desktop alerts. Desktop alerts for stalled tasks default to off and can be enabled separately. Each keepalive requests an `OK` reply and consumes model input, including the full prompt on a cache miss. The panel also controls desktop alerts, protection, local cleanup, and file-size limits. Preset modes & tool-loading modes via CLI: ```bash node scripts/install.mjs mode host-45k # Default: direct read up to 45 KB code / 128 KB patches, block >16 KB noisy logs node scripts/install.mjs mode balanced-16k # Outline first above 16 KB node scripts/install.mjs mode fast-32k # Raise normal file limit to 32 KB node scripts/install.mjs mode strict-8k # Block above 8 KB node scripts/install.mjs mode no-read-hook # Never block file reads, only trim noisy terminal output node scripts/install.mjs tool-loading fast-eager # Default: 4 fast tools eager, 8 context tools lazy node scripts/install.mjs tool-loading lazy # All 12 tools lazy-loaded node scripts/install.mjs tool-loading eager # All 12 tools eager-loaded ``` --- ## Changelog ### v1.7.1 - **Accurate "Guard Saved" accounting for `agy-dart_fast` tools**: `read_slices`, `run_checks`, and `batch_search` now record strictly non-inflated byte savings (only when raw input/output genuinely exceeds returned bytes) and attribute anonymous shared MCP calls cleanly to the active conversation without cross-session stealing. - **Expanded Windows / PowerShell CLI filtering**: `cli-filter` now recognizes leading package-manager flags (`npm --prefix`, `pnpm -C`, `yarn --cwd`, etc.) and safe `--` argument/path separators while preserving cross-shell safety guards. - **Complete MCP receipt claiming & subagent rollup**: Extended receipt claiming to `ctx_index` and `ctx_batch` alongside `ctx_execute`, synced `sources`/`chunks` ownership (`schema v155` + `idx_sources_origin_session`), and unified `rootSessionId` rollup so subagent savings roll up into parent conversation stats without double-counting. ### v1.7.0 - **Compact signature outlines & inline read-guard outlines**: Added compact function-signature outlines and inline line-number outlines when a large un-ranged file read is intercepted on first blind read. - **Multi-host CLI (`bin/agy-dart.mjs`) & scoped subagents**: Added `agy-dart` CLI with `--target claude|codex`, `outline`, `session`, and `compare` commands, shipped `dart-coder` / `dart-reviewer` role definitions, and hardened workspace isolation & Node.js 22.16+ / 24+ SQLite FTS5 checks. ### v1.6.0 - **4 core fast tools preloaded directly, fixing occasional multi-file edit drops**: Batch search, outlines, multi-file edits, and concurrent checks now preload directly instead of going through the wrapper tool that occasionally emptied multi-file edit arrays; the other 8 large-log tools stay on-demand to save initial context (switchable via `tool-loading`). - **Fixed automatic cache keepalive & skipped all subagents**: Cleared legacy global-off state conflicts from old panel processes, added duplicate-send locks, and auto-restarts the background panel after plugin updates; subagents spawned by `/boost`, browser tasks, or workflows — plus closed chats — no longer trigger keepalives or take over the top keepalive bar. - **Direct file reads for subagents, plugin-folder write protection**: Background subagents can read large or repeated files directly without red-text blocks; calls missing a project path that land inside the installed plugin folder are blocked so the plugin never searches or edits its own files. - **One-line install without cloning**: Added single-line PowerShell and Shell install commands. - Cross-platform hook launcher; unused quota from short checks shifts to long error traces; read-only Git sandboxing against external `.git/config` hooks; clean Windows exit, preserved `rules/*.local.md` on upgrade, plus `SECURITY.md` and light/dark architecture diagrams. ### v1.5.4 - **Click alerts to jump to that chat**: Clicking a desktop popup or cross-window panel alert brings the matching project window to the front and opens that conversation; added a multi-window session switcher bar in the panel. - **Optional cache keepalive** sends a ping for primary chats shortly before expiry. The panel controls the per-chat limit. Your next message resets the count. - Moved current context usage, cache countdown, and blocked noise volume into a larger top card in the panel. ### v1.5.3 - **Project & chat titles on multi-window alerts**: Desktop popups and panel alerts show folder names (e.g., `work/agy-dart`) and short chat titles without exposing message text. - **"Context Almost Full" desktop alert**: Pops up once near the limit and resets after `/compact`. ### v1.5.2 - Faster file reads and chat startup; added code outlines for multi-thousand-line `.html` / `.astro` and `.dart` files; fixed Windows Python / PowerShell encoding garbling and paused panel refreshes while hidden. ### v1.5.1 - Filled in untranslated strings in Chinese UI mode; tuned post-edit file-limit suggestions. ### v1.5.0 - **Read actual model cache expiry time**: Reads the active model's real cache lifetime (such as 5m or 15m) from recent usage and carries it into new chats. - Added optional 1-minute cache-expiry desktop reminder and CLI keepalive cost simulation. ### v1.4.0 - **Hang detection & rescue summary**: Flags chats stuck spinning with zero output (ignoring long builds and laptop sleep), points to the stalled step in the panel, and prepares a one-click progress summary (modified files, last command, current step) to continue in a new chat. ### v1.3.1 - Allow immediate file re-reads right after `/compact`; skip dedup prompts on slices under 4 KB; preserve mid-log error lines in long failure outputs. ### v1.3.0 - **Tiered file-read limits**: Raised direct reads to 45 KB (800 lines) for normal code and 128 KB for `.patch` files while keeping noisy logs at 16 KB; second-try reads pass through so patch reviews and subagents don't stall. - Added `.patch` file outlines and kept context lines when trimming `git diff`. ### v1.2.2 - **Uninterrupted long tasks**: Removed mid-task `/compact` prompts and routed >60s builds, tests, and background servers straight to Antigravity's native background runner. - Blocked `.env` reads and fixed 42 Windows shell, isolation, and orphan-process issues. ### v1.2.1 - Automatic rollback on failed multi-file edits and 76 path/argument stability fixes. ### v1.2.0 - Unified settings in `~/.agy-dart/config.json`; added local panel request checks; **automatic structure, sample, and error extraction for huge JSON files**; added `gh`, `kubectl`, `terraform`, and `playwright` output trimming plus handoff summaries. ### v1.1.0 - **Automatic terminal output trimming**: Strips progress bars and repetitive noise from `git`, test, build, and install commands while saving full logs locally. - Unchanged-file duplicate-read protection, edit-fail loop notes, internal-URL SSRF blocking, log secret masking, and one-click panel cleanup. --- ## Local Checks ```bash npm test # Run full test suite npm run verify:pkg # Verify installer file list npm run prefix:budget # Estimate configured Antigravity startup and full-catalog token usage node scripts/cache-audit.mjs --workspace . --no-live npm run cache:simulate ``` --- ## Credits & License [MIT License](LICENSE). Incorporates and adapts MIT-licensed code from [INK-Q/agy-fast](https://github.com/INK-Q/agy-fast) and [Domush/antigravity-plugin-context-mode](https://github.com/Domush/antigravity-plugin-context-mode); full third-party notices are in [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md). ## v1.7 CLI Install for Antigravity by default. Select Claude Code or Codex explicitly with `--target claude|codex`. Use `outline ` for a compact signature map and `session ` or `compare ` for transcript usage. For Claude Code and Codex, the installer keeps hashes and undo metadata in `~/.agy-dart/-install.json` to restore the plugin's configuration changes. Reinstalling replaces an older full-config record. Uninstalling removes that host's record. ```sh git clone --branch v1.7.1 --depth 1 https://github.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart.git cd Antigravity-agy-dart node bin/agy-dart.mjs install node bin/agy-dart.mjs doctor ```

多开项目窗口时，哪个后台窗口上下文快满了，或者一直转圈不出字，右下角会弹窗标明是哪个窗口、哪段对话，点一下弹窗直接切过去。会话真因为爆上下文崩掉或卡死时，在面板点一下复制当前进度摘要，贴到新对话接着往下做。 ### 其他内置功能 1. **压缩对话（`/compact`）后恢复上下文线索**：后台记录本轮改过哪些文件、最近一次测试或打包过没过、存过哪些参考资料。跑完 `/compact` 后 AI # agy-dart **Google Antigravity plugin — Save tokens · Improve KV-cache hits · Keep cache warm automatically · Protect context quota · Rescue crashed sessions** No extra dependencies · Works automatically in the background · Built-in Sidecar dashboard [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-10b981.svg)](LICENSE) [![Node.js 22.16+ (22.x) or 24+](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-22.16%2B_(22.x)_or_24%2B-38bdf8.svg)](package.json) [![Security Policy](https://img.shields.io/badge/Security-Policy-818cf8.svg)](SECURITY.md) [![Glama MCP](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/zou172866/agy-dart/badges/score.svg)](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/zou172866/agy-dart) [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · English · [How to Install](#how-to-install) · [Changelog](#changelog) · [Security](SECURITY.md) · [Third-Party Notices](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)

--- ## What does this Google Antigravity plugin do? `agy-dart` is a performance, KV-cache, and context-window plugin for **Google Antigravity** (also supports Claude Code and Codex via `--target`). It reduces repeated reads and large tool results, shows prompt-cache usage, and helps you resume work in a new chat when a session fills up or stalls. Once installed, it runs automatically in the background — no new commands to learn, just chat and code as usual: ### 1. Combine actions When the AI needs to search several terms, it runs them in one batch; when it edits multiple files, it edits them together and runs tests in the same step instead of resending your full chat context across half a dozen turns. ### 2. Block noise If a test run prints 3,000 lines of logs, the plugin passes only the lines that matter to the AI (e.g., line 42 failed, the other 199 passed) and stores the full log locally for lookup. On multi-thousand-line code files, it pulls the outline first and reads only the target lines. ### 3. Cache monitoring and optional keepalive The plugin keeps prompt headers steady and avoids repeated reads of unchanged files. Automatic keepalive and desktop expiry alerts start off. If you enable keepalive, the initial limit is one ping per chat until your next message. You can change the limit in the panel. ### 4. Side panel & crash/hang rescue The right-sidebar panel shows: remaining context space, minutes until cache expiry, and total noise blocked. With multiple project windows open, if a background window is nearly out of context or stuck spinning with zero output, a desktop popup names that exact project and chat — click the popup to jump straight there. If a session crashes from blown-out context or hangs completely, click once in the panel to copy a progress summary and paste it into a new chat to continue. ### Other built-in features 1. **Restore context clues after `/compact`**: Records modified files, latest test/build pass status, and saved reference IDs in the background so the AI can pick back up right after `/compact`. 2. **Local search for long docs & web pages**: Stores multi-thousand-word docs or web pages by section in a local database and fetches only matching sections by keyword. 3. **Local script filtering for giant logs & tables**: On multi-MB logs, CSVs, or huge JSON dumps, the AI runs a short local script to compute counts or extract rows (e.g., top 5 failing endpoints) and returns only the result; large JSON outputs also surface error rows automatically. 4. **Workspace layout on new chats**: Supplies a compact directory, script, and core-file summary at the start of a new conversation. 5. **Loop warnings**: Shows a UI-only note (not injected into model context) when the AI repeats `edit → fail → revert → fail` cycles or calls the same tool with no progress. 6. **Secret masking & sensitive-file blocking**: Masks API keys and tokens in logs or fetched pages, blocks accidental reads of `.env` files when configured, and sandboxes read-only `git` queries against untrusted `.git/config` hooks. 7. **Hard 8.8 KB response cap with dynamic quota**: Antigravity spills tool outputs above ~10 KB into a temp file that costs an extra read turn; all plugin responses stay within 8.8 KB, dynamically giving short passing checks' unused space to failing stack traces. 8. **Detailed panel breakdown & offline simulation**: Inspect context usage across file reads, terminal output, and subagents, check 15-turn cache hit trends and miss causes, optionally read only changed lines after edits (off by default), or replay past chat history via CLI to measure cache hit rates and keepalive cost. 9. **Complements Agent Skills & audits Skills prefix tax**: Works orthogonally alongside domain Agent Skills in Antigravity, Claude Code, and Codex — Skills guide task workflows while `agy-dart` handles low-level read guards, log filtering, and KV-cache hygiene underneath; run `node bin/agy-dart.mjs audit skills` to inspect Turn-0 frontmatter overhead and progressive-disclosure structure across installed skills. > Antigravity updates frequently — click **Star** at the top right to follow compatibility updates. --- ## How to Install Use **Node.js 22.16.0 or later in the 22.x line, or Node.js 24 or later**. The installer checks that the built-in SQLite supports FTS5 with the trigram tokenizer. The plugin uses only built-in modules. ### Option 1: One-line terminal install (no clone needed) **Windows (PowerShell):** ```powershell irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart/v1.7.2/install.ps1 | iex ``` **macOS / Linux:** ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart/v1.7.2/install.sh | sh ``` ### Option 2: Let Antigravity install it Send this to Antigravity: ```text Clone tag v1.7.2 of https://github.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart.git to a temp folder, run `node scripts/install.mjs install` (add `--install-rg` on Windows if `rg` is missing), and confirm `doctor` passes. ``` ### Option 3: Clone & install with custom flags ```powershell git clone --branch v1.7.2 --depth 1 https://github.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart.git cd Antigravity-agy-dart # Windows PowerShell (optional -InstallRg auto-installs ripgrep) .\install.ps1 -InstallRg # macOS / Linux ./install.sh ``` **Other commands:** ```bash node scripts/install.mjs install # Global install (auto-syncs GEMINI_HOME & T3 ACP if present) node scripts/install.mjs install --project /repo/path # Single-project install node scripts/install.mjs doctor # Check install health node scripts/install.mjs uninstall # Uninstall ``` Restart or reload Antigravity after installing and open a new chat. User-created `rules/*.local.md` files inside the plugin directory are preserved across upgrades. If you previously installed standalone `agy-fast` or `antigravity-plugin-context-mode`, disable the old ones in your plugin list. Indexed content and usage history are stored locally in `~/.agy-dart/context.db` by default and survive uninstall. Before uninstalling, `ctx_purge` can clear the current chat's index. When the host omits a session ID, this covers anonymous data for the confirmed workspace. To clear indexed data and history across all projects, call `ctx_purge` with `scope: "all"`. Global uninstall also removes the Gemini/T3 copies recorded by the installer. If an older copy has no ownership record, the installer prints its location and a command for removing that copy explicitly. --- ## Settings Automatic cache keepalive is off by default. To opt in for one chat, turn on **Auto-Keepalive** in the **agy-dart Context** panel. **Global Warm** sets the default for chats without an override. Turning off warming for a chat silences its cache-expiry and keepalive-limit desktop alerts. Desktop alerts for stalled tasks default to off and can be enabled separately. Each keepalive requests an `OK` reply and consumes model input, including the full prompt on a cache miss. The panel also controls desktop alerts, protection, local cleanup, and file-size limits. Preset modes & tool-loading modes via CLI: ```bash node scripts/install.mjs mode host-45k # Default: direct read up to 45 KB code / 128 KB patches, block >16 KB noisy logs node scripts/install.mjs mode balanced-16k # Outline first above 16 KB node scripts/install.mjs mode fast-32k # Raise normal file limit to 32 KB node scripts/install.mjs mode strict-8k # Block above 8 KB node scripts/install.mjs mode no-read-hook # Never block file reads, only trim noisy terminal output node scripts/install.mjs tool-loading fast-eager # Default: 4 fast tools eager, 8 context tools lazy node scripts/install.mjs tool-loading lazy # All 12 tools lazy-loaded node scripts/install.mjs tool-loading eager # All 12 tools eager-loaded ``` --- ## Changelog ### v1.7.2 - **Agent Skills progressive disclosure & prefix-tax audit**: Restructured `skills/agy-dart/` with on-demand `examples/` (`ctx_trace_summary.py`, `filters.json`) and `references/error-playbook.md` synced cleanly across Antigravity, Claude Code, and Codex; added `node bin/agy-dart.mjs audit skills` to inspect Turn-0 frontmatter tax and progressive-disclosure hygiene, and separated on-demand skill assets in `prefix:budget`. - added local panel request checks; **automatic structure, sample, and error extraction for huge JSON files**; added `gh`, `kubectl`, `terraform`, and `playwright` output trimming plus handoff summaries. ### v1.1.0 - **Automatic terminal output trimming**: Strips progress bars and repetitive noise from `git`, test, build, and install commands while saving full logs locally. - Unchanged-file duplicate-read protection, edit-fail loop notes, internal-URL SSRF blocking, log secret masking, and one-click panel cleanup. --- ## Local Checks ```bash npm test # Run full test suite npm run verify:pkg # Verify installer file list npm run prefix:budget # Estimate configured Antigravity startup and full-catalog token usage node scripts/cache-audit.mjs --workspace . --no-live node bin/agy-dart.mjs audit skills --workspace . # Audit Skills Turn-0 frontmatter tax & progressive disclosure npm run cache:simulate ``` --- ## Credits & License [MIT License](LICENSE). For Claude Code and Codex, the installer keeps hashes and undo metadata in `~/.agy-dart/-install.json` to restore the plugin's configuration changes. Uninstalling removes that host's record. ```sh git clone --branch v1.7.2 --depth 1 https://github.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart.git cd Antigravity-agy-dart node bin/agy-dart.mjs install node bin/agy-dart.mjs doctor ```

# AGY Market (`agy-market`)

The visual community plugin marketplace inside **Google Antigravity** — browse, search, inspect transparent capability badges, and one-click install language-agnostic Antigravity plugins from a zero-token Sidecar pane.

> **Repository Boundary**: This repository contains the `agy-market` Sidecar plugin, Windows lock-safe tarball installer, `npx agy-market` bootstrap CLI, and static web showcase (`site/`). To submit a plugin to the community catalog, open a Pull Request in **[`azwosile/agy-market-catalog`](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market-catalog)**.

---

## Quick Start

```powershell
# Build single-file Sidecar UI (sidecars/market_pane/index.html) & static showcase
npm run build

# Copy real plugin bundle into ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-market
npm run install:local

# Run installation health diagnostics
node ./bin/agy-market.mjs doctor

# Pack deterministic release tarball (dist/agy-market.tar.gz + .sha256)
npm run pack:release

# Run unit & cross-repository integration tests
npm test
```

### One-Line User Bootstrap

- **Node / npx**: `npx agy-market@latest`
- **Windows PowerShell (Zero npm)**: `irm https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market/releases/latest/download/install.ps1 | iex`
- **macOS / Linux Shell (Zero npm)**: `curl -fsSL https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market/releases/latest/download/install.sh | sh`

Once installed in Antigravity:
- Open Auxiliary Pane: `[AGY Market](sidecar://agy-market/market_pane/)`
- Manage Plugin: `[AGY Market](customization://agy-market)`

---

# AGY Market · 反重力插件市场 (`agy-market`) **Google Antigravity 零 Token 损耗可视化社区插件市场** 极光棱镜（Aurora Prism）液态玻璃界面 · 卡片原生启停滑块 · 5 层插件冲突雷达 · 智能重启提示 · 双通道中国镜像加速 · SHA-256 防篡改校验 **简体中文** · [English](README.en.md) · [提交插件到目录](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market-catalog) · [架构规范](AGENTS.md)
--- > **仓库边界说明**：本仓库（[`azwosile/agy-market`](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market)）包含 **AGY Market** 客户端 Sidecar 面板、Windows 锁安全安装器、`npx agy-market` 一行安装 CLI 与静态展示站（`site/`）。 > > 如需将你的插件收录至社区插件目录，请向 **[`azwosile/agy-market-catalog`](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market-catalog)** 提交单文件 YAML Pull Request。 --- ## ✨ 核心特性（v1.2.0 极光棱镜大改版） ### 1. 极光棱镜（Aurora Prism）视觉体验 - **零对话 Token 损耗**：采用纯 Antigravity 原生 `AUX_PANE` Sidecar 面板（`sidecars/market_pane/sidecar.json`），空闲时不注入任何常驻 MCP 工具，不消耗模型上下文预算。 - **流光展台与光学折射卡片**：顶部流光星云展台实时展示「已收录插件 / 运行中 / 可更新 / 冲突健康度」；每张卡片按分类赋予自适应色相光晕（`--card-accent`）、`1px` 镜面高光边与鼠标跟随微光（`--mx, --my`），同时完美适配暗色、亮色与半透明壁纸皮肤（如 Wallpaper Prism）。 - **双行优雅标题 + 一键直达 GitHub**：修复单行过早截断问题；点击探索卡片、已安装卡片或详情抽屉的**插件标题**可直接在新窗口打开对应 GitHub 仓库，点击卡片其余区域则展开详情抽屉。 - **开箱优先呈现简体中文文档**：详情抽屉请求 `/api/readme?id=...&locale=zh`，自动优先渲染目录源 `entriesZh` 或本地 `README.zh-CN.md` / `README.zh.md`，并在已安装卡片优先显示中文化简介。 - **告别隔离 iframe 无效死链**：彻底移除会被 Chromium 拦截的裸 `` 与 `` 链接；其他 Sidecar 插件的「面板」按钮升级为调用 `/preload.js` `window.sidecar.ui.toggleAuxPane`，并提供一键复制对话药丸兜底提示。 ### 2. 卡片底部原生「启用 / 禁用」安全停放仓滑块（Vault Parking） - **零改写 `config.json` 红线**：Antigravity 语言服务器对 `~/.gemini/config/config.json` 设有写保护。AGY Market 严守只读原则，永不改写 `config.json`，而是通过**安全停放仓（Vault Parking）**实现即时启停控制（`POST /api/toggle-plugin`）： - **滑向「禁用（OFF）」**：后端将 `~/.gemini/config/plugins/` 安全移入 `${PLUGIN_DATA}/disabled-plugins/`，宿主热监听约 1 秒内卸载对应 Skills / Rules / Hooks。 - **滑向「启用（ON）」**：后端将目录完整移回 `~/.gemini/config/plugins/` 并清理可能残留的 `"disabled": true`。 - **停放态持续可更新**：被禁用的插件仍保留在「已安装」与「探索」卡片中；对其执行版本更新时，会在 `disabled-plugins/` 内原位同步，绝不意外将其自动重新激活。 - **防误操作锁定**：`agy-market` 自身滑块保持常亮锁定（避免在市场面板内把自己停用断连）；`workspace`、`builtin` 及宿主手动禁用项显示只读锁定提示。 ### 3. 五层插件冲突与健康诊断中心（Conflict Radar） 顶部新增独立 **「冲突与诊断」** 标签页（`GET /api/conflicts`），一键执行零副作用只读体检并提供快速修复（`POST /api/fix-conflict`）： | 冲突层级 | 严重级别 | 检测内容 | 一键修复能力 | | :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- | | `duplicate-plugin-name` | 严重 | 跨 `workspace > global > builtin` 扫描重复 `plugin.json.name`，精确标出生效胜出方与被宿主静默丢弃的插件目录 | 一键双连字符隔离重命名（`--`） | | `windows-symlink-ignored` | 严重 | 检测 Windows 下 `~/.gemini/config/plugins/` 中被 `GetAllPlugins` 静默跳过的 NTFS Junction / 符号链接目录 | 一键实体化转为真实目录 | | `mcp-collision` | 严重 / 警告 | 检测重复 `_`、与用户全局 `mcp_config.json` 重名或裸通用服务名（如 `search`、`db`、`fetch`） | 定位冲突键名与来源文件 | | `skill-shadowing` / `agent-shadowing` | 警告 | 检测已启用插件之间的 `skills/*/SKILL.md`、`agents/*.md` 与用户全局目录或内置保留名的覆盖链 | 完整展示胜出/被覆盖链路 | | `host-enhancement-overlap` | 提示 | 检测多个已启用插件同时包含 `app-asar` 或 `cdp` 宿主增强（如旧版壁纸插件与新版皮肤并存） | 提示评估是否停用其一 | ### 4. 智能「免重启 / 需重开面板 / 需重启」生效引擎 安装、更新、批量更新或切换启停滑块后，依据插件能力与实时文件锁状态自动分级提示： - **`⚡ 免重启 · 即刻生效`（`instant`）**：纯声明式 Skills / Subagents（`declarative-only`）或全局规则（`global-rules`）。 - **`🔄 建议重开面板 / 刷新 MCP`（`reload-pane`）**：含 Sidecar 界面（`sidecar-ui`）、MCP 服务（`mcp-stdio` / `mcp-remote`）或生命周期钩子（`lifecycle-hooks`）。 - **`🚀 需重启 Antigravity 生效`（`host-restart`）**：含 `app.asar` 界面补丁、首次配置 `cdp` 调试端口的宿主增强插件，或 Windows 后台进程占用 `.exe`/`.node`/`.dll` 句柄触发了安全退避重命名（`*.old.`）。 ### 5. 内置 GitHub Discussions 社区讨论 - 插件详情抽屉内置 **「讨论」** 标签页（`GET /api/discussions`），无需登录或 Token 即可自动探测目标仓库是否开启 GitHub Discussions，并提供一键直达讨论区与发帖入口。 - 如在面板设置中可选填入个人 GitHub Token（仅以 `0600` 权限保存在本地 `prefs.json`，绝不写入缓存文件或日志），即可在侧栏直接拉取并浏览该插件最新 10 条社区讨论。 ### 6. 双通道中国大陆镜像加速与 SHA-256 防篡改校验 - **三级目录源自动解析（零内置陈旧快照）**： 1. **自定义团队/个人源**：优先合并 `prefs.json` 中配置的静态 `index.json` 订阅源。 2. **全球主通道（GitHub Pages + `gh-pages` Raw 回退）**：支持 `ETag`（`If-None-Match`）/ `If-Modified-Since` 条件请求，`304 Not Modified` 毫秒级复用本地缓存。 3. **中国大陆自动镜像回退**：主源超时（`> 3.5s`）或不可达时，自动切换拉取纯 JSON 数据包 `@agy-market/catalog`（依次尝试 `registry.npmmirror.com` 与 `mirrors.cloud.tencent.com/npm`），在内存流式解包目录索引；完全离线时自动降级为本地磁盘缓存。 - **语言无关 & 防篡改下载**：`@agy-market/catalog` 仅将 npm 用作高可用静态 JSON CDN，被收录的插件**无需是 npm 包或 JS 项目**。支持配置自定义 GitHub Release 镜像加速前缀，所有 `.tar.gz` 安装包在解压前都会强制比对目录源权威 `sha256`，任何字节差异立即触发 `INTEGRITY_SHA256_MISMATCH` 中止安装。 --- ## 🚀 一行快速安装 > 运行环境要求：**Node.js >= 22.0.0**（零外部 npm 运行时依赖）；或使用下方免 npm 系统脚本。 ### 方式一：Node / `npx`（推荐，全平台通用） ```bash npx agy-market@latest ``` ### 方式二：Windows PowerShell（免 npm，内置 SHA-256 校验与目录回退） ```powershell irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/azwosile/agy-market/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex ``` ### 方式三：macOS / Linux Shell（免 npm，内置 SHA-256 校验与目录回退） ```sh curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/azwosile/agy-market/main/scripts/install.sh | sh ``` ### 安装后如何在 Antigravity 中打开？ - 在 Antigravity 对话中发送「打开插件市场」，或点击聊天药丸：`[AGY Market](sidecar://agy-market/market_pane/)` - 也可直接点击右侧辅助面板顶部 **`+` → `Plugins` → `AGY Market`** 打开。 - 如需在 Antigravity 原生定制页管理本插件，可点击对话药丸：`[AGY Market](customization://agy-market)` --- ## 🏷️ 透明能力徽章与升级安全守卫 所有插件在点击「安装」前都会展示静态扫描生成的透明能力徽章，无隐藏权限： | 徽章标识 | 默认中文标签 | 含义说明 | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `declarative-only` | `🟢 纯声明式 · 0进程` | 仅包含 `skills/` 或 `agents/` 声明文档，无任何常驻进程或钩子 | | `global-rules` | `🔵 常驻规则 (~N tok)` | 包含启用期间常驻注入上下文的 `rules/*.md`，清晰标出预估 Token 占用 | | `sidecar-ui` | `🟣 Sidecar 面板 · 0 Token` | 提供右侧辅助面板独立 Web UI，空闲时不消耗对话 Token | | `mcp-stdio` | `🟠 本地 MCP 进程` | 通过 `mcp_config.json` 启动本地 Stdio 工具服务进程 | | `mcp-remote` | `🌐 远程 MCP 服务` | 连接外部 HTTPS MCP 服务端点（展示目标域名） | | `lifecycle-hooks` | `🔶 生命周期钩子 (Hooks)` | 通过 `hooks.json` 订阅会话或工具调用生命周期事件 | | `host-enhancement` | `💡 宿主界面增强` | 使用本地 CDP 调试桥或 `app.asar` 工作台界面增强（如毛玻璃皮肤、桌面挂件），社区完全欢迎，仅温和提示 | - **升级能力增量确认（T+N Escalation Guard）**：当插件从旧版本升级并**新增**之前未授予的能力类别或新的远程 MCP 域名时，自动弹出增量对比确认框，经用户确认后再同步写入并更新 `.agy-market-receipt.json`。 - **双轨插件支持**：默认展示 Track 1 精选验证目录；在设置中可按需开启 **Track 2 实验性 Topic 自动发现**（自动强制 `--` 双连字符命名隔离，避免同名冲突）。 --- ## 🛠️ CLI 诊断与本地开发命令 ### 用户 CLI 命令（`bin/agy-market.mjs`） ```bash # 安装或更新 AGY Market 到默认插件目录（支持 --dest 自定义路径） npx agy-market install # 查看当前配置路径、数据目录及所有已安装插件状态（支持 --json 机器可读输出） npx agy-market status npx agy-market status --json # 运行健康体检（校验 Node >= 22、非符号链接实体目录、10 字段清单纯净度、UI 产物）并清理 Windows 残留 *.old. 文件 npx agy-market doctor ``` ### 源码构建与本地开发 ```powershell # 1. 编译离线可用的单文件 Sidecar UI（sidecars/market_pane/index.html）及静态展示站 npm run build # 2. 以真实文件复制方式安装至 ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-market（严禁符号链接 / NTFS Junction） npm run install:local # 3. 执行健康诊断 node ./bin/agy-market.mjs doctor # 4. 打包确定性 GitHub Release 压缩包与校验文件（dist/agy-market.tar.gz + .sha256） npm run pack:release # 5. 运行全量单元测试与跨仓集成测试 npm test ``` --- ## 🔒 安全与宿主工程红线 - **绝不写入 `~/.gemini/config/config.json`**：仅只读解析插件启停状态，杜绝覆盖用户登录态与设置。 - **绝不创建符号链接 / NTFS Junction**：Windows 下 Antigravity 会静默跳过符号链接插件，所有安装/更新均为实体目录复制，且解包器硬性拦截 `..` 路径穿越与软硬链接。 - **Windows 锁安全原位更新与崩溃恢复**：先在插件外置 `${PLUGIN_DATA}/staging/` 解包并写入 `pending-journal.json`（启动 8 秒自动恢复中断事务），对 Windows 锁定中的二进制采用 `.old.` 改名退避并在下次启动时由 `retired-binaries.json` 自动垃圾回收。 - **严格环回与 CSRF 鉴权**：Sidecar HTTP 服务仅绑定 `127.0.0.1` 随机端口，所有写入/变更接口（`POST` / `DELETE`）强制校验 256-bit 随机 `X-Sidecar-Token` 与 `Origin` 头。 --- ## 📚 架构文档与贡献指引 修改本仓库代码前，请先阅读： - **[`AGENTS.md`](./AGENTS.md)** — 客户端工程规范、宿主红线与锁安全安装器设计 - **[`../AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md)** — 跨仓库协议、统一 JSON Schema 与双层防冲突规范 - **[`azwosile/agy-market-catalog`](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market-catalog)** — 插件目录提交指南与自动化收录管线 ## 📄 许可证 [MIT License](./LICENSE)

--- > **仓库边界说明**：本仓库（[`azwosile/agy-market`](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market)）包含 **AGY Market** 客户端 Sidecar 面板、Windows 锁安全安装器、`npx agy-market` 一行安装 CLI 与静态展示站（`site/`）。 > > 如需将你的插件收录至社区插件目录，请向 **[`azwosile/agy-market-catalog`](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market-catalog)** 提交单文件 YAML Pull Request。 --- ## ✨ 核心特性（v1.2.0 极光棱镜大改版） ### 1. 极光棱镜（Aurora Prism）视觉体验 - **零对话 Token 损耗**：采用纯 Antigravity 原生 `AUX_PANE` Sidecar 面板（`sidecars/market_pane/sidecar.json`），空闲时不注入任何常驻 MCP 工具，不消耗模型上下文预算。 - **流光展台与光学折射卡片**：顶部流光星云展台实时展示「已收录插件 / 运行中 / 可更新 / 冲突健康度」；每张卡片按分类赋予自适应色相光晕（`--card-accent`）、`1px` 镜面高光边与鼠标跟随微光（`--mx, --my`），同时完美适配暗色、亮色与半透明壁纸皮肤（如 Wallpaper Prism）。 - **双行优雅标题 + 一键直达 GitHub**：修复单行过早截断问题；点击探索卡片、已安装卡片或详情抽屉的**插件标题**可直接在新窗口打开对应 GitHub 仓库，点击卡片其余区域则展开详情抽屉。 - **开箱优先呈现简体中文文档**：详情抽屉请求 `/api/readme?id=...&locale=zh`，自动优先渲染目录源 `entriesZh` 或本地 `README.zh-CN.md` / `README.zh.md`，并在已安装卡片优先显示中文化简介。 - **告别隔离 iframe 无效死链**：彻底移除会被 Chromium 拦截的裸 `` 与 `` 链接；其他 Sidecar 插件的「面板」按钮升级为调用 `/preload.js` `window.sidecar.ui.toggleAuxPane`，并提供一键复制对话药丸兜底提示。 ### 2. 卡片底部原生「启用 / 禁用」安全停放仓滑块（Vault Parking） - **零改写 `config.json` 红线**：Antigravity 语言服务器对 `~/.gemini/config/config.json` 设有写保护。AGY Market 严守只读原则，永不改写 `config.json`，而是通过**安全停放仓（Vault Parking）**实现即时启停控制（`POST /api/toggle-plugin`）： - **滑向「禁用（OFF）」**：后端将 `~/.gemini/config/plugins/` 安全移入 `${PLUGIN_DATA}/disabled-plugins/`，宿主热监听约 1 秒内卸载对应 Skills / Rules / Hooks。 - **滑向「启用（ON）」**：后端将目录完整移回 `~/.gemini/config/plugins/` 并清理可能残留的 `"disabled": true`。 - **停放态持续可更新**：被禁用的插件仍保留在「已安装」与「探索」卡片中；对其执行版本更新时，会在 `disabled-plugins/` 内原位同步，绝不意外将其自动重新激活。 - **防误操作锁定**：`agy-market` 自身滑块保持常亮锁定（避免在市场面板内把自己停用断连）；`workspace`、`builtin` 及宿主手动禁用项显示只读锁定提示。 ### 3. 五层插件冲突与健康诊断中心（Conflict Radar） 顶部新增独立 **「冲突与诊断」** 标签页（`GET /api/conflicts`），一键执行零副作用只读体检并提供快速修复（`POST /api/fix-conflict`）： | 冲突层级 | 严重级别 | 检测内容 | 一键修复能力 | | :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- | | `duplicate-plugin-name` | 严重 | 跨 `workspace > global > builtin` 扫描重复 `plugin.json.name`，精确标出生效胜出方与被宿主静默丢弃的插件目录 | 一键双连字符隔离重命名（`--`） | | `windows-symlink-ignored` | 严重 | 检测 Windows 下 `~/.gemini/config/plugins/` 中被 `GetAllPlugins` 静默跳过的 NTFS Junction / 符号链接目录 | 一键实体化转为真实目录 | | `mcp-collision` | 严重 / 警告 | 检测重复 `_`、与用户全局 `mcp_config.json` 重名或裸通用服务名（如 `search`、`db`、`fetch`） | 定位冲突键名与来源文件 | | `skill-shadowing` / `agent-shadowing` | 警告 | 检测已启用插件之间的 `skills/*/SKILL.md`、`agents/*.md` 与用户全局目录或内置保留名的覆盖链 | 完整展示胜出/被覆盖链路 | | `host-enhancement-overlap` | 提示 | 检测多个已启用插件同时包含 `app-asar` 或 `cdp` 宿主增强（如旧版壁纸插件与新版皮肤并存） | 提示评估是否停用其一 | ### 4. 智能「免重启 / 需重开面板 / 需重启」生效引擎 安装、更新、批量更新或切换启停滑块后，依据插件能力与实时文件锁状态自动分级提示： - **`⚡ 免重启 · 即刻生效`（`instant`）**：纯声明式 Skills / Subagents（`declarative-only`）或全局规则（`global-rules`）。 - **`🔄 建议重开面板 / 刷新 MCP`（`reload-pane`）**：含 Sidecar 界面（`sidecar-ui`）、MCP 服务（`mcp-stdio` / `mcp-remote`）或生命周期钩子（`lifecycle-hooks`）。 - **`🚀 需重启 Antigravity 生效`（`host-restart`）**：含 `app.asar` 界面补丁、首次配置 `cdp` 调试端口的宿主增强插件，或 Windows 后台进程占用 `.exe`/`.node`/`.dll` 句柄触发了安全退避重命名（`*.old.`）。 ### 5. 内置 GitHub Discussions 社区讨论 - 插件详情抽屉内置 **「讨论」** 标签页（`GET /api/discussions`），无需登录或 Token 即可自动探测目标仓库是否开启 GitHub Discussions，并提供一键直达讨论区与发帖入口。 - 如在面板设置中可选填入个人 GitHub Token（仅以 `0600` 权限保存在本地 `prefs.json`，绝不写入缓存文件或日志），即可在侧栏直接拉取并浏览该插件最新 10 条社区讨论。 ### 6. 双通道中国大陆镜像加速与 SHA-256 防篡改校验 - **三级目录源自动解析（零内置陈旧快照）**： 1. **自定义团队/个人源**：优先合并 `prefs.json` 中配置的静态 `index.json` 订阅源。 2. **全球主通道（GitHub Pages + `gh-pages` Raw 回退）**：支持 `ETag`（`If-None-Match`）/ `If-Modified-Since` 条件请求，`304 Not Modified` 毫秒级复用本地缓存。 3. **中国大陆自动镜像回退**：主源超时（`> 3.5s`）或不可达时，自动切换拉取纯 JSON 数据包 `@agy-market/catalog`（依次尝试 `registry.npmmirror.com` 与 `mirrors.cloud.tencent.com/npm`），在内存流式解包目录索引；完全离线时自动降级为本地磁盘缓存。 - **语言无关 & 防篡改下载**：`@agy-market/catalog` 仅将 npm 用作高可用静态 JSON CDN，被收录的插件**无需是 npm 包或 JS 项目**。支持配置自定义 GitHub Release 镜像加速前缀，所有 `.tar.gz` 安装包在解压前都会强制比对目录源权威 `sha256`，任何字节差异立即触发 `INTEGRITY_SHA256_MISMATCH` 中止安装。 --- ## 🚀 一行快速安装 > 运行环境要求：**Node.js >= 22.0.0**（零外部 npm 运行时依赖）；或使用下方免 npm 系统脚本。 ### 方式一：Node / `npx`（推荐，全平台通用） ```bash npx agy-market@latest ``` ### 方式二：Windows PowerShell（免 npm，内置 SHA-256 校验与目录回退） ```powershell irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/azwosile/agy-market/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex ``` ### 方式三：macOS / Linux Shell（免 npm，内置 SHA-256 校验与目录回退） ```sh curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/azwosile/agy-market/main/scripts/install.sh | sh ``` ### 安装后如何在 Antigravity 中打开？ - 在 Antigravity 对话中发送「打开插件市场」，或点击聊天药丸：`[AGY Market](sidecar://agy-market/market_pane/)` - 也可直接点击右侧辅助面板顶部 **`+` → `Plugins` → `AGY Market`** 打开。 - 如需在 Antigravity 原生定制页管理本插件，可点击对话药丸：`[AGY Market](customization://agy-market)` --- ## 🏷️ 透明能力徽章与升级安全守卫 所有插件在点击「安装」前都会展示静态扫描生成的透明能力徽章，无隐藏权限： | 徽章标识 | 默认中文标签 | 含义说明 | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `declarative-only` | `🟢 纯声明式 · 0进程` | 仅包含 `skills/` 或 `agents/` 声明文档，无任何常驻进程或钩子 | | `global-rules` | `🔵 常驻规则 (~N tok)` | 包含启用期间常驻注入上下文的 `rules/*.md`，清晰标出预估 Token 占用 | | `sidecar-ui` | `🟣 Sidecar 面板 · 0 Token` | 提供右侧辅助面板独立 Web UI，空闲时不消耗对话 Token | | `mcp-stdio` | `🟠 本地 MCP 进程` | 通过 `mcp_config.json` 启动本地 Stdio 工具服务进程 | | `mcp-remote` | `🌐 远程 MCP 服务` | 连接外部 HTTPS MCP 服务端点（展示目标域名） | | `lifecycle-hooks` | `🔶 生命周期钩子 (Hooks)` | 通过 `hooks.json` 订阅会话或工具调用生命周期事件 | | `host-enhancement` | `💡 宿主界面增强` | 使用本地 CDP 调试桥或 `app.asar` 工作台界面增强（如毛玻璃皮肤、桌面挂件），社区完全欢迎，仅温和提示 | - **升级能力增量确认（T+N Escalation Guard）**：当插件从旧版本升级并**新增**之前未授予的能力类别或新的远程 MCP 域名时，自动弹出增量对比确认框，经用户确认后再同步写入并更新 `.agy-market-receipt.json`。 - **双轨插件支持**：默认展示 Track 1 精选验证目录；在设置中可按需开启 **Track 2 实验性 Topic 自动发现**（自动强制 `--` 双连字符命名隔离，避免同名冲突）。 --- ## 🛠️ CLI 诊断与本地开发命令 ### 用户 CLI 命令（`bin/agy-market.mjs`） ```bash # 安装或更新 AGY Market 到默认插件目录（支持 --dest 自定义路径） npx agy-market install # 查看当前配置路径、数据目录及所有已安装插件状态（支持 --json 机器可读输出） npx agy-market status npx agy-market status --json # 运行健康体检（校验 Node >= 22、非符号链接实体目录、10 字段清单纯净度、UI 产物）并清理 Windows 残留 *.old. 文件 npx agy-market doctor ``` ### 源码构建与本地开发 ```powershell # 1. 编译离线可用的单文件 Sidecar UI（sidecars/market_pane/index.html）及静态展示站 npm run build # 2. 以真实文件复制方式安装至 ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-market（严禁符号链接 / NTFS Junction） npm run install:local # 3. 执行健康诊断 node ./bin/agy-market.mjs doctor # 4. 打包确定性 GitHub Release 压缩包与校验文件（dist/agy-market.tar.gz + .sha256） npm run pack:release # 5. 运行全量单元测试与跨仓集成测试 npm test ``` --- ## 🔒 安全与宿主工程红线 - **绝不写入 `~/.gemini/config/config.json`**：仅只读解析插件启停状态，杜绝覆盖用户登录态与设置。 - **绝不创建符号链接 / NTFS Junction**：Windows 下 Antigravity 会静默跳过符号链接插件，所有安装/更新均为实体目录复制，且解包器硬性拦截 `..` 路径穿越与软硬链接。 - **Windows 锁安全原位更新与崩溃恢复**：先在插件外置 `${PLUGIN_DATA}/staging/` 解包并写入 `pending-journal.json`（启动 8 秒自动恢复中断事务），对 Windows 锁定中的二进制采用 `.old.` 改名退避并在下次启动时由 `retired-binaries.json` 自动垃圾回收。 - **严格环回与 CSRF 鉴权**：Sidecar HTTP 服务仅绑定 `127.0.0.1` 随机端口，所有写入/变更接口（`POST` / `DELETE`）强制校验 256-bit 随机 `X-Sidecar-Token` 与 `Origin` 头。 --- ## 📚 架构文档与贡献指引 修改本仓库代码前，请先阅读： - **[`AGENTS.md`](./AGENTS.md)** — 客户端工程规范、宿主红线与锁安全安装器设计 - **[`../AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md)** — 跨仓库协议、统一 JSON Schema 与双层防冲突规范 - **[`azwosile/agy-market-catalog`](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market-catalog)** — 插件目录提交指南与自动化收录管线 ## 📄 许可证 [MIT License](./LICENSE)

# AGY Market (`agy-market`) **Zero-Token Visual Community Plugin Marketplace for Google Antigravity** Aurora Prism Liquid-Glass UI · Native Vault-Parking Toggle Sliders · 5-Layer Conflict Radar · Smart Restart Indicators · Dual-Mirror China Acceleration · SHA-256 Tamper-Proof Installs [简体中文](README.md) · **English** · [Submit a Plugin](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market-catalog) · [Architecture Spec](AGENTS.md)
--- > **Repository Boundary**: This repository ([`azwosile/agy-market`](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market)) houses the **AGY Market** Sidecar client plugin, Windows lock-safe tarball installer, `npx agy-market` bootstrap CLI, and static web showcase (`site/`). > > To list your plugin in the community catalog, open a single-YAML Pull Request in **[`azwosile/agy-market-catalog`](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market-catalog)**. --- ## ✨ Highlights (v1.2.0 Aurora Prism Release) ### 1. Aurora Prism Visual Architecture - **Zero Idle Agent Token Cost**: Runs as a native Antigravity `AUX_PANE` Sidecar (`sidecars/market_pane/sidecar.json`) with zero bundled MCP servers, consuming 0 prompt tokens on idle turns. - **Prismatic Bento Cards & Nebula Header**: Live top Spotlight Hero Strip displays catalog stats (*Indexed / Active / Updates / Conflict Health*); each card adapts its radial hue aura (`--card-accent`), `1px` specular top rim, and pointer-tracking spotlight (`--mx, --my`), staying crisp across Dark, Light, and translucent wallpaper skins (such as Wallpaper Prism). - **2-Line Graceful Titles + Clickable GitHub Links**: Eliminates cramped single-line title truncation. Clicking any **plugin title** in cards or the Detail Drawer opens its GitHub repository directly in a new window, while clicking the card body opens the Detail Drawer. - **Multilingual README Drawer**: Queries `/api/readme?id=...&locale=zh|en`, preferring localized `entriesZh` / `entriesEn` from the catalog (or local `README.zh-CN.md` / `README.zh.md` for installed plugins) and rendering localized descriptions on installed cards. - **Zero Dead iframe Protocol Links**: Replaces raw `` and `` anchors blocked inside isolated Chromium iframes. Sibling Sidecar plugins invoke `/preload.js` `window.sidecar.ui.toggleAuxPane` with a one-click copyable chat pill fallback. ### 2. Native Card-Footer Enable / Disable Slider (Vault Parking) - **Zero Writes to `config.json`**: Antigravity's Language Server write-protects `~/.gemini/config/config.json`. AGY Market reads `config.json` strictly read-only and powers live toggling via **Vault Parking** (`POST /api/toggle-plugin`): - **Toggle OFF (Disable)**: Moves `~/.gemini/config/plugins/` cleanly into `${PLUGIN_DATA}/disabled-plugins/`. Host hot-watch unloads its Skills / Rules / Hooks within ~1 second. - **Toggle ON (Enable)**: Moves the folder back into `~/.gemini/config/plugins/` and removes any stale `"disabled": true` flag. - **Update While Parked**: Disabled plugins remain visible in *Installed* and *Discover* tabs and update in-place inside `disabled-plugins/` without accidentally reactivating them. - **Safe Locking**: `agy-market` itself stays locked ON to prevent disconnecting its own pane; `workspace`, `builtin`, and host-disabled plugins show clear read-only lock states. ### 3. 5-Layer Plugin Conflict & Health Radar Dedicated **Conflicts & Diagnostics** tab (`GET /api/conflicts`) with zero-side-effect scanning and one-click fixes (`POST /api/fix-conflict`): | Layer | Severity | What It Detects | Quick Action | | :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- | | `duplicate-plugin-name` | Critical | Duplicate `plugin.json.name` across `workspace > global > builtin` precedence, pinpointing the winner and silently dropped victim directories | 1-click `--` scoped isolation rename | | `windows-symlink-ignored` | Critical | Symlinks or NTFS junctions inside `~/.gemini/config/plugins/` that Windows `GetAllPlugins` silently skips | 1-click materialize to real directory | | `mcp-collision` | Critical / Warning | Duplicate `_` keys, collisions with global `mcp_config.json`, or bare generic server names (`search`, `db`, `fetch`, etc.) | Pinpoints colliding keys & sources | | `skill-shadowing` / `agent-shadowing` | Warning | Overlapping `skills/*/SKILL.md` or `agents/*.md` across active plugins, `~/.gemini/config/skills/*`, and built-in reserved names | Shows full override chain | | `host-enhancement-overlap` | Info | Two or more active plugins simultaneously using `app-asar` or `cdp` host enhancements | Advisory to disable legacy duplicate | ### 4. Smart Restart & Reload Activation Indicators Every install, update, batch update, and toggle classifies exact activation requirements (`classifyActivationRequirement`): - **`⚡ Instant · No Restart` (`instant`)**: Pure declarative skills/agents (`declarative-only`) or `global-rules`. - **`🔄 Reload Pane / Refresh MCP` (`reload-pane`)**: Plugins containing `sidecar-ui`, `mcp-stdio`, `mcp-remote`, or `lifecycle-hooks`. - **`🚀 Restart Antigravity Required` (`host-restart`)**: Plugins applying `app.asar` patches, first-time `cdp` debug-port setup, or Windows installs/disables that retired locked `.exe`/`.node`/`.dll` binaries (`*.old.`). ### 5. Built-In GitHub Discussions Integration - Every plugin Detail Drawer includes a **Discussions** tab (`GET /api/discussions`) that detects whether Discussions are enabled on the repository without needing a token and provides direct links to browse or start a thread. - Optionally configuring a personal GitHub Token in Settings (stored locally in `prefs.json` with `0600` permissions; never logged or persisted in caches) loads the latest 10 repository discussions directly inside the pane. ### 6. Dual-Mirror China Acceleration & SHA-256 Tamper-Proof Installs - **Three-Tier Live Catalog Resolution (No Stale Bundled Snapshot)**: 1. **Custom Feeds**: User/team static `index.json` URLs configured in `prefs.json` take highest priority. 2. **Primary Channel (GitHub Pages + `gh-pages` Raw Fallback)**: Conditional `ETag` (`If-None-Match`) / `If-Modified-Since` requests achieve `<50ms` `304 Not Modified` cache hits. 3. **Automatic Mainland China Mirror Fallback**: If GitHub Pages times out (`> 3.5s`) or fails, streams the pure-JSON `@agy-market/catalog` transport package from `registry.npmmirror.com` or `mirrors.cloud.tencent.com/npm` in memory; falls back to disk cache when offline. - **Language-Agnostic & Tamper-Proof**: npm is used **strictly** as a JSON mirror CDN for catalog metadata—listed plugins do **not** need to be npm or JavaScript projects. Optional GitHub Release mirror prefixes are supported safely because every tarball is streamed and verified against the authoritative catalog `sha256` before extraction (`INTEGRITY_SHA256_MISMATCH` aborts immediately on any altered byte). --- ## 🚀 One-Line Bootstrap Install > Requires **Node.js >= 22.0.0** (zero runtime npm dependencies), or use the zero-npm OS installers below. - **Node / `npx` (Cross-Platform, Recommended)**: ```bash npx agy-market@latest ``` - **Windows PowerShell (Zero npm, SHA-256 Verified + Catalog Fallback)**: ```powershell irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/azwosile/agy-market/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex ``` - **macOS / Linux Shell (Zero npm, SHA-256 Verified + Catalog Fallback)**: ```sh curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/azwosile/agy-market/main/scripts/install.sh | sh ``` Once installed in Antigravity: - Open Auxiliary Pane: click `[AGY Market](sidecar://agy-market/market_pane/)` in chat, or open **Auxiliary Pane → `+` → `Plugins` → `AGY Market`**. - Manage on Native Customizations Page: `[AGY Market](customization://agy-market)` --- ## 🏷️ Transparent Capability Badges & Update Guard Every plugin surfaces static capability badges beside the Install button before installation: | Badge ID | Default Label | Description | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `declarative-only` | `🟢 Declarative · 0 Process` | Pure `skills/` or `agents/` markdown; zero background processes or hooks | | `global-rules` | `🔵 Global Rules (~N tok)` | Includes `rules/*.md` active in prompt context while enabled, with token estimate | | `sidecar-ui` | `🟣 Sidecar Pane · 0 Token` | Visual auxiliary Sidecar web pane with zero idle LLM token cost | | `mcp-stdio` | `🟠 Local MCP Process` | Spawns a local stdio MCP server defined in `mcp_config.json` | | `mcp-remote` | `🌐 Remote MCP Service` | Connects to an external HTTPS MCP endpoint (domains listed transparently) | | `lifecycle-hooks` | `🔶 Lifecycle Hooks` | Registers session/tool lifecycle hooks via `hooks.json` | | `host-enhancement` | `💡 Host UI Enhancement` | Uses local CDP bridge or `app.asar` workbench enhancements (glass skins, companion widgets); fully permitted, gentle notice only | - **Capability-Escalation Confirmation**: Updating a plugin that adds newly introduced privilege badges or remote MCP domains pauses for explicit user approval before syncing and updating `.agy-market-receipt.json`. - **Dual-Track Discovery**: Track 1 verified plugins appear by default; opting into **Track 2 Experimental Topic Discovery** automatically enforces `--` double-hyphen isolation. --- ## 🛠️ CLI Commands & Local Development ### CLI (`bin/agy-market.mjs`) ```bash # Install or update AGY Market (optional --dest ) npx agy-market install # List local installed plugins, config/data paths & market receipts (--json supported) npx agy-market status npx agy-market status --json # Run health diagnostics (Node >= 22, real directory check, 10-field manifest purity, built UI) & sweep retired Windows binaries npx agy-market doctor ``` ### Build & Test From Source ```powershell # Build single-file offline-capable Sidecar UI (sidecars/market_pane/index.html) & static showcase npm run build # Copy real plugin bundle into ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-market (never symlinks/junctions) npm run install:local # Verify local installation health node ./bin/agy-market.mjs doctor # Pack deterministic release tarball (dist/agy-market.tar.gz + .sha256) npm run pack:release # Run unit & integration tests npm test ``` --- ## 🔒 Security & Host Redlines - **Never Writes `~/.gemini/config/config.json`**: Read-only inspection only; Vault Parking handles enable/disable cleanly. - **Never Creates Symlinks / NTFS Junctions**: Every install performs real directory/file copies and rejects archive traversal (`..`) and symlink/hardlink tar entries. - **Windows Lock-Safe Sync & Crash Recovery**: Stages outside `~/.gemini/config/plugins/` in `${PLUGIN_DATA}/staging/`, journals transitions via `pending-journal.json` (auto-recovered 8s after boot), renames locked binaries to `*.old.`, and sweeps them via `retired-binaries.json`. - **Loopback-Only Sidecar & CSRF Guard**: Listens strictly on `127.0.0.1` (ephemeral port) and enforces a 256-bit random `X-Sidecar-Token` + `Origin` check on all `POST`/`DELETE` routes. --- ## 📚 Architecture & Contributing Read **[`AGENTS.md`](./AGENTS.md)** and **[`../AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md)** before modifying any module in this repository. To submit plugins, visit **[`azwosile/agy-market-catalog`](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market-catalog)**. ## 📄 License [MIT License](./LICENSE)

# AGY Market · 反重力插件市场 (`agy-market`) **Google Antigravity 极光棱镜可视化社区插件市场** 极光棱镜（Aurora Prism）液态玻璃界面 · ⭐ 插件收藏栏 · 已安装实时搜索筛选 · 一键直开 Sidebar 侧边栏 · 卡片原生启停滑块 · 5 层插件冲突雷达 · 双通道中国镜像加速 · SHA-256 防篡改校验 **简体中文** · [English](./README.en.md) · **[📖 申请收录插件教程](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market-catalog/blob/main/docs/SUBMISSION_GUIDE.md)** · [插件目录仓库](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market-catalog) · [架构规范](./AGENTS.md)
--- > **仓库边界说明**：本仓库（[`azwosile/agy-market`](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market)）包含 **AGY Market** 客户端 Sidebar 侧边栏、Windows 锁安全安装器、`npx agy-market` 一行安装 CLI 与静态展示站（`site/`）。 > > 如需将你的插件收录至社区插件目录，点击市场顶部的 **`+ 申请收录插件`** 按钮或直接阅读 **[📖 申请收录插件完整教程 (`docs/SUBMISSION_GUIDE.md`)](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market-catalog/blob/main/docs/SUBMISSION_GUIDE.md)**，向 **[`azwosile/agy-market-catalog`](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market-catalog)** 提交单文件 YAML Pull Request。 --- ## ✨ 核心特性（v1.3.0 极光棱镜打磨版） ### 1. 极光棱镜（Aurora Prism）Sidebar 侧边栏体验 - **原生右侧 Sidebar 侧边栏**：基于 Antigravity 原生 `AUX_PANE` 扩展视图（`sidecars/market_pane/sidecar.json`），不捆绑常驻 MCP 服务，打开即用、轻量流畅。 - **流光展台与光学折射卡片**：顶部流光星云展台实时展示「已收录插件 / 运行中 / 可更新 / 冲突健康度」，并内置 **`+ 申请收录插件`** 快捷入口直达官方中文收录教程；每张卡片按分类赋予自适应色相光晕（`--card-accent`）、`1px` 镜面高光边与鼠标跟随微光（`--mx, --my`），完美适配暗色、亮色与半透明壁纸皮肤（如 Wallpaper Prism）。 - **双行优雅标题 + 一键直达 GitHub**：点击探索卡片、收藏卡片、已安装卡片或详情抽屉的**插件标题**可直接在新窗口打开对应 GitHub 仓库，点击卡片其余区域展开详情抽屉。 - **开箱优先呈现简体中文文档**：详情抽屉请求 `/api/readme?id=...&locale=zh`，自动优先渲染目录源 `entriesZh` 或本地 `README.zh-CN.md` / `README.zh.md`，并在已安装卡片优先显示中文化简介。 - **点击「面板」一键直开目标 Sidebar 侧边栏**：彻底移除会被 Chromium 拦截的裸 `` 死链；点击其他 Sidebar 插件卡片上的「面板」按钮时，直接联动宿主 `window.sidecar.ui.toggleAuxPane` 与后端 `POST /api/open-pane` 自动拉起或聚焦对应侧边栏，告别繁琐的手动复制提示。 ### 2. ⭐ 插件收藏栏、已安装搜索筛选与更新失败告警 - **⭐ 插件收藏栏 & 独立「收藏」标签页**： - 每张插件卡片（探索、收藏、已安装）与详情抽屉顶部均内置 `☆` / 琥珀金 `★` 收藏按钮，点击调用 `POST /api/favorites` 原子持久化至本地 `prefs.json`（无需重复配置）。 - 收藏任意插件后，「探索」页顶部自动浮现可折叠的 **「★ 我的收藏栏」** 快捷入口；顶部导航同步提供独立 **「★ 收藏」** 标签页（`探索 · 收藏 · 已安装 · 冲突与诊断 · 源与设置`），支持全文检索与快速启停/安装。 - **`已安装` 插件实时搜索与状态筛选**： - 「已安装」视图配备实时搜索栏（支持按插件显示名、目录名或简介瞬时过滤）与状态筛选胶囊（**全部 / 已启用 / 已停用 / 可更新**），插件再多也能秒级定位。 - **更新失败显著红色告警条（绝不静默失败）**： - 当单个安装/更新、批量「全部更新」或市场自更新遇到网络中断、SHA-256 校验不匹配或文件锁异常时，页面顶部立即弹出醒目的红色玻璃告警条与错误通知，完整展示失败插件与具体错误原因，并提供一键 **「重试」** 按钮。 ### 3. 卡片底部原生「启用 / 禁用」安全停放仓滑块（Vault Parking） - **零改写 `config.json` 红线**：Antigravity 语言服务器对 `~/.gemini/config/config.json` 设有写保护。AGY Market 严守只读原则，永不改写 `config.json`，而是通过**安全停放仓（Vault Parking）**实现即时启停控制（`POST /api/toggle-plugin`）： - **滑向「禁用（OFF）」**：后端将 `~/.gemini/config/plugins/` 安全移入 `${PLUGIN_DATA}/disabled-plugins/`，宿主热监听约 1 秒内卸载对应 Skills / Rules / Hooks。 - **滑向「启用（ON）」**：后端将目录完整移回 `~/.gemini/config/plugins/` 并清理可能残留的 `"disabled": true`。 - **停放态持续可更新**：被禁用的插件仍保留在「已安装」与「探索」卡片中；对其执行版本更新时，会在 `disabled-plugins/` 内原位同步，绝不意外将其自动重新激活。 - **防误操作锁定**：`agy-market` 自身滑块保持常亮锁定（避免在市场侧边栏内把自己停用断连）；`workspace`、`builtin` 及宿主手动禁用项显示只读锁定提示。 ### 4. 五层插件冲突与健康诊断中心（Conflict Radar） 顶部内置独立 **「冲突与诊断」** 标签页（`GET /api/conflicts`），一键执行零副作用只读体检并提供快速修复（`POST /api/fix-conflict`）： | 冲突层级 | 严重级别 | 检测内容 | 一键修复能力 | | :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- | | `duplicate-plugin-name` | 严重 | 跨 `workspace > global > builtin` 扫描重复 `plugin.json.name`，精确标出生效胜出方与被宿主静默丢弃的插件目录 | 一键双连字符隔离重命名（`--`） | | `windows-symlink-ignored` | 严重 | 检测 Windows 下 `~/.gemini/config/plugins/` 中被 `GetAllPlugins` 静默跳过的 NTFS Junction / 符号链接目录 | 一键实体化转为真实目录 | | `mcp-collision` | 严重 / 警告 | 检测重复 `_`、与用户全局 `mcp_config.json` 重名或裸通用服务名（如 `search`、`db`、`fetch`） | 定位冲突键名与来源文件 | | `skill-shadowing` / `agent-shadowing` | 警告 | 检测已启用插件之间的 `skills/*/SKILL.md`、`agents/*.md` 与用户全局目录或内置保留名的覆盖链 | 完整展示胜出/被覆盖链路 | | `host-enhancement-overlap` | 提示 | 检测多个已启用插件同时包含 `app-asar` 或 `cdp` 宿主增强（如旧版壁纸插件与新版皮肤并存） | 提示评估是否停用其一 | ### 5. 按需触发的智能重启 / 重开侧边栏提示 卡片与详情抽屉保持视觉清爽，不再堆叠静态「需重启 / 免重启」标签；**仅当安装、更新、批量更新成功或 Windows 禁用遇到文件锁时**，依据插件能力与实时句柄状态按需弹出精准提示： - **纯声明式技能 / 全局规则（`instant`）**：热加载即刻生效，免重启无打扰。 - **含 Sidebar 侧边栏 / MCP / 钩子（`reload-pane`）**：更新或安装成功后提示重开侧边栏或刷新 MCP。 - **含 `app.asar` / 首次配置 `cdp` / Windows 锁定退避文件（`host-restart`）**：操作完成后弹出顶部横幅提醒重启 Antigravity 生效。 ### 6. 内置 GitHub Discussions 社区讨论 - 插件详情抽屉内置 **「讨论」** 标签页（`GET /api/discussions`），无需登录或 Token 即可自动探测目标仓库是否开启 GitHub Discussions，并提供一键直达讨论区与发帖入口。 - 如在面板设置中可选填入个人 GitHub Token（仅以 `0600` 权限保存在本地 `prefs.json`，绝不写入缓存文件或日志），即可在侧边栏直接拉取并浏览该插件最新 10 条社区讨论。 ### 7. 双通道中国大陆镜像加速与 SHA-256 防篡改校验 - **三级目录源自动解析（零内置陈旧快照）**： 1. **自定义团队/个人源**：优先合并 `prefs.json` 中配置的静态 `index.json` 订阅源。 2. **全球主通道（GitHub Pages + `gh-pages` Raw 回退）**：支持 `ETag`（`If-None-Match`）/ `If-Modified-Since` 条件请求，`304 Not Modified` 毫秒级复用本地缓存。 3. **中国大陆自动镜像回退**：主源超时（`> 3.5s`）或不可达时，自动切换拉取纯 JSON 数据包 `@agy-market/catalog`（依次尝试 `registry.npmmirror.com` 与 `mirrors.cloud.tencent.com/npm`），在内存流式解包目录索引；完全离线时自动降级为本地磁盘缓存。 - **语言无关 & 防篡改下载**：`@agy-market/catalog` 仅将 npm 用作高可用静态 JSON CDN，被收录的插件**无需是 npm 包或 JS 项目**。支持配置自定义 GitHub Release 镜像加速前缀，所有 `.tar.gz` 安装包在解压前都会强制比对目录源权威 `sha256`，任何字节差异立即触发 `INTEGRITY_SHA256_MISMATCH` 中止安装。 --- ## 🚀 一行快速安装 > 运行环境要求：**Node.js >= 22.0.0**（零外部 npm 运行时依赖）；或使用下方免 npm 系统脚本。 ### 方式一：Node / `npx`（推荐，全平台通用） ```bash npx agy-market@latest ``` ### 方式二：Windows PowerShell（免 npm，内置 SHA-256 校验与目录回退） ```powershell irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/azwosile/agy-market/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex ``` ### 方式三：macOS / Linux Shell（免 npm，内置 SHA-256 校验与目录回退） ```sh curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/azwosile/agy-market/main/scripts/install.sh | sh ``` ### 安装后如何在 Antigravity 中打开？ - 在 Antigravity 对话中发送「打开插件市场」，或点击聊天药丸：`[AGY Market](sidecar://agy-market/market_pane/)` - 也可直接点击右侧 Sidebar 辅助栏顶部 **`+` → `Plugins` → `AGY Market`** 打开。 - 如需在 Antigravity 原生定制页管理本插件，可点击对话药丸：`[AGY Market](customization://agy-market)` --- ## 🏷️ 透明能力徽章与升级安全守卫 所有插件在点击「安装」前都会展示静态扫描生成的透明能力徽章，无隐藏权限： | 徽章标识 | 默认中文标签 | 含义说明 | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `declarative-only` | `🟢 纯声明式技能` | 仅包含 `skills/` 或 `agents/` 声明文档，无后台常驻进程或钩子 | | `global-rules` | `🔵 常驻规则 (~N tok)` | 包含启用期间常驻注入上下文的 `rules/*.md`，清晰标出预估 Token 占用 | | `sidecar-ui` | `🟣 Sidebar 侧边栏` | 在右侧 Sidebar 辅助栏提供可视化交互界面 | | `mcp-stdio` | `🟠 本地 MCP 进程` | 通过 `mcp_config.json` 启动本地 Stdio 工具服务进程 | | `mcp-remote` | `🌐 远程 MCP 服务` | 连接外部 HTTPS MCP 服务端点（展示目标域名） | | `lifecycle-hooks` | `🔶 生命周期钩子 (Hooks)` | 通过 `hooks.json` 订阅会话或工具调用生命周期事件 | | `host-enhancement` | `💡 宿主界面增强` | 使用本地 CDP 调试桥或 `app.asar` 工作台界面增强（如毛玻璃皮肤、桌面挂件），社区完全欢迎，仅温和提示 | - **升级能力增量确认（T+N Escalation Guard）**：当插件从旧版本升级并**新增**之前未授予的能力类别或新的远程 MCP 域名时，自动弹出增量对比确认框，经用户确认后再同步写入并更新 `.agy-market-receipt.json`。 - **双轨插件支持**：默认展示 Track 1 精选验证目录；在设置中可按需开启 **Track 2 实验性 Topic 自动发现**（自动强制 `--` 双连字符命名隔离，避免同名冲突）。 --- ## 🛠️ CLI 诊断与本地开发命令 ### 用户 CLI 命令（`bin/agy-market.mjs`） ```bash # 安装或更新 AGY Market 到默认插件目录（支持 --dest 自定义路径） npx agy-market install # 查看当前配置路径、数据目录及所有已安装插件状态（支持 --json 机器可读输出） npx agy-market status npx agy-market status --json # 运行健康体检（校验 Node >= 22、非符号链接实体目录、10 字段清单纯净度、UI 产物）并清理 Windows 残留 *.old. 文件 npx agy-market doctor ``` ### 源码构建与本地开发 ```powershell # 1. 编译离线可用的单文件 Sidebar UI（sidecars/market_pane/index.html）及静态展示站 npm run build # 2. 以真实文件复制方式安装至 ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-market（严禁符号链接 / NTFS Junction） npm run install:local # 3. 执行健康诊断 node ./bin/agy-market.mjs doctor # 4. 打包确定性 GitHub Release 压缩包与校验文件（dist/agy-market.tar.gz + .sha256） npm run pack:release # 5. 运行全量单元测试与跨仓集成测试 npm test ``` --- ## 🔒 安全与宿主工程红线 - **绝不写入 `~/.gemini/config/config.json`**：仅只读解析插件启停状态，杜绝覆盖用户登录态与设置。 - **绝不创建符号链接 / NTFS Junction**：Windows 下 Antigravity 会静默跳过符号链接插件，所有安装/更新均为实体目录复制，且解包器硬性拦截 `..` 路径穿越与软硬链接。 - **Windows 锁安全原位更新与崩溃恢复**：先在插件外置 `${PLUGIN_DATA}/staging/` 解包并写入 `pending-journal.json`（启动 8 秒自动恢复中断事务），对 Windows 锁定中的二进制采用 `.old.` 改名退避并在下次启动时由 `retired-binaries.json` 自动垃圾回收。 - **严格环回与 CSRF 鉴权**：本地 HTTP 服务仅绑定 `127.0.0.1` 随机端口，所有写入/变更接口（`POST` / `DELETE`）强制校验 256-bit 随机 `X-Sidecar-Token` 与 `Origin` 头。 --- ## 📚 架构文档与收录指引 - **[📖 申请收录插件完整教程 (`docs/SUBMISSION_GUIDE.md`)](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market-catalog/blob/main/docs/SUBMISSION_GUIDE.md)** — 一文搞定 Track 1 单文件 YAML 提交流程与 Track 2 免 PR 自动发现 - 插件详情抽屉内置 **「讨论」** 标签页（`GET /api/discussions`），无需登录或 Token 即可自动探测目标仓库是否开启 GitHub Discussions，并提供一键直达讨论区与发帖入口。 - 如在面板设置中可选填入个人 GitHub Token（仅以 `0600` 权限保存在本地 `prefs.json`，绝不写入缓存文件或日志），即可在侧边栏直接拉取并浏览该插件最新 10 条社区讨论。 ### 7. 双通道中国大陆镜像加速与 SHA-256 防篡改校验 - **三级目录源自动解析（零内置陈旧快照）**： 1. **自定义团队/个人源**：优先合并 `prefs.json` 中配置的静态 `index.json` 订阅源。 2. **全球主通道（GitHub Pages + `gh-pages` Raw 回退）**：支持 `ETag`（`If-None-Match`）/ `If-Modified-Since` 条件请求，`304 Not Modified` 毫秒级复用本地缓存。 3. **中国大陆自动镜像回退**：主源超时（`> 3.5s`）或不可达时，自动切换拉取纯 JSON 数据包 `@agy-market/catalog`（依次尝试 `registry.npmmirror.com` 与 `mirrors.cloud.tencent.com/npm`），在内存流式解包目录索引；完全离线时自动降级为本地磁盘缓存。 - **语言无关 & 防篡改下载**：`@agy-market/catalog` 仅将 npm 用作高可用静态 JSON CDN，被收录的插件**无需是 npm 包或 JS 项目**。支持配置自定义 GitHub Release 镜像加速前缀，所有 `.tar.gz` 安装包在解压前都会强制比对目录源权威 `sha256`，任何字节差异立即触发 `INTEGRITY_SHA256_MISMATCH` 中止安装。 --- ## 🚀 一行快速安装 > 运行环境要求：**Node.js >= 22.0.0**（零外部 npm 运行时依赖）；或使用下方免 npm 系统脚本。 ### 方式一：Node / `npx`（推荐，全平台通用） ```bash npx agy-market@latest ``` ### 方式二：Windows PowerShell（免 npm，内置 SHA-256 校验与目录回退） ```powershell irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/azwosile/agy-market/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex ``` ### 方式三：macOS / Linux Shell（免 npm，内置 SHA-256 校验与目录回退） ```sh curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/azwosile/agy-market/main/scripts/install.sh | sh ``` ### 安装后如何在 Antigravity 中打开？ - 在 Antigravity 对话中发送「打开插件市场」，或点击聊天药丸：`[AGY Market](sidecar://agy-market/market_pane/)` - 也可直接点击右侧 Sidebar 辅助栏顶部 **`+` → `Plugins` → `AGY Market`** 打开。 - 如需在 Antigravity 原生定制页管理本插件，可点击对话药丸：`[AGY Market](customization://agy-market)` --- ## 🏷️ 透明能力徽章与升级安全守卫 所有插件在点击「安装」前都会展示静态扫描生成的透明能力徽章，无隐藏权限： | 徽章标识 | 默认中文标签 | 含义说明 | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `declarative-only` | `🟢 纯声明式技能` | 仅包含 `skills/` 或 `agents/` 声明文档，无后台常驻进程或钩子 | | `global-rules` | `🔵 常驻规则 (~N tok)` | 包含启用期间常驻注入上下文的 `rules/*.md`，清晰标出预估 Token 占用 | | `sidecar-ui` | `🟣 Sidebar 侧边栏` | 在右侧 Sidebar 辅助栏提供可视化交互界面 | | `mcp-stdio` | `🟠 本地 MCP 进程` | 通过 `mcp_config.json` 启动本地 Stdio 工具服务进程 | | `mcp-remote` | `🌐 远程 MCP 服务` | 连接外部 HTTPS MCP 服务端点（展示目标域名） | | `lifecycle-hooks` | `🔶 生命周期钩子 (Hooks)` | 通过 `hooks.json` 订阅会话或工具调用生命周期事件 | | `host-enhancement` | `💡 宿主界面增强` | 使用本地 CDP 调试桥或 `app.asar` 工作台界面增强（如毛玻璃皮肤、桌面挂件），社区完全欢迎，仅温和提示 | - **升级能力增量确认（T+N Escalation Guard）**：当插件从旧版本升级并**新增**之前未授予的能力类别或新的远程 MCP 域名时，自动弹出增量对比确认框，经用户确认后再同步写入并更新 `.agy-market-receipt.json`。 - **双轨插件支持**：默认展示 Track 1 精选验证目录；在设置中可按需开启 **Track 2 实验性 Topic 自动发现**（自动强制 `--` 双连字符命名隔离，避免同名冲突）。 --- ## 🛠️ CLI 诊断与本地开发命令 ### 用户 CLI 命令（`bin/agy-market.mjs`） ```bash # 安装或更新 AGY Market 到默认插件目录（支持 --dest 自定义路径） npx agy-market install # 查看当前配置路径、数据目录及所有已安装插件状态（支持 --json 机器可读输出） npx agy-market status npx agy-market status --json # 运行健康体检（校验 Node >= 22、非符号链接实体目录、10 字段清单纯净度、UI 产物）并清理 Windows 残留 *.old. 文件 npx agy-market doctor ``` ### 源码构建与本地开发 ```powershell # 1. 编译离线可用的单文件 Sidebar UI（sidecars/market_pane/index.html）及静态展示站 npm run build # 2. 以真实文件复制方式安装至 ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-market（严禁符号链接 / NTFS Junction） npm run install:local # 3. 执行健康诊断 node ./bin/agy-market.mjs doctor # 4. 打包确定性 GitHub Release 压缩包与校验文件（dist/agy-market.tar.gz + .sha256） npm run pack:release # 5. 运行全量单元测试与跨仓集成测试 npm test ``` --- ## 🔒 安全与宿主工程红线 - **绝不写入 `~/.gemini/config/config.json`**：仅只读解析插件启停状态，杜绝覆盖用户登录态与设置。 - **绝不创建符号链接 / NTFS Junction**：Windows 下 Antigravity 会静默跳过符号链接插件，所有安装/更新均为实体目录复制，且解包器硬性拦截 `..` 路径穿越与软硬链接。 - **Windows 锁安全原位更新与崩溃恢复**：先在插件外置 `${PLUGIN_DATA}/staging/` 解包并写入 `pending-journal.json`（启动 8 秒自动恢复中断事务），对 Windows 锁定中的二进制采用 `.old.` 改名退避并在下次启动时由 `retired-binaries.json` 自动垃圾回收。 - **严格环回与 CSRF 鉴权**：本地 HTTP 服务仅绑定 `127.0.0.1` 随机端口，所有写入/变更接口（`POST` / `DELETE`）强制校验 256-bit 随机 `X-Sidecar-Token` 与 `Origin` 头。 --- ## 📚 架构文档与收录指引 - **[📖 申请收录插件完整教程 (`docs/SUBMISSION_GUIDE.md`)](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market-catalog/blob/main/docs/SUBMISSION_GUIDE.md)** — 一文搞定 Track 1 单文件 YAML 提交流程与 Track 2 免 PR 自动发现 -
