# AGY Market (`agy-market`) **Aurora Prism Visual Community Plugin Marketplace for Google Antigravity** Aurora Prism Liquid-Glass UI · ⭐ Pinned Favorites Shelf & Tab · Live Installed Search & Filters · One-Click Sidebar Launcher · Native Vault-Parking Toggle Sliders · 5-Layer Conflict Radar · Dual-Mirror China Acceleration · SHA-256 Tamper-Proof Installs [简体中文](./README.md) · **English** · **[📖 Submit a Plugin Guide](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market-catalog/blob/main/docs/SUBMISSION_GUIDE.md)** · [Plugin Catalog](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market-catalog) · [Architecture Spec](./AGENTS.md)
--- > **Repository Boundary**: This repository ([`azwosile/agy-market`](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market)) houses the **AGY Market** Sidebar client plugin, Windows lock-safe tarball installer, `npx agy-market` bootstrap CLI, and static web showcase (`site/`). > > To list your plugin in the community catalog, click **`+ Submit Plugin`** (`+ 申请收录插件`) in AGY Market or follow the step-by-step **[📖 Plugin Submission Guide (`docs/SUBMISSION_GUIDE.md`)](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market-catalog/blob/main/docs/SUBMISSION_GUIDE.md)** to open a single-YAML Pull Request in **[`azwosile/agy-market-catalog`](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market-catalog)**. --- ## ✨ Highlights (v1.3.0 Aurora Prism Polish) ### 1. Aurora Prism Sidebar Experience - **Native Right Sidebar Panel**: Runs inside Antigravity's native `AUX_PANE` extension view (`sidecars/market_pane/sidecar.json`) with no bundled MCP servers, keeping the panel lightweight and responsive. - **Prismatic Bento Cards & Nebula Header**: Live top Spotlight Hero Strip displays catalog stats (*Indexed / Active / Updates / Conflict Health*) alongside a quick **`+ Submit Plugin`** button linking straight to `docs/SUBMISSION_GUIDE.md`. Each card adapts its radial hue aura (`--card-accent`), `1px` specular top rim, and pointer-tracking spotlight (`--mx, --my`), staying crisp across Dark, Light, and translucent wallpaper skins (such as Wallpaper Prism). - **2-Line Graceful Titles + Clickable GitHub Links**: Clicking any **plugin title** in cards or the Detail Drawer opens its GitHub repository directly in a new window, while clicking the card body opens the Detail Drawer. - **Multilingual README Drawer**: Queries `/api/readme?id=...&locale=zh|en`, preferring localized `entriesZh` / `entriesEn` from the catalog (or local `README.zh-CN.md` / `README.zh.md` for installed plugins) and rendering localized descriptions on installed cards. - **Direct One-Click Sidebar Launcher**: Replaces raw `` links blocked inside isolated iframes. Clicking a sibling plugin's **Panel** button invokes both host `window.sidecar.ui.toggleAuxPane` and backend `POST /api/open-pane` to open or focus its Sidebar panel directly—no manual copy prompts. ### 2. ⭐ Favorites Shelf & Tab, Installed Search/Filters & Update Error Alerts - **⭐ Pinned Favorites Shelf & Dedicated Favorites Tab**: - Every plugin card (Discover, Favorites, Installed) and the Detail Drawer header feature a tactile star button (`☆` / glowing amber `★`) backed by `POST /api/favorites` persisted atomically in `prefs.json`. - When 1 or more plugins are starred, a collapsible **Pinned Favorites Shelf (`★ Favorites`)** appears above the Discover grid, complemented by a dedicated **`★ Favorites`** top navigation tab (`Discover · Favorites · Installed · Conflicts & Diagnostics · Sources & Settings`). - **Live Search & Status Filters in `Installed` View**: - The **Installed** view includes a live search bar (matching display name, directory name, or description) and quick status filter pills (**All / Enabled / Disabled / Updatable**) for fast management at scale. - **High-Visibility Update Error Alert Banner (Zero Silent Failures)**: - Whenever an install/update, batch **Update All**, or self-update fails due to network errors, SHA-256 mismatch, or permissions, a dismissible red glass error banner and danger toast surface the affected plugin, exact failure reason, and a one-click **Retry** button. ### 3. Native Card-Footer Enable / Disable Slider (Vault Parking) - **Zero Writes to `config.json`**: Antigravity's Language Server write-protects `~/.gemini/config/config.json`. AGY Market reads `config.json` strictly read-only and powers live toggling via **Vault Parking** (`POST /api/toggle-plugin`): - **Toggle OFF (Disable)**: Moves `~/.gemini/config/plugins/` cleanly into `${PLUGIN_DATA}/disabled-plugins/`. Host hot-watch unloads its Skills / Rules / Hooks within ~1 second. - **Toggle ON (Enable)**: Moves the folder back into `~/.gemini/config/plugins/` and removes any stale `"disabled": true` flag. - **Update While Parked**: Disabled plugins remain visible in *Installed* and *Discover* tabs and update in-place inside `disabled-plugins/` without accidentally reactivating them. - **Safe Locking**: `agy-market` itself stays locked ON to prevent disconnecting its own panel; `workspace`, `builtin`, and host-disabled plugins show clear read-only lock states. ### 4. 5-Layer Plugin Conflict & Health Radar Dedicated **Conflicts & Diagnostics** tab (`GET /api/conflicts`) with zero-side-effect scanning and one-click fixes (`POST /api/fix-conflict`): | Layer | Severity | What It Detects | Quick Action | | :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- | | `duplicate-plugin-name` | Critical | Duplicate `plugin.json.name` across `workspace > global > builtin` precedence, pinpointing the winner and silently dropped victim directories | 1-click `--` scoped isolation rename | | `windows-symlink-ignored` | Critical | Symlinks or NTFS junctions inside `~/.gemini/config/plugins/` that Windows `GetAllPlugins` silently skips | 1-click materialize to real directory | | `mcp-collision` | Critical / Warning | Duplicate `_` keys, collisions with global `mcp_config.json`, or bare generic server names (`search`, `db`, `fetch`, etc.) | Pinpoints colliding keys & sources | | `skill-shadowing` / `agent-shadowing` | Warning | Overlapping `skills/*/SKILL.md` or `agents/*.md` across active plugins, `~/.gemini/config/skills/*`, and built-in reserved names | Shows full override chain | | `host-enhancement-overlap` | Info | Two or more active plugins simultaneously using `app-asar` or `cdp` host enhancements | Advisory to disable legacy duplicate | ### 5. Action-Triggered Restart & Reload Prompts Cards and the Detail Drawer stay clutter-free without static restart chips. Activation prompts appear **only after an install, update, batch update succeeds** (or when a Windows disable retires a locked binary): - **Declarative Skills / Global Rules (`instant`)**: Hot-reloads immediately with no restart required. - **Sidebar Panel / MCP / Hooks (`reload-pane`)**: Prompts to reopen the Sidebar panel or refresh MCP after update/install completes. - **`app.asar` / First-Time `cdp` / Retired Locked Binaries (`host-restart`)**: Displays a clear banner reminding you to restart Antigravity for changes to take full effect. ### 6. Built-In GitHub Discussions Integration - Every plugin Detail Drawer includes a **Discussions** tab (`GET /api/discussions`) that detects whether Discussions are enabled on the repository without needing a token and provides direct links to browse or start a thread. - Optionally configuring a personal GitHub Token in Settings (stored locally in `prefs.json` with `0600` permissions; never logged or persisted in caches) loads the latest 10 repository discussions directly inside the Sidebar panel. ### 7. Dual-Mirror China Acceleration & SHA-256 Tamper-Proof Installs - **Three-Tier Live Catalog Resolution (No Stale Bundled Snapshot)**: 1. **Custom Feeds**: User/team static `index.json` URLs configured in `prefs.json` take highest priority. 2. **Primary Channel (GitHub Pages + `gh-pages` Raw Fallback)**: Conditional `ETag` (`If-None-Match`) / `If-Modified-Since` requests achieve `<50ms` `304 Not Modified` cache hits. 3. **Automatic Mainland China Mirror Fallback**: If GitHub Pages times out (`> 3.5s`) or fails, streams the pure-JSON `@agy-market/catalog` transport package from `registry.npmmirror.com` or `mirrors.cloud.tencent.com/npm` in memory; falls back to disk cache when offline. - **Language-Agnostic & Tamper-Proof**: npm is used **strictly** as a JSON mirror CDN for catalog metadata—listed plugins do **not** need to be npm or JavaScript projects. Optional GitHub Release mirror prefixes are supported safely because every tarball is streamed and verified against the authoritative catalog `sha256` before extraction (`INTEGRITY_SHA256_MISMATCH` aborts immediately on any altered byte). --- ## 🚀 One-Line Bootstrap Install > Requires **Node.js >= 22.0.0** (zero runtime npm dependencies), or use the zero-npm OS installers below. - **Node / `npx` (Cross-Platform, Recommended)**: ```bash npx agy-market@latest ``` - **Windows PowerShell (Zero npm, SHA-256 Verified + Catalog Fallback)**: ```powershell irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/azwosile/agy-market/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex ``` - **macOS / Linux Shell (Zero npm, SHA-256 Verified + Catalog Fallback)**: ```sh curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/azwosile/agy-market/main/scripts/install.sh | sh ``` Once installed in Antigravity: - Open the Sidebar Panel: click `[AGY Market](sidecar://agy-market/market_pane/)` in chat, or open **Sidebar (`+`) → `Plugins` → `AGY Market`**. - Manage on Native Customizations Page: `[AGY Market](customization://agy-market)` --- ## 🏷️ Transparent Capability Badges & Update Guard Every plugin surfaces static capability badges beside the Install button before installation: | Badge ID | Default Label | Description | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `declarative-only` | `🟢 Declarative Skill` | Pure `skills/` or `agents/` markdown; zero background processes or hooks | | `global-rules` | `🔵 Global Rules (~N tok)` | Includes `rules/*.md` active in prompt context while enabled, with token estimate | | `sidecar-ui` | `🟣 Sidebar Panel` | Provides a visual interactive panel in the right Sidebar | | `mcp-stdio` | `🟠 Local MCP Process` | Spawns a local stdio MCP server defined in `mcp_config.json` | | `mcp-remote` | `🌐 Remote MCP Service` | Connects to an external HTTPS MCP endpoint (domains listed transparently) | | `lifecycle-hooks` | `🔶 Lifecycle Hooks` | Registers session/tool lifecycle hooks via `hooks.json` | | `host-enhancement` | `💡 Host UI Enhancement` | Uses local CDP bridge or `app.asar` workbench enhancements (glass skins, companion widgets); fully permitted, gentle notice only | - **Capability-Escalation Confirmation**: Updating a plugin that adds newly introduced privilege badges or remote MCP domains pauses for explicit user approval before syncing and updating `.agy-market-receipt.json`. - **Dual-Track Discovery**: Track 1 verified plugins appear by default; opting into **Track 2 Experimental Topic Discovery** automatically enforces `--` double-hyphen isolation. --- ## 🛠️ CLI Commands & Local Development ### CLI (`bin/agy-market.mjs`) ```bash # Install or update AGY Market (optional --dest ) npx agy-market install # List local installed plugins, config/data paths & market receipts (--json supported) npx agy-market status npx agy-market status --json # Run health diagnostics (Node >= 22, real directory check, 10-field manifest purity, built UI) & sweep retired Windows binaries npx agy-market doctor ``` ### Build & Test From Source ```powershell # Build single-file offline-capable Sidebar UI (sidecars/market_pane/index.html) & static showcase npm run build # Copy real plugin bundle into ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-market (never symlinks/junctions) npm run install:local # Verify local installation health node ./bin/agy-market.mjs doctor # Pack deterministic release tarball (dist/agy-market.tar.gz + .sha256) npm run pack:release # Run unit & integration tests npm test ``` --- ## 🔒 Security & Host Redlines - **Never Writes `~/.gemini/config/config.json`**: Read-only inspection only; Vault Parking handles enable/disable cleanly. - **Never Creates Symlinks / NTFS Junctions**: Every install performs real directory/file copies and rejects archive traversal (`..`) and symlink/hardlink tar entries. - **Windows Lock-Safe Sync & Crash Recovery**: Stages outside `~/.gemini/config/plugins/` in `${PLUGIN_DATA}/staging/`, journals transitions via `pending-journal.json` (auto-recovered 8s after boot), renames locked binaries to `*.old.`, and sweeps them via `retired-binaries.json`. - **Loopback-Only Local Server & CSRF Guard**: Listens strictly on `127.0.0.1` (ephemeral port) and enforces a 256-bit random `X-Sidecar-Token` + `Origin` check on all `POST`/`DELETE` routes. --- ## 📚 Guides, Architecture & Contributing - **[📖 Plugin Submission Guide (`docs/SUBMISSION_GUIDE.md`)](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market-catalog/blob/main/docs/SUBMISSION_GUIDE.md)** — Full Track-1 single-YAML & Track-2 auto-discovery submission tutorial - Read **[`AGENTS.md`](./AGENTS.md)** and **[`../AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md)** before modifying any module in this repository. To submit plugins, visit **[`azwosile/agy-market-catalog`](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market-catalog)**. ## 📄 License [MIT License](./LICENSE)

# AGY Market · 反重力插件市场 (`agy-market`) **Google Antigravity 社区插件市场** Sidebar 侧边栏界面 · GitHub 完整链接预检安装 · ⭐ 插件收藏栏 · 已安装实时搜索筛选 · 一键直开 Sidebar 侧边栏 · 卡片原生启停滑块 · 本地插件冲突检查 · 双通道中国镜像加速 · SHA-256 校验 **简体中文** · [English](./README.en.md) · **[📖 申请收录插件教程](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market-catalog/blob/main/docs/SUBMISSION_GUIDE.md)** · [插件目录仓库](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market-catalog) · [架构规范](./AGENTS.md)
--- > **仓库边界说明**：本仓库（[`azwosile/agy-market`](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market)）包含 **AGY Market** 客户端 Sidebar 侧边栏、Windows 锁安全安装器、`npx agy-market` 一行安装 CLI 与静态展示站（`site/`）。 > > 如需将你的插件收录至社区插件目录，点击市场顶部的 **`+ 申请收录插件`** 按钮或直接阅读 **[📖 申请收录插件完整教程 (`docs/SUBMISSION_GUIDE.md`)](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market-catalog/blob/main/docs/SUBMISSION_GUIDE.md)**，向 **[`azwosile/agy-market-catalog`](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market-catalog)** 提交单文件 YAML Pull Request。 --- ## ✨ 核心特性（v1.4.0） ### 1. Sidebar 侧边栏界面与导航体验 - **原生右侧 Sidebar 侧边栏**：基于 Antigravity 原生 `AUX_PANE` 扩展视图（`sidecars/market_pane/sidecar.json`），不捆绑常驻 MCP 服务，打开即用、轻量流畅。 - **顶部概览栏与插件卡片**：顶部可折叠概览栏实时展示「已收录插件 / 运行中 / 可更新 / 本地冲突」，顶栏内置 **`链接添加`**（粘贴任意 GitHub 链接预检安装）与 **`+ 申请收录插件`** 快捷入口；卡片样式适配暗色、亮色与半透明壁纸皮肤（如 Wallpaper Prism）。 - **双行标题 + 一键直达 GitHub**：点击探索卡片、收藏卡片、已安装卡片或详情抽屉的**插件标题**可直接在新窗口打开对应 GitHub 仓库，点击卡片其余区域展开详情抽屉。 - **开箱优先呈现简体中文文档**：详情抽屉请求 `/api/readme?id=...&locale=zh`，自动优先渲染目录源 `entriesZh` 或本地 `README.zh-CN.md` / `README.zh.md`，并在已安装卡片优先显示中文化简介。 - **点击「面板」一键直开目标 Sidebar 侧边栏**：移除会被 Chromium 拦截的裸 `` 链接；在宿主侧边栏内点击其他 Sidebar 插件卡片上的「面板」按钮时，直接调用宿主 `window.sidecar.ui.toggleAuxPane`（`tabType: "sidecarView"`）拉起或聚焦对应侧边栏，无需手动复制提示。 ### 2. ⭐ 插件收藏栏、已安装搜索筛选与更新失败告警 - **⭐ 插件收藏栏 & 独立「收藏」标签页**： - 每张插件卡片（探索、收藏、已安装）与详情抽屉顶部均内置 `☆` / 琥珀金 `★` 收藏按钮，点击调用 `POST /api/favorites` 原子持久化至本地 `prefs.json`（无需重复配置）。 - 收藏任意插件后，「探索」页顶部自动浮现可折叠的 **「★ 我的收藏栏」** 快捷入口；顶部导航同步提供独立 **「★ 收藏」** 标签页（`探索 · 收藏 · 已安装 · 冲突与诊断 · 源与设置`），支持全文检索与快速启停/安装。 - **`已安装` 插件实时搜索与状态筛选**： - 「已安装」视图配备实时搜索栏（支持按插件显示名、目录名或简介瞬时过滤）与状态筛选胶囊（**全部 / 已启用 / 已停用 / 可更新**），插件再多也能秒级定位。 - **更新失败显著红色告警条（绝不静默失败）**： - 当单个安装/更新、批量「全部更新」或市场自更新遇到网络中断、SHA-256 校验不匹配或文件锁异常时，页面顶部立即弹出醒目的红色告警条与错误通知，完整展示失败插件与具体错误原因，并提供一键 **「重试」** 按钮。 ### 3. 卡片底部原生「启用 / 禁用」安全停放仓滑块（Vault Parking） - **零改写 `config.json` 红线**：Antigravity 语言服务器对 `~/.gemini/config/config.json` 设有写保护。AGY Market 严守只读原则，永不改写 `config.json`，而是通过**安全停放仓（Vault Parking）**实现即时启停控制（`POST /api/toggle-plugin`）： - **滑向「禁用（OFF）」**：后端将 `~/.gemini/config/plugins/` 安全移入 `${PLUGIN_DATA}/disabled-plugins/`，宿主热监听约 1 秒内卸载对应 Skills / Rules / Hooks。 - **滑向「启用（ON）」**：后端将目录完整移回 `~/.gemini/config/plugins/` 并清理可能残留的 `"disabled": true`。 - **停放态持续可更新**：被禁用的插件仍保留在「已安装」与「探索」卡片中；对其执行版本更新时，会在 `disabled-plugins/` 内原位同步，绝不意外将其自动重新激活。 - **防误操作锁定**：`agy-market` 自身滑块保持常亮锁定（避免在市场侧边栏内把自己停用断连）；`workspace`、`builtin` 及宿主手动禁用项显示只读锁定提示。 ### 4. 本地插件冲突检查与修复 顶部内置独立 **「冲突与诊断」** 标签页（`GET /api/conflicts`），对本地已安装插件执行只读静态检查，并提供一键修复（`POST /api/fix-conflict`）： | 检测项 | 严重级别 | 检测内容 | 一键修复能力 | | :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- | | `duplicate-plugin-name` | 严重 | 跨 `workspace > global > builtin` 扫描重复 `plugin.json.name`，精确标出生效胜出方与被宿主静默丢弃的插件目录 | 一键双连字符隔离重命名（`--`） | | `windows-symlink-ignored` | 严重 | 检测 Windows 下 `~/.gemini/config/plugins/` 中被 `GetAllPlugins` 静默跳过的 NTFS Junction / 符号链接目录 | 一键实体化转为真实目录 | | `mcp-collision` | 严重 / 警告 | 检测重复 `_`、与用户全局 `mcp_config.json` 重名或裸通用服务名（如 `search`、`db`、`fetch`） | 定位冲突键名与来源文件 | | `skill-shadowing` / `agent-shadowing` | 警告 | 检测已启用插件之间的 `skills/*/SKILL.md`、`agents/*.md` 与用户全局目录或内置保留名的覆盖链 | 完整展示胜出/被覆盖链路 | | `host-enhancement-overlap` | 警告 / 提示 | 检测多个已启用插件同时修改 `app.asar`（**警告**，需注意文件补丁叠加风险）或同时使用 `cdp` 宿主界面增强（**提示**，通常可共存） | 提示评估是否停用其一 | ### 5. 按需触发的智能重启 / 重开侧边栏提示 卡片与详情抽屉保持视觉清爽，不再堆叠静态「需重启 / 免重启」标签；**仅当安装、更新、批量更新成功或 Windows 禁用遇到文件锁时**，依据插件能力与实时句柄状态按需弹出精准提示： - **纯声明式技能 / 全局规则（`instant`）**：热加载即刻生效，免重启无打扰。 - **含 Sidebar 侧边栏 / MCP / 钩子（`reload-pane`）**：更新或安装成功后提示重开侧边栏或刷新 MCP。 - **含 `app.asar` / 首次配置 `cdp` / Windows 锁定退避文件（`host-restart`）**：操作完成后弹出顶部横幅提醒重启 Antigravity 生效。 ### 6. 内置 GitHub Discussions 社区讨论 - 插件详情抽屉内置 **「讨论」** 标签页（`GET /api/discussions`），无需登录或 Token 即可自动探测目标仓库是否开启 GitHub Discussions，并提供一键直达讨论区与发帖入口。 - 如在面板设置中可选填入个人 GitHub Token（仅以 `0600` 权限保存在本地 `prefs.json`，绝不写入缓存文件或日志），即可在侧边栏直接拉取并浏览该插件最新 10 条社区讨论。 ### 7. 双通道中国大陆镜像加速与 SHA-256 校验 - **三级目录源自动解析（零内置陈旧快照）**： 1. **自定义团队/个人源**：优先合并 `prefs.json` 中配置的静态 `index.json` 订阅源。 2. **全球主通道（GitHub Pages + `gh-pages` Raw 回退）**：支持 `ETag`（`If-None-Match`）/ `If-Modified-Since` 条件请求，`304 Not Modified` 毫秒级复用本地缓存。 3. **中国大陆自动镜像回退**：主源超时（`> 3.5s`）或不可达时，自动切换拉取纯 JSON 数据包 `@agy-market/catalog`（依次尝试 `registry.npmmirror.com` 与 `mirrors.cloud.tencent.com/npm`），在内存流式解包目录索引；完全离线时自动降级为本地磁盘缓存。 - **语言无关与 SHA-256 校验下载**：`@agy-market/catalog` 仅将 npm 用作静态 JSON CDN，被收录的插件**无需是 npm 包或 JS 项目**。支持配置自定义 GitHub Release 镜像加速前缀，所有 `.tar.gz` 安装包在解压前都会比对目录源中的 `sha256` 摘要，不匹配时立即触发 `INTEGRITY_SHA256_MISMATCH` 中止安装。 --- ## 🚀 一行快速安装 > 运行环境要求：**Node.js >= 22.0.0**（零外部 npm 运行时依赖）；或使用下方免 npm 系统脚本。 ### 方式一：Node / `npx`（推荐，全平台通用） ```bash npx agy-market@latest ``` ### 方式二：Windows PowerShell（免 npm，内置 SHA-256 校验与目录回退） ```powershell irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/azwosile/agy-market/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex ``` ### 方式三：macOS / Linux Shell（免 npm，内置 SHA-256 校验与目录回退） ```sh curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/azwosile/agy-market/main/scripts/install.sh | sh ``` ### 安装后如何在 Antigravity 中打开？ - 在 Antigravity 对话中发送「打开插件市场」，或点击聊天药丸：`[AGY Market](sidecar://agy-market/market_pane/)` - 也可直接点击右侧 Sidebar 辅助栏顶部 **`+` → `Plugins` → `AGY Market`** 打开。 - 如需在 Antigravity 原生定制页管理本插件，可点击对话药丸：`[AGY Market](customization://agy-market)` --- ## 🔗 通过 GitHub 完整链接添加插件 无需等待目录收录，v1.4.0 起可直接通过 GitHub 完整链接预检并安装任意社区插件，自动兼容单插件子目录、Monorepo 多插件目录及无 Release Tag 的默认分支提交。 ### 方式一：UI 顶栏「链接添加」按钮（两步式预检安装） 1. 打开 AGY Market 侧边栏，点击顶栏右上角 **`链接添加`** 按钮（或在探索页搜索无结果时点击 **「通过 GitHub 链接添加」**）。 2. 粘贴任意 GitHub 完整链接并点击 **「解析预检」**，支持以下链接形式： - 仓库主页：`https://github.com//`（自动按最新 Release → Git Tag → 默认分支提交解析） - 分支或子目录：`https://github.com///tree//` - 清单文件直链：`https://github.com///blob//[/]plugin.json` - 指定 Release / 标签 / 归档直链：`/releases/tag/`、`/releases/latest`、`/releases/download//.tar.gz`、`/archive/...tar.gz` 3. 后端在插件外置暂存目录下载归档并完成本地静态检查： - **自动识别布局**：兼容根目录 `plugin.json`、`.antigravity-plugin/plugin.json`、唯一命名子目录自动定位（如 `agy-capsule/plugin.json`）；若仓库为 Monorepo 多插件布局（如 `plugins/*`、`.agents/plugins/*`），弹窗将列出全部候选子目录供直接点选。 - **预检与安全拦截**：安装前明确展示版本号或短 `commitSha`、SHA-256 摘要、能力徽章及安装方式（原生目录名或 `--` 隔离目录名）；若仓库不含有效 `plugin.json` 或命中路径穿越、软硬链接、规则越界注入等安全规则，将提示原因并清理暂存目录，不产生残留。 - **已安装联动更新**：通过链接安装的插件在「已安装」页带有 `GitHub URL` 来源标签，支持滑块启停、详情抽屉查看，并可按 Release Tag 或分支最新 Commit SHA 一键检查更新。 ### 方式二：CLI `npx agy-market add ` ```bash # 预检并交互确认安装任意 GitHub 插件仓库（兼容子目录与无 Tag 默认分支） npx agy-market add https://github.com// # 指定 Monorepo 子目录，使用 -- 隔离目录名并跳过交互确认 npx agy-market add https://github.com// --subpath plugins/ --isolate --yes # 可选参数：--replace（替换同源目录）、--dest 、--mirror 、--token 、--json npx agy-market add https://github.com///tree/main/ --yes --json ``` --- ## 🏷️ 能力徽章与升级权限增量确认 所有插件在点击「安装」前都会展示静态扫描生成的能力徽章： | 徽章标识 | 默认中文标签 | 含义说明 | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `declarative-only` | `🟢 纯声明式技能` | 仅包含 `skills/` 或 `agents/` 声明文档，无后台常驻进程或钩子 | | `global-rules` | `🔵 常驻规则 (~N tok)` | 包含启用期间常驻注入上下文的 `rules/*.md`，清晰标出预估 Token 占用 | | `sidecar-ui` | `🟣 Sidebar 侧边栏` | 在右侧 Sidebar 辅助栏提供可视化交互界面 | | `mcp-stdio` | `🟠 本地 MCP 进程` | 通过 `mcp_config.json` 启动本地 Stdio 工具服务进程 | | `mcp-remote` | `🌐 远程 MCP 服务` | 连接外部 HTTPS MCP 服务端点（展示目标域名） | | `lifecycle-hooks` | `🔶 生命周期钩子 (Hooks)` | 通过 `hooks.json` 订阅会话或工具调用生命周期事件 | | `host-enhancement` | `💡 宿主界面增强` | 使用本地 CDP 调试桥或 `app.asar` 工作台界面增强（如毛玻璃皮肤、桌面挂件），社区完全欢迎，仅温和提示 | - --- > **仓库边界说明**：本仓库（[`azwosile/agy-market`](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market)）包含 **AGY Market** 客户端 Sidebar 侧边栏、Windows 锁安全安装器、`npx agy-market` 一行安装 CLI 与静态展示站（`site/`）。 > > 如需将你的插件收录至社区插件目录，点击市场顶部的 **`+ 申请收录插件`** 按钮或直接阅读 **[📖 申请收录插件完整教程 (`docs/SUBMISSION_GUIDE.md`)](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market-catalog/blob/main/docs/SUBMISSION_GUIDE.md)**，向 **[`azwosile/agy-market-catalog`](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market-catalog)** 提交单文件 YAML Pull Request。 --- ## ✨ 核心特性（v1.4.0） ### 1. Sidebar 侧边栏界面与导航体验 - **原生右侧 Sidebar 侧边栏**：基于 Antigravity 原生 `AUX_PANE` 扩展视图（`sidecars/market_pane/sidecar.json`），不捆绑常驻 MCP 服务，打开即用、轻量流畅。 - **顶部概览栏与插件卡片**：顶部可折叠概览栏实时展示「已收录插件 / 运行中 / 可更新 / 本地冲突」，顶栏内置 **`链接添加`**（粘贴任意 GitHub 链接预检安装）与 **`+ 申请收录插件`** 快捷入口；卡片样式适配暗色、亮色与半透明壁纸皮肤（如 Wallpaper Prism）。 - **双行标题 + 一键直达 GitHub**：点击探索卡片、收藏卡片、已安装卡片或详情抽屉的**插件标题**可直接在新窗口打开对应 GitHub 仓库，点击卡片其余区域展开详情抽屉。 - **开箱优先呈现简体中文文档**：详情抽屉请求 `/api/readme?id=...&locale=zh`，自动优先渲染目录源 `entriesZh` 或本地 `README.zh-CN.md` / `README.zh.md`，并在已安装卡片优先显示中文化简介。 - **点击「面板」一键直开目标 Sidebar 侧边栏**：移除会被 Chromium 拦截的裸 `` 链接；在宿主侧边栏内点击其他 Sidebar 插件卡片上的「面板」按钮时，直接调用宿主 `window.sidecar.ui.toggleAuxPane`（`tabType: "sidecarView"`）拉起或聚焦对应侧边栏，无需手动复制提示。 ### 2. ⭐ 插件收藏栏、已安装搜索筛选与更新失败告警 - **⭐ 插件收藏栏 & 独立「收藏」标签页**： - 每张插件卡片（探索、收藏、已安装）与详情抽屉顶部均内置 `☆` / 琥珀金 `★` 收藏按钮，点击调用 `POST /api/favorites` 原子持久化至本地 `prefs.json`（无需重复配置）。 - 收藏任意插件后，「探索」页顶部自动浮现可折叠的 **「★ 我的收藏栏」** 快捷入口；顶部导航同步提供独立 **「★ 收藏」** 标签页（`探索 · 收藏 · 已安装 · 冲突与诊断 · 源与设置`），支持全文检索与快速启停/安装。 - **`已安装` 插件实时搜索与状态筛选**： - 「已安装」视图配备实时搜索栏（支持按插件显示名、目录名或简介瞬时过滤）与状态筛选胶囊（**全部 / 已启用 / 已停用 / 可更新**），插件再多也能秒级定位。 - **更新失败显著红色告警条（绝不静默失败）**： - 当单个安装/更新、批量「全部更新」或市场自更新遇到网络中断、SHA-256 校验不匹配或文件锁异常时，页面顶部立即弹出醒目的红色告警条与错误通知，完整展示失败插件与具体错误原因，并提供一键 **「重试」** 按钮。 ### 3. 卡片底部原生「启用 / 禁用」安全停放仓滑块（Vault Parking） - **零改写 `config.json` 红线**：Antigravity 语言服务器对 `~/.gemini/config/config.json` 设有写保护。AGY Market 严守只读原则，永不改写 `config.json`，而是通过**安全停放仓（Vault Parking）**实现即时启停控制（`POST /api/toggle-plugin`）： - **滑向「禁用（OFF）」**：后端将 `~/.gemini/config/plugins/` 安全移入 `${PLUGIN_DATA}/disabled-plugins/`，宿主热监听约 1 秒内卸载对应 Skills / Rules / Hooks。 - **滑向「启用（ON）」**：后端将目录完整移回 `~/.gemini/config/plugins/` 并清理可能残留的 `"disabled": true`。 - **停放态持续可更新**：被禁用的插件仍保留在「已安装」与「探索」卡片中；对其执行版本更新时，会在 `disabled-plugins/` 内原位同步，绝不意外将其自动重新激活。 - **防误操作锁定**：`agy-market` 自身滑块保持常亮锁定（避免在市场侧边栏内把自己停用断连）；`workspace`、`builtin` 及宿主手动禁用项显示只读锁定提示。 ### 4. 本地插件冲突检查与修复 顶部内置独立 **「冲突与诊断」** 标签页（`GET /api/conflicts`），对本地已安装插件执行只读静态检查，并提供一键修复（`POST /api/fix-conflict`）： | 检测项 | 严重级别 | 检测内容 | 一键修复能力 | | :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- | | `duplicate-plugin-name` | 严重 | 跨 `workspace > global > builtin` 扫描重复 `plugin.json.name`，精确标出生效胜出方与被宿主静默丢弃的插件目录 | 一键双连字符隔离重命名（`--`） | | `windows-symlink-ignored` | 严重 | 检测 Windows 下 `~/.gemini/config/plugins/` 中被 `GetAllPlugins` 静默跳过的 NTFS Junction / 符号链接目录 | 一键实体化转为真实目录 | | `mcp-collision` | 严重 / 警告 | 检测重复 `_`、与用户全局 `mcp_config.json` 重名或裸通用服务名（如 `search`、`db`、`fetch`） | 定位冲突键名与来源文件 | | `skill-shadowing` / `agent-shadowing` | 警告 | 检测已启用插件之间的 `skills/*/SKILL.md`、`agents/*.md` 与用户全局目录或内置保留名的覆盖链 | 完整展示胜出/被覆盖链路 | | `host-enhancement-overlap` | 警告 / 提示 | 检测多个已启用插件同时修改 `app.asar`（**警告**，需注意文件补丁叠加风险）或同时使用 `cdp` 宿主界面增强（**提示**，通常可共存） | 提示评估是否停用其一 | ### 5. 按需触发的智能重启 / 重开侧边栏提示 卡片与详情抽屉保持视觉清爽，不再堆叠静态「需重启 / 免重启」标签；**仅当安装、更新、批量更新成功或 Windows 禁用遇到文件锁时**，依据插件能力与实时句柄状态按需弹出精准提示： - **纯声明式技能 / 全局规则（`instant`）**：热加载即刻生效，免重启无打扰。 - **含 Sidebar 侧边栏 / MCP / 钩子（`reload-pane`）**：更新或安装成功后提示重开侧边栏或刷新 MCP。 - **含 `app.asar` / 首次配置 `cdp` / Windows 锁定退避文件（`host-restart`）**：操作完成后弹出顶部横幅提醒重启 Antigravity 生效。 ### 6. 内置 GitHub Discussions 社区讨论 - 插件详情抽屉内置 **「讨论」** 标签页（`GET /api/discussions`），无需登录或 Token 即可自动探测目标仓库是否开启 GitHub Discussions，并提供一键直达讨论区与发帖入口。 - 如在面板设置中可选填入个人 GitHub Token（仅以 `0600` 权限保存在本地 `prefs.json`，绝不写入缓存文件或日志），即可在侧边栏直接拉取并浏览该插件最新 10 条社区讨论。 ### 7. 双通道中国大陆镜像加速与 SHA-256 校验 - 仓库主页：`https://github.com//`（自动按最新 Release → Git Tag → 默认分支提交解析） - 分支或子目录：`https://github.com///tree//` - 清单文件直链：`https://github.com///blob//[/]plugin.json` - 指定 Release / 标签 / 归档直链：`/releases/tag/`、`/releases/latest`、`/releases/download//.tar.gz`、`/archive/...tar.gz` 3. 后端在插件外置暂存目录下载归档并完成本地静态检查： - **自动识别布局**：兼容根目录 `plugin.json`、`.antigravity-plugin/plugin.json`、唯一命名子目录自动定位（如 `agy-capsule/plugin.json`）；若仓库为 Monorepo 多插件布局（如 `plugins/*`、`.agents/plugins/*`），弹窗将列出全部候选子目录供直接点选。 - **预检与安全拦截**：安装前明确展示版本号或短 `commitSha`、SHA-256 摘要、能力徽章及安装方式（原生目录名或 `--` 隔离目录名）；若仓库不含有效 `plugin.json` 或命中路径穿越、软硬链接、规则越界注入等安全规则，将提示原因并清理暂存目录，不产生残留。 - **已安装联动更新**：通过链接安装的插件在「已安装」页带有 `GitHub URL` 来源标签，支持滑块启停、详情抽屉查看，并可按 Release Tag 或分支最新 Commit SHA 一键检查更新。 ### 方式二：CLI `npx agy-market add ` ```bash # 预检并交互确认安装任意 GitHub 插件仓库（兼容子目录与无 Tag 默认分支） npx agy-market add https://github.com// # 指定 Monorepo 子目录，使用 -- 隔离目录名并跳过交互确认 npx agy-market add https://github.com// --subpath plugins/ --isolate --yes # 可选参数：--replace（替换同源目录）、--dest 、--mirror 、--token 、--json npx agy-market add https://github.com///tree/main/ --yes --json ``` --- ## 🏷️ 能力徽章与升级权限增量确认 所有插件在点击「安装」前都会展示静态扫描生成的能力徽章： | 徽章标识 | 默认中文标签 | 含义说明 | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `declarative-only` | `🟢 纯声明式技能` | 仅包含 `skills/` 或 `agents/` 声明文档，无后台常驻进程或钩子 | | `global-rules` | `🔵 常驻规则 (~N tok)` | 包含启用期间常驻注入上下文的 `rules/*.md`，清晰标出预估 Token 占用 | | `sidecar-ui` | `🟣 Sidebar 侧边栏` | 在右侧 Sidebar 辅助栏提供可视化交互界面 | | `mcp-stdio` | `🟠 本地 MCP 进程` | 通过 `mcp_config.json` 启动本地 Stdio 工具服务进程 | | `mcp-remote` | `🌐 远程 MCP 服务` | 连接外部 HTTPS MCP 服务端点（展示目标域名） | | `lifecycle-hooks` | `🔶 生命周期钩子 (Hooks)` | 通过 `hooks.json` 订阅会话或工具调用生命周期事件 | | `host-enhancement` | `💡 宿主界面增强` | 使用本地 CDP 调试桥或 `app.asar` 工作台界面增强（如毛玻璃皮肤、桌面挂件），社区完全欢迎，仅温和提示 | - **升级能力增量确认（T+N Escalation Guard）**：当插件从旧版本升级并**新增**之前未授予的能力类别或新的远程 MCP 域名时，自动弹出增量对比确认框，经用户确认后再同步写入并更新 `.agy-market-receipt.json`。 - **双轨插件支持**：默认展示 Track 1 已验证目录；在设置中可按需开启 **Track 2 实验性 Topic 自动发现**（自动强制 `--` 双连字符命名隔离，避免同名冲突）。 --- ## 🛠️ CLI 诊断与本地开发命令 ### 用户 CLI 命令（`bin/agy-market.mjs`） ```bash # 安装或更新 AGY Market 到默认插件目录（支持 --dest 自定义路径） npx agy-market install # 通过任意 GitHub 完整链接预检并安装插件（支持 --subpath / --isolate / --replace / --yes / --dest / --mirror / --token / --json） npx agy-market add # 查看当前配置路径、数据目录及所有已安装插件状态（支持 --json 机器可读输出） npx agy-market status npx agy-market status --json # 运行安装检查（校验 Node >= 22、非符号链接实体目录、10 字段清单纯净度、UI 产物）并清理 Windows 残留 *.old. 文件 npx agy-market doctor ``` ### 源码构建与本地开发 ```powershell # 1. 编译离线可用的单文件 Sidebar UI（sidecars/market_pane/index.html）及静态展示站 npm run build # 2. 以真实文件复制方式安装至 ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-market（严禁符号链接 / NTFS Junction） npm run install:local # 3. 执行安装检查 node ./bin/agy-market.mjs doctor # 4. 打包确定性 GitHub Release 压缩包与校验文件（dist/agy-market.tar.gz + .sha256） npm run pack:release # 5. 运行全量单元测试与跨仓集成测试 npm test ``` --- ## 🔒 安全与宿主工程红线 - **绝不写入 `~/.gemini/config/config.json`**：仅只读解析插件启停状态，杜绝覆盖用户登录态与设置。 - **绝不创建符号链接 / NTFS Junction**：Windows 下 Antigravity 会静默跳过符号链接插件，所有安装/更新均为实体目录复制，且解包器硬性拦截 `..` 路径穿越与软硬链接。 - **Windows 锁安全原位更新与崩溃恢复**：先在插件外置 `${PLUGIN_DATA}/staging/` 解包并写入 `pending-journal.json`（启动 8 秒自动恢复中断事务），对 Windows 锁定中的二进制采用 `.old.` 改名退避并在下次启动时由 `retired-binaries.json` 自动垃圾回收。 - **严格环回与 CSRF 鉴权**：本地 HTTP 服务仅绑定 `127.0.0.1` 随机端口，所有写入/变更接口（`POST` / `DELETE`）强制校验 256-bit 随机 `X-Sidecar-Token` 与 `Origin` 头。 --- ## 📚 架构文档与收录指引 - **[📖 申请收录插件完整教程 (`docs/SUBMISSION_GUIDE.md`)](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market-catalog/blob/main/docs/SUBMISSION_GUIDE.md)** — 一文搞定 Track 1 单文件 YAML 提交流程与 Track 2 免 PR 自动发现 - **[`AGENTS.md`](./AGENTS.md)** — 客户端工程规范、宿主红线与锁安全安装器设计 - **[`../AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md)** — 跨仓库协议、统一 JSON Schema 与双层防冲突规范 - **[`azwosile/agy-market-catalog`](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market-catalog)** — 插件目录仓库与自动化收录管线 ## 📄 许可证 [MIT License](./LICENSE)

# AGY Market (`agy-market`) **Community Plugin Marketplace for Google Antigravity** Sidebar Panel UI · GitHub URL Preflight Installer · ⭐ Pinned Favorites Shelf & Tab · Live Installed Search & Filters · One-Click Sidebar Launcher · Native Vault-Parking Toggle Sliders · Local Conflict Checks · Dual-Mirror China Acceleration · SHA-256 Verified Installs [简体中文](./README.md) · **English** · **[📖 Submit a Plugin Guide](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market-catalog/blob/main/docs/SUBMISSION_GUIDE.md)** · [Plugin Catalog](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market-catalog) · [Architecture Spec](./AGENTS.md)
--- > **Repository Boundary**: This repository ([`azwosile/agy-market`](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market)) houses the **AGY Market** Sidebar client plugin, Windows lock-safe tarball installer, `npx agy-market` bootstrap CLI, and static web showcase (`site/`). > > To list your plugin in the community catalog, click **`+ Submit Plugin`** (`+ 申请收录插件`) in AGY Market or follow the step-by-step **[📖 Plugin Submission Guide (`docs/SUBMISSION_GUIDE.md`)](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market-catalog/blob/main/docs/SUBMISSION_GUIDE.md)** to open a single-YAML Pull Request in **[`azwosile/agy-market-catalog`](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market-catalog)**. --- ## ✨ Highlights (v1.4.0) ### 1. Sidebar Panel UI & Navigation - **Native Right Sidebar Panel**: Runs inside Antigravity's native `AUX_PANE` extension view (`sidecars/market_pane/sidecar.json`) with no bundled MCP servers, keeping the panel lightweight and responsive. - **Overview Strip & Plugin Cards**: Collapsible top overview strip displays catalog stats (*Indexed / Active / Updates / Local Conflicts*) alongside quick **`Add URL`** (`链接添加`) and **`+ Submit Plugin`** actions. Card styles adapt across Dark, Light, and translucent wallpaper skins (such as Wallpaper Prism). - **2-Line Titles + Clickable GitHub Links**: Clicking any **plugin title** in cards or the Detail Drawer opens its GitHub repository directly in a new window, while clicking the card body opens the Detail Drawer. - **Multilingual README Drawer**: Queries `/api/readme?id=...&locale=zh|en`, preferring localized `entriesZh` / `entriesEn` from the catalog (or local `README.zh-CN.md` / `README.zh.md` for installed plugins) and rendering localized descriptions on installed cards. - **Direct One-Click Sidebar Launcher**: Replaces raw `` links blocked inside isolated iframes. Inside the host panel, clicking a sibling plugin's **Panel** button invokes host `window.sidecar.ui.toggleAuxPane` (`tabType: "sidecarView"`) directly to open or focus its Sidebar panel—no manual copy prompts. ### 2. ⭐ Favorites Shelf & Tab, Installed Search/Filters & Update Error Alerts - **⭐ Pinned Favorites Shelf & Dedicated Favorites Tab**: - Every plugin card (Discover, Favorites, Installed) and the Detail Drawer header feature a tactile star button (`☆` / glowing amber `★`) backed by `POST /api/favorites` persisted atomically in `prefs.json`. - When 1 or more plugins are starred, a collapsible **Pinned Favorites Shelf (`★ Favorites`)** appears above the Discover grid, complemented by a dedicated **`★ Favorites`** top navigation tab (`Discover · Favorites · Installed · Conflicts & Diagnostics · Sources & Settings`). - **Live Search & Status Filters in `Installed` View**: - The **Installed** view includes a live search bar (matching display name, directory name, or description) and quick status filter pills (**All / Enabled / Disabled / Updatable**) for fast management at scale. - **High-Visibility Update Error Alert Banner (Zero Silent Failures)**: - Whenever an install/update, batch **Update All**, or self-update fails due to network errors, SHA-256 mismatch, or permissions, a dismissible red error banner and error toast surface the affected plugin, exact failure reason, and a one-click **Retry** button. ### 3. Native Card-Footer Enable / Disable Slider (Vault Parking) - **Zero Writes to `config.json`**: Antigravity's Language Server write-protects `~/.gemini/config/config.json`. AGY Market reads `config.json` strictly read-only and powers live toggling via **Vault Parking** (`POST /api/toggle-plugin`): - **Toggle OFF (Disable)**: Moves `~/.gemini/config/plugins/` cleanly into `${PLUGIN_DATA}/disabled-plugins/`. Host hot-watch unloads its Skills / Rules / Hooks within ~1 second. - **Toggle ON (Enable)**: Moves the folder back into `~/.gemini/config/plugins/` and removes any stale `"disabled": true` flag. - **Update While Parked**: Disabled plugins remain visible in *Installed* and *Discover* tabs and update in-place inside `disabled-plugins/` without accidentally reactivating them. - **Safe Locking**: `agy-market` itself stays locked ON to prevent disconnecting its own panel; `workspace`, `builtin`, and host-disabled plugins show clear read-only lock states. ### 4. Local Plugin Conflict Checks & Fixes Dedicated **Conflicts & Diagnostics** tab (`GET /api/conflicts`) with read-only static conflict checks and one-click fixes (`POST /api/fix-conflict`): | Check | Severity | What It Detects | Quick Action | | :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- | | `duplicate-plugin-name` | Critical | Duplicate `plugin.json.name` across `workspace > global > builtin` precedence, pinpointing the winner and silently dropped victim directories | 1-click `--` scoped isolation rename | | `windows-symlink-ignored` | Critical | Symlinks or NTFS junctions inside `~/.gemini/config/plugins/` that Windows `GetAllPlugins` silently skips | 1-click materialize to real directory | | `mcp-collision` | Critical / Warning | Duplicate `_` keys, collisions with global `mcp_config.json`, or bare generic server names (`search`, `db`, `fetch`, etc.) | Pinpoints colliding keys & sources | | `skill-shadowing` / `agent-shadowing` | Warning | Overlapping `skills/*/SKILL.md` or `agents/*.md` across active plugins, `~/.gemini/config/skills/*`, and built-in reserved names | Shows full override chain | | `host-enhancement-overlap` | Warning / Info | Two or more active plugins modifying `app.asar` (**Warning**, patch overlap risk) or using `cdp` UI enhancements (**Info**, generally compatible) | Advisory to review or disable duplicate | ### 5. Action-Triggered Restart & Reload Prompts Cards and the Detail Drawer stay clutter-free without static restart chips. Activation prompts appear **only after an install, update, batch update succeeds** (or when a Windows disable retires a locked binary): - **Declarative Skills / Global Rules (`instant`)**: Hot-reloads immediately with no restart required. - **Sidebar Panel / MCP / Hooks (`reload-pane`)**: Prompts to reopen the Sidebar panel or refresh MCP after update/install completes. - **`app.asar` / First-Time `cdp` / Retired Locked Binaries (`host-restart`)**: Displays a clear banner reminding you to restart Antigravity for changes to take full effect. ### 6. Built-In GitHub Discussions Integration - Every plugin Detail Drawer includes a **Discussions** tab (`GET /api/discussions`) that detects whether Discussions are enabled on the repository without needing a token and provides direct links to browse or start a thread. - Optionally configuring a personal GitHub Token in Settings (stored locally in `prefs.json` with `0600` permissions; never logged or persisted in caches) loads the latest 10 repository discussions directly inside the Sidebar panel. ### 7. Dual-Mirror China Acceleration & SHA-256 Verified Installs - **Three-Tier Live Catalog Resolution (No Stale Bundled Snapshot)**: 1. **Custom Feeds**: User/team static `index.json` URLs configured in `prefs.json` take highest priority. 2. **Primary Channel (GitHub Pages + `gh-pages` Raw Fallback)**: Conditional `ETag` (`If-None-Match`) / `If-Modified-Since` requests achieve `<50ms` `304 Not Modified` cache hits. 3. **Automatic Mainland China Mirror Fallback**: If GitHub Pages times out (`> 3.5s`) or fails, streams the pure-JSON `@agy-market/catalog` transport package from `registry.npmmirror.com` or `mirrors.cloud.tencent.com/npm` in memory; falls back to disk cache when offline. - **Language-Agnostic & SHA-256 Verified**: npm is used **strictly** as a JSON mirror CDN for catalog metadata—listed plugins do **not** need to be npm or JavaScript projects. Optional GitHub Release mirror prefixes are supported safely because every tarball is streamed and verified against the catalog `sha256` digest before extraction (`INTEGRITY_SHA256_MISMATCH` aborts immediately on any mismatch). --- ## 🚀 One-Line Bootstrap Install > Requires **Node.js >= 22.0.0** (zero runtime npm dependencies), or use the zero-npm OS installers below. - **Node / `npx` (Cross-Platform, Recommended)**: ```bash npx agy-market@latest ``` - **Windows PowerShell (Zero npm, SHA-256 Verified + Catalog Fallback)**: ```powershell irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/azwosile/agy-market/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex ``` - **macOS / Linux Shell (Zero npm, SHA-256 Verified + Catalog Fallback)**: ```sh curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/azwosile/agy-market/main/scripts/install.sh | sh ``` Once installed in Antigravity: - Open the Sidebar Panel: click `[AGY Market](sidecar://agy-market/market_pane/)` in chat, or open **Sidebar (`+`) → `Plugins` → `AGY Market`**. - Manage on Native Customizations Page: `[AGY Market](customization://agy-market)` --- ## 🔗 Adding Plugins from Any GitHub URL Starting with v1.4.0, you can preflight and install any community plugin directly from a full GitHub URL without waiting for catalog indexing — including single-subdirectory layouts, Monorepos, and repositories without Release tags. ### Option 1: Sidebar Top Bar `Add URL` (`链接添加`) Button (Two-Step Preflight) 1. Open the AGY Market Sidebar panel and click **`Add URL`** (`链接添加`) in the top bar (or click **Add via GitHub URL** when a Discover search returns no matches). 2. Paste any full GitHub URL and click **Inspect**: - Repository homepage: `https://github.com//` (resolves latest Release → Git Tag → default branch commit automatically) - Branch or subdirectory: `https://github.com///tree//` - Manifest blob URL: `https://github.com///blob//[/]plugin.json` - Release / tag / archive URLs: `/releases/tag/`, `/releases/latest`, `/releases/download//.tar.gz`, `/archive/...tar.gz` 3. AGY Market downloads the archive into an external staging directory and runs local static checks before installing: - **Multi-layout detection**: Supports root `plugin.json`, `.antigravity-plugin/plugin.json`, automatic unique-subdirectory detection (e.g. `agy-capsule/plugin.json`), and interactive subpath selection for Monorepo repositories (`plugins/*`, `.agents/plugins/*`, etc.). - **Preflight & safety checks**: Displays version or short `commitSha`, SHA-256 digest, capability badges, and install mode (native directory vs. `--` scoped isolation). Repositories missing a valid `plugin.json` or failing traversal/symlink/rule-smuggling checks are rejected with clear diagnostics and zero leftover files. - **Installed tracking & updates**: Installed items display a `GitHub URL` source badge in *Installed*, work with the Vault-Parking toggle slider, and check for updates via Release Tag or branch commit SHA. ### Option 2: CLI `npx agy-market add ` ```bash # Inspect and interactively install any GitHub plugin repository (supports subpaths & branch commits) npx agy-market add https://github.com// # Target a specific Monorepo subdirectory with -- scoped isolation and non-interactive confirmation npx agy-market add https://github.com// --subpath plugins/ --isolate --yes # Optional flags: --replace, --dest , --mirror , --token , --json npx agy-market add https://github.com///tree/main/ --yes --json ``` --- ## 🏷️ Capability Badges & Update Escalation Confirmation Every plugin surfaces static capability badges beside the Install button before installation: | Badge ID | Default Label | Description | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `declarative-only` | `🟢 Declarative Skill` | Pure `skills/` or `agents/` markdown; zero background processes or hooks | | `global-rules` | `🔵 Global Rules (~N tok)` | Includes `rules/*.md` active in prompt context while enabled, with token estimate | | `sidecar-ui` | `🟣 Sidebar Panel` | Provides a visual interactive panel in the right Sidebar | | `mcp-stdio` | `🟠 Local MCP Process` | Spawns a local stdio MCP server defined in `mcp_config.json` | | `mcp-remote` | `🌐 Remote MCP Service` | Connects to an external HTTPS MCP endpoint (domains listed transparently) | | `lifecycle-hooks` | `🔶 Lifecycle Hooks` | Registers session/tool lifecycle hooks via `hooks.json` | | `host-enhancement` | `💡 Host UI Enhancement` | Uses local CDP bridge or `app.asar` workbench enhancements (glass skins, companion widgets); fully permitted, gentle notice only | - **Capability-Escalation Confirmation**: Updating a plugin that adds newly introduced privilege badges or remote MCP domains pauses for explicit user approval before syncing and updating `.agy-market-receipt.json`. - **Dual-Track Discovery**: Track 1 verified plugins appear by default; opting into **Track 2 Experimental Topic Discovery** automatically enforces `--` double-hyphen isolation. --- ## 🛠️ CLI Commands & Local Development ### CLI (`bin/agy-market.mjs`) ```bash # Install or update AGY Market (optional --dest ) npx agy-market install # Preflight and install a plugin from any GitHub URL (--subpath, --isolate, --replace, --yes, --dest, --mirror, --token, --json) npx agy-market add # List local installed plugins, config/data paths & market receipts (--json supported) npx agy-market status npx agy-market status --json # Run local installation checks (Node >= 22, real directory check, 10-field manifest purity, built UI) & sweep retired Windows binaries npx agy-market doctor ``` ### Build & Test From Source ```powershell # Build single-file offline-capable Sidebar UI (sidecars/market_pane/index.html) & static showcase npm run build # Copy real plugin bundle into ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-market (never symlinks/junctions) npm run install:local # Verify local installation node ./bin/agy-market.mjs doctor # Pack deterministic release tarball (dist/agy-market.tar.gz + .sha256) npm run pack:release # Run unit & integration tests npm test ``` --- ## 🔒 Security & Host Redlines - **Never Writes `~/.gemini/config/config.json`**: Read-only inspection only; Vault Parking handles enable/disable cleanly. - **Never Creates Symlinks / NTFS Junctions**: Every install performs real directory/file copies and rejects archive traversal (`..`) and symlink/hardlink tar entries. - **Windows Lock-Safe Sync & Crash Recovery**: Stages outside `~/.gemini/config/plugins/` in `${PLUGIN_DATA}/staging/`, journals transitions via `pending-journal.json` (auto-recovered 8s after boot), renames locked binaries to `*.old.`, and sweeps them via `retired-binaries.json`. - **Loopback-Only Local Server & CSRF Guard**: Listens strictly on `127.0.0.1` (ephemeral port) and enforces a 256-bit random `X-Sidecar-Token` + `Origin` check on all `POST`/`DELETE` routes. --- ## 📚 Guides, Architecture & Contributing - **[📖 Plugin Submission Guide (`docs/SUBMISSION_GUIDE.md`)](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market-catalog/blob/main/docs/SUBMISSION_GUIDE.md)** — Full Track-1 single-YAML & Track-2 auto-discovery submission tutorial - Read **[`AGENTS.md`](./AGENTS.md)** and **[`../AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md)** before modifying any module in this repository. To submit plugins, visit **[`azwosile/agy-market-catalog`](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market-catalog)**. ## 📄 License [MIT License](./LICENSE)

**锁安全插件卸载（Sidebar 卡片/详情抽屉 + `npx agy-market uninstall `）**： - 每张可卸载全局已安装插件卡片与详情抽屉均内置 **「卸载」** 按钮（`POST /api/uninstall`，同时兼容 `/api/remove-files`），确认弹窗支持可选勾选「同时从收藏夹移除」。 - 统一覆盖活跃目录（`~/.gemini/config/plugins/`）与停放仓（`${PLUGIN_DATA}/disabled-plugins/`）；绝不写 `config.json` 或调用受限 RPC；遇到符号链接/NTFS Junction 仅删除链接本身绝不误删源目录；Windows 下遇到 `EBUSY` 文件锁自动 `.old.` 改名退避并立即摘除 `plugin.json`，下次启动由 `sweepRetiredBinaries` 自动清扫残留空壳目录；硬性拦截 `agy-market` 自删（`ERR_CANNOT_SELF_DELETE`）及 `workspace` / `builtin` 插件误删。 - **Sidebar 内全通道直装更新（告别外链手动下载）**： - 当检测到 GitHub 上游 Release/Tag 领先于目录版本或来源于 GitHub URL 时，`GET /api/updates` 统一标记 `installable: true`（`updateChannel: 'catalog' | 'github-upstream' | 'github-url'`），点击更新直接在 Sidebar 内完成拉取、预检与原位升级，彻底移除跳转外部浏览器的上游外链按钮。 - 目录认证插件通过 GitHub 上游通道直装更新时，100% 保留原有 `receipt.track`（如 `'verified'`）与 `repositoryId`，并持续执行能力增量确认门禁。 - **每张已安装卡片配单插件「更新」按钮 + 顶栏常驻「一键更新」**： - 所有具备远端更新源的已安装插件卡片均提供单插件 **「更新」** 按钮（纯本地无源插件显示置灰禁用态，接口返回 `ERR_NO_UPDATE_SOURCE`）。 - 「已安装」页签顶栏在 **「检查更新」** 旁常驻 **「一键更新」** 按钮：一键自动核检并按序批量更新 `catalog`、`github-upstream` 与 `github-url` 全部通道，并将 `agy-market` 自身更新严格排在最后触发重启。 ### 3. ⭐ 插件收藏栏、已安装搜索筛选与更新失败告警 - **⭐ 插件收藏栏 & 独立「收藏」标签页**： - 每张插件卡片（探索、收藏、已安装）与详情抽屉顶部均内置 `☆` / 琥珀金 `★` 收藏按钮，点击调用 `POST /api/favorites` 原子持久化至本地 `prefs.json`（无需重复配置）。 - 收藏任意插件后，「探索」页顶部自动浮现可折叠的 **「★ 我的收藏栏」** 快捷入口；顶部导航同步提供独立 **「★ 收藏」** 标签页（`探索 · 收藏 · 已安装 · 冲突与诊断 · 源与设置`），支持全文检索与快速启停/安装。 - **`已安装` 插件实时搜索与状态筛选**： - 「已安装」视图配备实时搜索栏（支持按插件显示名、目录名或简介瞬时过滤）与状态筛选胶囊（**全部 / 已启用 / 已停用 / 可更新**），插件再多也能秒级定位。 - **更新失败显著红色告警条（绝不静默失败）**： - 当单个安装/更新、批量「全部更新」或市场自更新遇到网络中断、SHA-256 校验不匹配或文件锁异常时，页面顶部立即弹出醒目的红色告警条与错误通知，完整展示失败插件与具体错误原因，并提供一键 **「重试」** 按钮。 ### 4. 卡片底部原生「启用 / 禁用」安全停放仓滑块（Vault Parking） - **零改写 `config.json` 红线**：Antigravity 语言服务器对 `~/.gemini/config/config.json` 设有写保护。AGY Market 严守只读原则，永不改写 `config.json`，而是通过**安全停放仓（Vault Parking）**实现即时启停控制（`POST /api/toggle-plugin`）： - **滑向「禁用（OFF）」**：后端将 `~/.gemini/config/plugins/` 安全移入 `${PLUGIN_DATA}/disabled-plugins/`，宿主热监听约 1 秒内卸载对应 Skills / Rules / Hooks。 - **滑向「启用（ON）」**：后端将目录完整移回 `~/.gemini/config/plugins/` 并清理可能残留的 `"disabled": true`。 - **停放态持续可更新**：被禁用的插件仍保留在「已安装」与「探索」卡片中；对其执行版本更新时，会在 `disabled-plugins/` 内原位同步，绝不意外将其自动重新激活。 - **防误操作锁定**：`agy-market` 自身滑块保持常亮锁定（避免在市场侧边栏内把自己停用断连）；`workspace`、`builtin` 及宿主手动禁用项显示只读锁定提示。 ### 5. 本地插件冲突检查与修复 顶部内置独立 **「冲突与诊断」** 标签页（`GET /api/conflicts`），对本地已安装插件执行只读静态检查，并提供一键修复（`POST /api/fix-conflict`）： | 检测项 | 严重级别 | 检测内容 | 一键修复能力 | | :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- | | `duplicate-plugin-name` | 严重 | 跨 `workspace > global > builtin` 扫描重复 `plugin.json.name`，精确标出生效胜出方与被宿主静默丢弃的插件目录 | 一键双连字符隔离重命名（`--`） | | `windows-symlink-ignored` | 严重 | 检测 Windows 下 `~/.gemini/config/plugins/` 中被 `GetAllPlugins` 静默跳过的 NTFS Junction / 符号链接目录 | 一键实体化转为真实目录 | | `mcp-collision` | 严重 / 警告 | 检测重复 `_`、与用户全局 `mcp_config.json` 重名或裸通用服务名（如 `search`、`db`、`fetch`） | 定位冲突键名与来源文件 | | `skill-shadowing` / `agent-shadowing` | 警告 | 检测已启用插件之间的 `skills/*/SKILL.md`、`agents/*.md` 与用户全局目录或内置保留名的覆盖链 | 完整展示胜出/被覆盖链路 | | `host-enhancement-overlap` | 警告 / 提示 | 检测多个已启用插件同时修改 `app.asar`（**警告**，需注意文件补丁叠加风险）或同时使用 `cdp` 宿主界面增强（**提示**，通常可共存） | 提示评估是否停用其一 | ### 6. 按需触发的智能重启 / 重开侧边栏提示 卡片与详情抽屉保持视觉清爽，不再堆叠静态「需重启 / 免重启」标签；**仅当安装、更新、批量更新、卸载完成或 Windows 禁用遇到文件锁时**，依据插件能力与实时句柄状态按需弹出精准提示： - **纯声明式技能 / 全局规则（`instant`）**：热加载即刻生效，免重启无打扰。 - **含 Sidebar 侧边栏 / MCP / 钩子（`reload-pane`）**：更新或安装成功后提示重开侧边栏或刷新 MCP。 - **含 `app.asar` / 首次配置 `cdp` / Windows 锁定退避文件（`host-restart`）**：操作完成后弹出顶部横幅提醒重启 Antigravity 生效。 ### 7. 内置 GitHub Discussions 社区讨论 - 插件详情抽屉内置 **「讨论」** 标签页（`GET /api/discussions`），无需登录或 Token 即可自动探测目标仓库是否开启 GitHub Discussions，并提供一键直达讨论区与发帖入口。 - 如在面板设置中可选填入个人 GitHub Token（仅以 `0600` 权限保存在本地 `prefs.json`，绝不写入缓存文件或日志），即可在侧边栏直接拉取并浏览该插件最新 10 条社区讨论。 ### 8. 双通道中国大陆镜像加速与 SHA-256 校验 - **三级目录源自动解析（零内置陈旧快照）**： 1. **自定义团队/个人源**：优先合并 `prefs.json` 中配置的静态 `index.json` 订阅源。 2. **全球主通道（GitHub Pages + `gh-pages` Raw 回退）**：支持 `ETag`（`If-None-Match`）/ `If-Modified-Since` 条件请求，`304 Not Modified` 毫秒级复用本地缓存。 3. **中国大陆自动镜像回退**：主源超时（`> 3.5s`）或不可达时，自动切换拉取纯 JSON 数据包 `@agy-market/catalog`（依次尝试 `registry.npmmirror.com` 与 `mirrors.cloud.tencent.com/npm`），在内存流式解包目录索引；完全离线时自动降级为本地磁盘缓存。 - **语言无关与 SHA-256 校验下载**：`@agy-market/catalog` 仅将 npm 用作静态 JSON CDN，被收录的插件**无需是 npm 包或 JS 项目**。支持配置自定义 GitHub Release 镜像加速前缀，所有 `.tar.gz` 安装包在解压前都会比对目录源中的 `sha256` 摘要，不匹配时立即触发 `INTEGRITY_SHA256_MISMATCH` 中止安装。 --- ## 🚀 一行快速安装 > 运行环境要求：**Node.js >= 22.0.0**（零外部 npm 运行时依赖）；或使用下方免 npm 系统脚本。 ### 方式一：Node / `npx`（推荐，全平台通用） ```bash npx agy-market@latest ``` ### 方式二：Windows PowerShell（免 npm，内置 SHA-256 校验与目录回退） ```powershell irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/azwosile/agy-market/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex ``` ### 方式三：macOS / Linux Shell（免 npm，内置 SHA-256 校验与目录回退） ```sh curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/azwosile/agy-market/main/scripts/install.sh | sh ``` ### 安装后如何在 Antigravity 中打开？ - 在 Antigravity 对话中发送「打开插件市场」，或点击聊天药丸：`[AGY Market](sidecar://agy-market/market_pane/)` - 也可直接点击右侧 Sidebar 辅助栏顶部 **`+` → `Plugins` → `AGY Market`** 打开。 - 如需在 Antigravity 原生定制页管理本插件，可点击对话药丸：`[AGY Market](customization://agy-market)` --- ## 🔗 通过 GitHub 完整链接添加插件 无需等待目录收录，v1.4.0 起可直接通过 GitHub 完整链接预检并安装任意社区插件，自动兼容单插件子目录、Monorepo 多插件目录及无 Release Tag 的默认分支提交。 ### 方式一：UI 顶栏「链接添加」按钮（两步式预检安装） 1. 打开 AGY Market 侧边栏，点击顶栏右上角 **`链接添加`** 按钮（或在探索页搜索无结果时点击 **「通过 GitHub 链接添加」**）。 2. 粘贴任意 GitHub 完整链接并点击 **「解析预检」**，支持以下链接形式： - 仓库主页：`https://github.com//`（自动按最新 Release → Git Tag → 默认分支提交解析） - 分支或子目录：`https://github.com///tree//` - 清单文件直链：`https://github.com///blob//[/]plugin.json` - 指定 Release / 标签 / 归档直链：`/releases/tag/`、`/releases/latest`、`/releases/download//.tar.gz`、`/archive/...tar.gz` 3. 后端在插件外置暂存目录下载归档并完成本地静态检查： - **自动识别布局**：兼容根目录 `plugin.json`、`.antigravity-plugin/plugin.json`、唯一命名子目录自动定位（如 `agy-capsule/plugin.json`）；若仓库为 Monorepo 多插件布局（如 `plugins/*`、`.agents/plugins/*`），弹窗将列出全部候选子目录供直接点选。 - **预检与安全拦截**：安装前明确展示版本号或短 `commitSha`、SHA-256 摘要、能力徽章及安装方式（原生目录名或 `--` 隔离目录名）；若仓库不含有效 `plugin.json` 或命中路径穿越、软硬链接、规则越界注入等安全规则，将提示原因并清理暂存目录，不产生残留。 - **已安装联动更新**：通过链接安装的插件在「已安装」页带有 `GitHub URL` 来源标签，支持滑块启停、详情抽屉查看，并可按 Release Tag 或分支最新 Commit SHA 一键检查更新。 ### 方式二：CLI `npx agy-market add ` ```bash # 预检并交互确认安装任意 GitHub 插件仓库（兼容子目录与无 Tag 默认分支） npx agy-market add https://github.com// # 指定 Monorepo 子目录，使用 -- 隔离目录名并跳过交互确认 npx agy-market add https://github.com// --subpath plugins/ --isolate --yes # 可选参数：--replace（替换同源目录）、--dest 、--mirror 、--token 、--json npx agy-market add https://github.com///tree/main/ --yes --json ``` --- ## 🏷️ 能力徽章与升级权限增量确认 所有插件在点击「安装」前都会展示静态扫描生成的能力徽章： | 徽章标识 | 默认中文标签 | 含义说明 | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `declarative-only` | `🟢 纯声明式技能` | 仅包含 `skills/` 或 `agents/` 声明文档，无后台常驻进程或钩子 | | `global-rules` | `🔵 常驻规则 (~N tok)` | 包含启用期间常驻注入上下文的 `rules/*.md`，清晰标出预估 Token 占用 | | `sidecar-ui` | `🟣 Sidebar 侧边栏` | 在右侧 Sidebar 辅助栏提供可视化交互界面 | | `mcp-stdio` | `🟠 本地 MCP 进程` | 通过 `mcp_config.json` 启动本地 Stdio 工具服务进程 | | `mcp-remote` | `🌐 远程 MCP 服务` | 连接外部 HTTPS MCP 服务端点（展示目标域名） | | `lifecycle-hooks` | `🔶 生命周期钩子 (Hooks)` | 通过 `hooks.json` 订阅会话或工具调用生命周期事件 | | `host-enhancement` | `💡 宿主界面增强` | 使用本地 CDP 调试桥或 `app.asar` 工作台界面增强（如毛玻璃皮肤、桌面挂件），社区完全欢迎，仅温和提示 | - **升级能力增量确认（T+N Escalation Guard）**：当插件从旧版本升级并**新增**之前未授予的能力类别或新的远程 MCP 域名时，自动弹出增量对比确认框，经用户确认后再同步写入并更新 `.agy-market-receipt.json`。 - **双轨插件支持**：默认展示 Track 1 已验证目录；在设置中可按需开启 **Track 2 实验性 Topic 自动发现**（自动强制 `--` 双连字符命名隔离，避免同名冲突）。 --- ## 🛠️ CLI 诊断与本地开发命令 ### 用户 CLI 命令（`bin/agy-market.mjs`） ```bash # 安装或更新 AGY Market 到默认插件目录（支持 --dest 自定义路径） npx agy-market install # 通过任意 GitHub 完整链接预检并安装插件（支持 --subpath / --isolate / --replace / --yes / --dest / --mirror / --token / --json） npx agy-market add # 锁安全卸载已安装的全局社区插件（别名 remove；支持 --yes / --dest / --json） npx agy-market uninstall npx agy-market uninstall --yes --json # 查看当前配置路径、数据目录及所有已安装插件状态（支持 --json 机器可读输出） npx agy-market status npx agy-market status --json # 运行安装检查（校验 Node >= 22、非符号链接实体目录、10 字段清单纯净度、UI 产物）并清理 Windows 残留 *.old. 文件 npx agy-market doctor ``` ### 源码构建与本地开发 ```powershell # 1. 编译离线可用的单文件 Sidebar UI（sidecars/market_pane/index.html）及静态展示站 npm run build # 2. 以真实文件复制方式安装至 ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-market（严禁符号链接 / NTFS Junction） npm run install:local # 3. 执行安装检查 node ./bin/agy-market.mjs doctor # 4. 打包确定性 GitHub Release 压缩包与校验文件（dist/agy-market.tar.gz + .sha256） npm run pack:release # 5. 运行全量单元测试与跨仓集成测试 npm test ``` --- ## 🔒 安全与宿主工程红线 - **绝不写入 `~/.gemini/config/config.json`**：仅只读解析插件启停状态，杜绝覆盖用户登录态与设置。 - **绝不创建符号链接 / NTFS Junction**：Windows 下 Antigravity 会静默跳过符号链接插件，所有安装/更新均为实体目录复制，且解包器硬性拦截 `..` 路径穿越与软硬链接。 - **Windows 锁安全原位更新与崩溃恢复**：先在插件外置 `${PLUGIN_DATA}/staging/` 解包并写入 `pending-journal.json`（启动 8 秒自动恢复中断事务），对 Windows 锁定中的二进制采用 `.old.` 改名退避并在下次启动时由 `retired-binaries.json` 自动垃圾回收。 - **三级目录源自动解析（零内置陈旧快照）**： 1. **自定义团队/个人源**：优先合并 `prefs.json` 中配置的静态 `index.json` 订阅源。 2. **全球主通道（GitHub Pages + `gh-pages` Raw 回退）**：支持 `ETag`（`If-None-Match`）/ `If-Modified-Since` 条件请求，`304 Not Modified` 毫秒级复用本地缓存。 3. **中国大陆自动镜像回退**：主源超时（`> 3.5s`）或不可达时，自动切换拉取纯 JSON 数据包 `@agy-market/catalog`（依次尝试 `registry.npmmirror.com` 与 `mirrors.cloud.tencent.com/npm`），在内存流式解包目录索引；完全离线时自动降级为本地磁盘缓存。 - **语言无关与 SHA-256 校验下载**：`@agy-market/catalog` 仅将 npm 用作静态 JSON CDN，被收录的插件**无需是 npm 包或 JS 项目**。支持配置自定义 GitHub Release 镜像加速前缀，所有 `.tar.gz` 安装包在解压前都会比对目录源中的 `sha256` 摘要，不匹配时立即触发 `INTEGRITY_SHA256_MISMATCH` 中止安装。 --- ## 🚀 一行快速安装 > 运行环境要求：**Node.js >= 22.0.0**（零外部 npm 运行时依赖）；或使用下方免 npm 系统脚本。 ### 方式一：Node / `npx`（推荐，全平台通用） ```bash npx agy-market@latest ``` ### 方式二：Windows PowerShell（免 npm，内置 SHA-256 校验与目录回退） ```powershell irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/azwosile/agy-market/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex ``` ### 方式三：macOS / Linux Shell（免 npm，内置 SHA-256 校验与目录回退） ```sh curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/azwosile/agy-market/main/scripts/install.sh | sh ``` ### 安装后如何在 Antigravity 中打开？ - 在 Antigravity 对话中发送「打开插件市场」，或点击聊天药丸：`[AGY Market](sidecar://agy-market/market_pane/)` - 也可直接点击右侧 Sidebar 辅助栏顶部 **`+` → `Plugins` → `AGY Market`** 打开。 - 如需在 Antigravity 原生定制页管理本插件，可点击对话药丸：`[AGY Market](customization://agy-market)` --- ## 🔗 通过 GitHub 完整链接添加插件 无需等待目录收录，v1.4.0 起可直接通过 GitHub 完整链接预检并安装任意社区插件，自动兼容单插件子目录、Monorepo 多插件目录及无 Release Tag 的默认分支提交。 ### 方式一：UI 顶栏「链接添加」按钮（两步式预检安装） 1. 打开 AGY Market 侧边栏，点击顶栏右上角 **`链接添加`** 按钮（或在探索页搜索无结果时点击 **「通过 GitHub 链接添加」**）。 2. 粘贴任意 GitHub 完整链接并点击 **「解析预检」**，支持以下链接形式： - 仓库主页：`https://github.com//`（自动按最新 Release → Git Tag → 默认分支提交解析） - 分支或子目录：`https://github.com///tree//` - 清单文件直链：`https://github.com///blob//[/]plugin.json` - 指定 Release / 标签 / 归档直链：`/releases/tag/`、`/releases/latest`、`/releases/download//.tar.gz`、`/archive/...tar.gz` 3. 后端在插件外置暂存目录下载归档并完成本地静态检查： - **自动识别布局**：兼容根目录 `plugin.json`、`.antigravity-plugin/plugin.json`、唯一命名子目录自动定位（如 `agy-capsule/plugin.json`）；若仓库为 Monorepo 多插件布局（如 `plugins/*`、`.agents/plugins/*`），弹窗将列出全部候选子目录供直接点选。 - **预检与安全拦截**：安装前明确展示版本号或短 `commitSha`、SHA-256 摘要、能力徽章及安装方式（原生目录名或 `--` 隔离目录名）；若仓库不含有效 `plugin.json` 或命中路径穿越、软硬链接、规则越界注入等安全规则，将提示原因并清理暂存目录，不产生残留。 - **已安装联动更新**：通过链接安装的插件在「已安装」页带有 `GitHub URL` 来源标签，支持滑块启停、详情抽屉查看，并可按 Release Tag 或分支最新 Commit SHA 一键检查更新。 ### 方式二：CLI `npx agy-market add ` ```bash # 预检并交互确认安装任意 GitHub 插件仓库（兼容子目录与无 Tag 默认分支） npx agy-market add https://github.com// # 指定 Monorepo 子目录，使用 -- 隔离目录名并跳过交互确认 npx agy-market add https://github.com// --subpath plugins/ --isolate --yes # 可选参数：--replace（替换同源目录）、--dest 、--mirror 、--token 、--json npx agy-market add https://github.com///tree/main/ --yes --json ``` --- ## 🏷️ 能力徽章与升级权限增量确认 所有插件在点击「安装」前都会展示静态扫描生成的能力徽章： | 徽章标识 | 默认中文标签 | 含义说明 | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `declarative-only` | `🟢 纯声明式技能` | 仅包含 `skills/` 或 `agents/` 声明文档，无后台常驻进程或钩子 | | `global-rules` | `🔵 常驻规则 (~N tok)` | 包含启用期间常驻注入上下文的 `rules/*.md`，清晰标出预估 Token 占用 | | `sidecar-ui` | `🟣 Sidebar 侧边栏` | 在右侧 Sidebar 辅助栏提供可视化交互界面 | | `mcp-stdio` | `🟠 本地 MCP 进程` | 通过 `mcp_config.json` 启动本地 Stdio 工具服务进程 | | `mcp-remote` | `🌐 远程 MCP 服务` | 连接外部 HTTPS MCP 服务端点（展示目标域名） | | `lifecycle-hooks` | `🔶 生命周期钩子 (Hooks)` | 通过 `hooks.json` 订阅会话或工具调用生命周期事件 | | `host-enhancement` | `💡 宿主界面增强` | 使用本地 CDP 调试桥或 `app.asar` 工作台界面增强（如毛玻璃皮肤、桌面挂件），社区完全欢迎，仅温和提示 | - **升级能力增量确认（T+N Escalation Guard）**：当插件从旧版本升级并**新增**之前未授予的能力类别或新的远程 MCP 域名时，自动弹出增量对比确认框，经用户确认后再同步写入并更新 `.agy-market-receipt.json`。 - **双轨插件支持**：默认展示 Track 1 已验证目录；在设置中可按需开启 **Track 2 实验性 Topic 自动发现**（自动强制 `--` 双连字符命名隔离，避免同名冲突）。 --- ## 🛠️ CLI 诊断与本地开发命令 ### 用户 CLI 命令（`bin/agy-market.mjs`） ```bash # 安装或更新 AGY Market 到默认插件目录（支持 --dest 自定义路径） npx agy-market install # 通过任意 GitHub 完整链接预检并安装插件（支持 --subpath / --isolate / --replace / --yes / --dest / --mirror / --token / --json） npx agy-market add # 锁安全卸载已安装的全局社区插件（别名 remove；支持 --yes / --dest / --json） npx agy-market uninstall npx agy-market uninstall --yes --json # 查看当前配置路径、数据目录及所有已安装插件状态（支持 --json 机器可读输出） npx agy-market status npx agy-market status --json # 运行安装检查（校验 Node >= 22、非符号链接实体目录、10 字段清单纯净度、UI 产物）并清理 Windows 残留 *.old. 文件 npx agy-market doctor ``` ### 源码构建与本地开发 ```powershell # 1. 编译离线可用的单文件 Sidebar UI（sidecars/market_pane/index.html）及静态展示站 npm run build # 2. 以真实文件复制方式安装至 ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-market（严禁符号链接 / NTFS Junction） npm run install:local # 3. 执行安装检查 node ./bin/agy-market.mjs doctor # 4. 打包确定性 GitHub Release 压缩包与校验文件（dist/agy-market.tar.gz + .sha256） npm run pack:release # 5. 运行全量单元测试与跨仓集成测试 npm test ``` --- ## 🔒 安全与宿主工程红线 - **绝不写入 `~/.gemini/config/config.json`**：仅只读解析插件启停状态，杜绝覆盖用户登录态与设置。 - **绝不创建符号链接 / NTFS Junction**：Windows 下 Antigravity 会静默跳过符号链接插件，所有安装/更新均为实体目录复制，且解包器硬性拦截 `..` 路径穿越与软硬链接。 - **Windows 锁安全原位更新与崩溃恢复**：先在插件外置 `${PLUGIN_DATA}/staging/` 解包并写入 `pending-journal.json`（启动 8 秒自动恢复中断事务），对 Windows 锁定中的二进制采用 `.old.` 改名退避并在下次启动时由 `retired-binaries.json` 自动垃圾回收。 - **严格环回与 CSRF 鉴权**：本地 HTTP 服务仅绑定 `127.0.0.1` 随机端口，所有写入/变更接口（`POST` / `DELETE`）强制校验 256-bit 随机 `X-Sidecar-Token` 与 `Origin` 头。 --- ## 📚 架构文档与收录指引 - **[📖 申请收录插件完整教程 (`docs/SUBMISSION_GUIDE.md`)](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market-catalog/blob/main/docs/SUBMISSION_GUIDE.md)** — 一文搞定 Track 1 单文件 YAML 提交流程与 Track 2 免 PR 自动发现 - **[`AGENTS.md`](./AGENTS.md)** — 客户端工程规范、宿主红线与锁安全安装器设计 - **[`../AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md)** — 跨仓库协议、统一 JSON Schema 与双层防冲突规范 - **[`azwosile/agy-market-catalog`](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market-catalog)** — 插件目录仓库与自动化收录管线 ## 📄 许可证 [MIT License](./LICENSE)

# AGY Market (`agy-market`) **Community Plugin Marketplace for Google Antigravity** Sidebar Panel UI · Lock-Safe One-Click Uninstall · Direct In-Sidebar Upstream & Batch Updates · 15 Precision Categories · GitHub URL Preflight Installer · ⭐ Pinned Favorites Shelf & Tab · Live Installed Search & Filters · One-Click Sidebar Launcher · Native Vault-Parking Toggle Sliders · Local Conflict Checks · Dual-Mirror China Acceleration · SHA-256 Verified Installs [简体中文](./README.md) · **English** · **[📖 Submit a Plugin Guide](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market-catalog/blob/main/docs/SUBMISSION_GUIDE.md)** · [Plugin Catalog](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market-catalog) · [Architecture Spec](./AGENTS.md)
--- > **Repository Boundary**: This repository ([`azwosile/agy-market`](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market)) houses the **AGY Market** Sidebar client plugin, Windows lock-safe tarball installer, `npx agy-market` bootstrap CLI, and static web showcase (`site/`). > > To list your plugin in the community catalog, click **`+ Submit Plugin`** (`+ 申请收录插件`) in AGY Market or follow the step-by-step **[📖 Plugin Submission Guide (`docs/SUBMISSION_GUIDE.md`)](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market-catalog/blob/main/docs/SUBMISSION_GUIDE.md)** to open a single-YAML Pull Request in **[`azwosile/agy-market-catalog`](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market-catalog)**. --- ## ✨ Highlights (v1.5.0) ### 1. Sidebar Panel UI, 15 Precision Categories & Navigation - **Native Right Sidebar Panel**: Runs inside Antigravity's native `AUX_PANE` extension view (`sidecars/market_pane/sidecar.json`) with no bundled MCP servers, keeping the panel lightweight and responsive. - **15 Precision Plugin Categories (16 Keys Including `all`)**: Adds **`monitoring-quota`** (*Telemetry & Quota*), **`context-cache`** (*Context & Cache Boost*), and **`agents-reasoning`** (*Agents & Reasoning*) alongside the existing 12 taxonomy buckets. Discover dynamically renders filter pills for all active categories, indexes localized category names in search, and displays category tags on cards and Detail Drawers. - **Overview Strip & Plugin Cards**: Collapsible top overview strip displays catalog stats (*Indexed / Active / Updates / Local Conflicts*) alongside quick **`Add URL`** (`链接添加`) and **`+ Submit Plugin`** actions. Card styles adapt across Dark, Light, and translucent wallpaper skins (such as Wallpaper Prism). - **2-Line Titles + Clickable GitHub Links**: Clicking any **plugin title** in cards or the Detail Drawer opens its GitHub repository directly in a new window, while clicking the card body opens the Detail Drawer. - **Multilingual README Drawer**: Queries `/api/readme?id=...&locale=zh|en`, preferring localized `entriesZh` / `entriesEn` from the catalog (or local `README.zh-CN.md` / `README.zh.md` for installed plugins) and rendering localized descriptions on installed cards. - **Direct One-Click Sidebar Launcher**: Replaces raw `` links blocked inside isolated iframes. Inside the host panel, clicking a sibling plugin's **Panel** button invokes host `window.sidecar.ui.toggleAuxPane` (`tabType: "sidecarView"`) directly to open or focus its Sidebar panel—no manual copy prompts. ### 2. Lock-Safe Uninstall, Direct In-Sidebar Updates & Permanent Update All - **Lock-Safe Plugin Uninstall (Sidebar Card/Drawer + `npx agy-market uninstall `)**: - Every removable global plugin card and Detail Drawer exposes an **Uninstall** (`卸载`) button backed by `POST /api/uninstall` (with `POST /api/remove-files` compatibility) and a confirmation modal with an optional *Also remove from favorites* checkbox. - Handles both active (`~/.gemini/config/plugins/`) and Vault-Parked (`${PLUGIN_DATA}/disabled-plugins/`) directories; never writes `config.json` or calls restricted RPCs; unlinks symlinks/NTFS junctions without touching target source directories; retires Windows `EBUSY`-locked binaries to `.old.` while immediately deleting `plugin.json` (with `sweepRetiredBinaries` later removing empty orphan shells); strictly blocks self-deletion of `agy-market` (`ERR_CANNOT_SELF_DELETE`) as well as `workspace` and `builtin` plugins. - **Direct In-Sidebar Updates Across All Channels (Zero External Download Redirects)**: - Whenever an upstream GitHub Release/Tag leads the catalog or comes from a GitHub URL install, `GET /api/updates` returns `installable: true` (`updateChannel: 'catalog' | 'github-upstream' | 'github-url'`), eliminating external browser download redirects. - Upgrading a verified catalog plugin directly from GitHub upstream preserves its original `receipt.track` (`'verified'`) and `repositoryId` while still enforcing capability-escalation confirmation. - **Per-Card `Update` Button & Permanent Top-Bar `Update All`**: - Every installed plugin card with a catalog or GitHub source provides a per-plugin **Update** button (pure local plugins without a remote source render a disabled button and return `ERR_NO_UPDATE_SOURCE` on API calls). - The **Installed** tab header permanently displays **Update All** beside **Check Updates**: clicking it checks for updates when needed and sequentially upgrades `catalog`, `github-upstream`, and `github-url` plugins (always scheduling `agy-market` self-update last to trigger clean restart). ### 3. ⭐ Favorites Shelf & Tab, Installed Search/Filters & Update Error Alerts - **⭐ Pinned Favorites Shelf & Dedicated Favorites Tab**: - Every plugin card (Discover, Favorites, Installed) and the Detail Drawer header feature a tactile star button (`☆` / glowing amber `★`) backed by `POST /api/favorites` persisted atomically in `prefs.json`. - When 1 or more plugins are starred, a collapsible **Pinned Favorites Shelf (`★ Favorites`)** appears above the Discover grid, complemented by a dedicated **`★ Favorites`** top navigation tab (`Discover · Favorites · Installed · Conflicts & Diagnostics · Sources & Settings`). - **Live Search & Status Filters in `Installed` View**: - The **Installed** view includes a live search bar (matching display name, directory name, or description) and quick status filter pills (**All / Enabled / Disabled / Updatable**) for fast management at scale. - **High-Visibility Update Error Alert Banner (Zero Silent Failures)**: - Whenever an install/update, batch **Update All**, or self-update fails due to network errors, SHA-256 mismatch, or permissions, a dismissible red error banner and error toast surface the affected plugin, exact failure reason, and a one-click **Retry** button. ### 4. Native Card-Footer Enable / Disable Slider (Vault Parking) - **Zero Writes to `config.json`**: Antigravity's Language Server write-protects `~/.gemini/config/config.json`. AGY Market reads `config.json` strictly read-only and powers live toggling via **Vault Parking** (`POST /api/toggle-plugin`): - **Toggle OFF (Disable)**: Moves `~/.gemini/config/plugins/` cleanly into `${PLUGIN_DATA}/disabled-plugins/`. Host hot-watch unloads its Skills / Rules / Hooks within ~1 second. - **Toggle ON (Enable)**: Moves the folder back into `~/.gemini/config/plugins/` and removes any stale `"disabled": true` flag. - **Update While Parked**: Disabled plugins remain visible in *Installed* and *Discover* tabs and update in-place inside `disabled-plugins/` without accidentally reactivating them. - **Safe Locking**: `agy-market` itself stays locked ON to prevent disconnecting its own panel; `workspace`, `builtin`, and host-disabled plugins show clear read-only lock states. ### 5. Local Plugin Conflict Checks & Fixes Dedicated **Conflicts & Diagnostics** tab (`GET /api/conflicts`) with read-only static conflict checks and one-click fixes (`POST /api/fix-conflict`): | Check | Severity | What It Detects | Quick Action | | :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- | | `duplicate-plugin-name` | Critical | Duplicate `plugin.json.name` across `workspace > global > builtin` precedence, pinpointing the winner and silently dropped victim directories | 1-click `--` scoped isolation rename | | `windows-symlink-ignored` | Critical | Symlinks or NTFS junctions inside `~/.gemini/config/plugins/` that Windows `GetAllPlugins` silently skips | 1-click materialize to real directory | | `mcp-collision` | Critical / Warning | Duplicate `_` keys, collisions with global `mcp_config.json`, or bare generic server names (`search`, `db`, `fetch`, etc.) | Pinpoints colliding keys & sources | | `skill-shadowing` / `agent-shadowing` | Warning | Overlapping `skills/*/SKILL.md` or `agents/*.md` across active plugins, `~/.gemini/config/skills/*`, and built-in reserved names | Shows full override chain | | `host-enhancement-overlap` | Warning / Info | Two or more active plugins modifying `app.asar` (**Warning**, patch overlap risk) or using `cdp` UI enhancements (**Info**, generally compatible) | Advisory to review or disable duplicate | ### 6. Action-Triggered Restart & Reload Prompts Cards and the Detail Drawer stay clutter-free without static restart chips. Activation prompts appear **only after an install, update, batch update, or uninstall completes** (or when a Windows disable/uninstall retires a locked binary): - **Declarative Skills / Global Rules (`instant`)**: Hot-reloads immediately with no restart required. - **Sidebar Panel / MCP / Hooks (`reload-pane`)**: Prompts to reopen the Sidebar panel or refresh MCP after update/install completes. - **`app.asar` / First-Time `cdp` / Retired Locked Binaries (`host-restart`)**: Displays a clear banner reminding you to restart Antigravity for changes to take full effect. ### 7. Built-In GitHub Discussions Integration - Every plugin Detail Drawer includes a **Discussions** tab (`GET /api/discussions`) that detects whether Discussions are enabled on the repository without needing a token and provides direct links to browse or start a thread. - Optionally configuring a personal GitHub Token in Settings (stored locally in `prefs.json` with `0600` permissions; never logged or persisted in caches) loads the latest 10 repository discussions directly inside the Sidebar panel. ### 8. Dual-Mirror China Acceleration & SHA-256 Verified Installs - **Three-Tier Live Catalog Resolution (No Stale Bundled Snapshot)**: 1. **Custom Feeds**: User/team static `index.json` URLs configured in `prefs.json` take highest priority. 2. **Primary Channel (GitHub Pages + `gh-pages` Raw Fallback)**: Conditional `ETag` (`If-None-Match`) / `If-Modified-Since` requests achieve `<50ms` `304 Not Modified` cache hits. 3. **Automatic Mainland China Mirror Fallback**: If GitHub Pages times out (`> 3.5s`) or fails, streams the pure-JSON `@agy-market/catalog` transport package from `registry.npmmirror.com` or `mirrors.cloud.tencent.com/npm` in memory; falls back to disk cache when offline. - **Language-Agnostic & SHA-256 Verified**: npm is used **strictly** as a JSON mirror CDN for catalog metadata—listed plugins do **not** need to be npm or JavaScript projects. Optional GitHub Release mirror prefixes are supported safely because every tarball is streamed and verified against the catalog `sha256` digest before extraction (`INTEGRITY_SHA256_MISMATCH` aborts immediately on any mismatch). --- ## 🚀 One-Line Bootstrap Install > Requires **Node.js >= 22.0.0** (zero runtime npm dependencies), or use the zero-npm OS installers below. - **Node / `npx` (Cross-Platform, Recommended)**: ```bash npx agy-market@latest ``` - **Windows PowerShell (Zero npm, SHA-256 Verified + Catalog Fallback)**: ```powershell irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/azwosile/agy-market/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex ``` - **macOS / Linux Shell (Zero npm, SHA-256 Verified + Catalog Fallback)**: ```sh curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/azwosile/agy-market/main/scripts/install.sh | sh ``` Once installed in Antigravity: - Open the Sidebar Panel: click `[AGY Market](sidecar://agy-market/market_pane/)` in chat, or open **Sidebar (`+`) → `Plugins` → `AGY Market`**. - Manage on Native Customizations Page: `[AGY Market](customization://agy-market)` --- ## 🔗 Adding Plugins from Any GitHub URL Starting with v1.4.0, you can preflight and install any community plugin directly from a full GitHub URL without waiting for catalog indexing — including single-subdirectory layouts, Monorepos, and repositories without Release tags. ### Option 1: Sidebar Top Bar `Add URL` (`链接添加`) Button (Two-Step Preflight) 1. Open the AGY Market Sidebar panel and click **`Add URL`** (`链接添加`) in the top bar (or click **Add via GitHub URL** when a Discover search returns no matches). 2. Paste any full GitHub URL and click **Inspect**: - Repository homepage: `https://github.com//` (resolves latest Release → Git Tag → default branch commit automatically) - Branch or subdirectory: `https://github.com///tree//` - Manifest blob URL: `https://github.com///blob//[/]plugin.json` - Release / tag / archive URLs: `/releases/tag/`, `/releases/latest`, `/releases/download//.tar.gz`, `/archive/...tar.gz` 3. AGY Market downloads the archive into an external staging directory and runs local static checks before installing: - **Multi-layout detection**: Supports root `plugin.json`, `.antigravity-plugin/plugin.json`, automatic unique-subdirectory detection (e.g. `agy-capsule/plugin.json`), and interactive subpath selection for Monorepo repositories (`plugins/*`, `.agents/plugins/*`, etc.). - **Preflight & safety checks**: Displays version or short `commitSha`, SHA-256 digest, capability badges, and install mode (native directory vs. `--` scoped isolation). Repositories missing a valid `plugin.json` or failing traversal/symlink/rule-smuggling checks are rejected with clear diagnostics and zero leftover files. - **Installed tracking & updates**: Installed items display a `GitHub URL` source badge in *Installed*, work with the Vault-Parking toggle slider, and check for updates via Release Tag or branch commit SHA. ### Option 2: CLI `npx agy-market add ` ```bash # Inspect and interactively install any GitHub plugin repository (supports subpaths & branch commits) npx agy-market add https://github.com// # Target a specific Monorepo subdirectory with -- scoped isolation and non-interactive confirmation npx agy-market add https://github.com// --subpath plugins/ --isolate --yes # Optional flags: --replace, --dest , --mirror , --token , --json npx agy-market add https://github.com///tree/main/ --yes --json ``` --- ## 🏷️ Capability Badges & Update Escalation Confirmation Every plugin surfaces static capability badges beside the Install button before installation: | Badge ID | Default Label | Description | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `declarative-only` | `🟢 Declarative Skill` | Pure `skills/` or `agents/` markdown; zero background processes or hooks | | `global-rules` | `🔵 Global Rules (~N tok)` | Includes `rules/*.md` active in prompt context while enabled, with token estimate | | `sidecar-ui` | `🟣 Sidebar Panel` | Provides a visual interactive panel in the right Sidebar | | `mcp-stdio` | `🟠 Local MCP Process` | Spawns a local stdio MCP server defined in `mcp_config.json` | | `mcp-remote` | `🌐 Remote MCP Service` | Connects to an external HTTPS MCP endpoint (domains listed transparently) | | `lifecycle-hooks` | `🔶 Lifecycle Hooks` | Registers session/tool lifecycle hooks via `hooks.json` | | `host-enhancement` | `💡 Host UI Enhancement` | Uses local CDP bridge or `app.asar` workbench enhancements (glass skins, companion widgets); fully permitted, gentle notice only | - **Capability-Escalation Confirmation**: Updating a plugin that adds newly introduced privilege badges or remote MCP domains pauses for explicit user approval before syncing and updating `.agy-market-receipt.json`. - **Dual-Track Discovery**: Track 1 verified plugins appear by default; opting into **Track 2 Experimental Topic Discovery** automatically enforces `--` double-hyphen isolation. --- ## 🛠️ CLI Commands & Local Development ### CLI (`bin/agy-market.mjs`) ```bash # Install or update AGY Market (optional --dest ) npx agy-market install # Preflight and install a plugin from any GitHub URL (--subpath, --isolate, --replace, --yes, --dest, --mirror, --token, --json) npx agy-market add # Lock-safe uninstall of an installed global plugin (alias: remove; supports --yes, --dest , --json) npx agy-market uninstall npx agy-market uninstall --yes --json # List local installed plugins, config/data paths & market receipts (--json supported) npx agy-market status npx agy-market status --json # Run local installation checks (Node >= 22, real directory check, 10-field manifest purity, built UI) & sweep retired Windows binaries npx agy-market doctor ``` ### Build & Test From Source ```powershell # Build single-file offline-capable Sidebar UI (sidecars/market_pane/index.html) & static showcase npm run build # Copy real plugin bundle into ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-market (never symlinks/junctions) npm run install:local # Verify local installation node ./bin/agy-market.mjs doctor # Pack deterministic release tarball (dist/agy-market.tar.gz + .sha256) npm run pack:release # Run unit & integration tests npm test ``` --- ## 🔒 Security & Host Redlines - **Never Writes `~/.gemini/config/config.json`**: Read-only inspection only; Vault Parking handles enable/disable cleanly. - **Never Creates Symlinks / NTFS Junctions**: Every install performs real directory/file copies and rejects archive traversal (`..`) and symlink/hardlink tar entries. - **Windows Lock-Safe Sync & Crash Recovery**: Stages outside `~/.gemini/config/plugins/` in `${PLUGIN_DATA}/staging/`, journals transitions via `pending-journal.json` (auto-recovered 8s after boot), renames locked binaries to `*.old.`, and sweeps them via `retired-binaries.json`. - **Loopback-Only Local Server & CSRF Guard**: Listens strictly on `127.0.0.1` (ephemeral port) and enforces a 256-bit random `X-Sidecar-Token` + `Origin` check on all `POST`/`DELETE` routes. --- ## 📚 Guides, Architecture & Contributing - **[📖 Plugin Submission Guide (`docs/SUBMISSION_GUIDE.md`)](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market-catalog/blob/main/docs/SUBMISSION_GUIDE.md)** — Full Track-1 single-YAML & Track-2 auto-discovery submission tutorial - Read **[`AGENTS.md`](./AGENTS.md)** and **[`../AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md)** before modifying any module in this repository. To submit plugins, visit **[`azwosile/agy-market-catalog`](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market-catalog)**. ## 📄 License [MIT License](./LICENSE)
